title: Video Editor for 8 Figure Ecommerce Brand
job_title: Video Editor for 8 Figure Ecommerce Brand
description: Summary Our brand is looking for a full-time Direct Response Video Editor to join our fast-growing e-commerce team! As our video editor, you will be responsible for turning raw footage, UGC, stock, and briefs into high-converting ads that run across Meta, TikTok, and other paid channels. You’ll work closely with our creative strategists to bring concepts to life, iterate quickly, and deliver engaging ads that resonate with our target audience (primarily consumers aged 40+). This isn’t just about editing — it’s about creating ads that convert. We’re looking for someone with a deep understanding of direct response marketing who can combine speed, creativity, and attention to detail to produce scroll-stopping videos that perform. Who Are We? We are dedicated to building innovative wellness devices that improve people’s lives. Since our launch, we’ve grown rapidly through viral digital marketing, building a passionate community of customers who love our products. We operate with a lean, high-performance team focused on innovation and growth. Now, we’re excited to bring on a video editor to help us scale further by producing top-performing ads week in and week out. What is Our Culture Like & Who Is a Good Fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We live by the following 4 core values: "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king", and "better every day". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you’re looking for a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn’t it. But if you want to challenge yourself, sharpen your editing skills, and play a huge role in scaling a brand to $20M+ a year, you’ll love it here. You’ll be working directly with strategists and founders, producing ads that reach millions of people every month. You’ll join a passionate, smart, and hardworking team with zero politics, no corporate nonsense, and a focus only on results. If you’re hands-on, proactive, and excited to create ads that actually convert — while being rewarded with an excellent performance-based bonus plan — then you’ve come to the right place. Key Objectives - Edit 8-15 minutes of direct response video ads per week. - Produce 3 variants of hooks for each concept for testing. - Apply platform best practices (Meta/TikTok safe zones, pacing, etc.). - Collaborate with creative strategists to bring briefs/scripts to life. - Turn raw UGC/testimonials into polished, engaging ads. - Implement clear CTAs, captions, and motion graphics as per SOP. - Deliver edits in Frame/Trello with proper organization & naming conventions. - Iterate quickly on feedback and resubmit within 24h when revisions are required. Requirements - Fully remote, flexible schedule. - Fluent in English (written and spoken). - Direct Response Expertise: 2+ years editing for DTC/e-commerce brands or agencies. - Strong portfolio of paid social ads (Meta/TikTok a must). - Proficiency with Adobe Premiere, After Effects (or DaVinci/CapCut if equally strong). - Ability to edit fast without sacrificing quality. - Skilled in text animations, captions, pacing, and effects that drive engagement. - Understanding of performance-driven editing (knowing what makes people stop scrolling). - Experience with AI tools (voice cloning, Arcads, Runway, etc.). - Prior experience in generating clips and full videos with AI (Veo, Kling, GPT…) like the viral cartoon ads or clay ads Accountabilities - Deliver high-quality edits on time — no missed deadlines. - Complete revisions within 24h of feedback. - Follow brand guidelines (colors, fonts, captions). - Attention to details, make sure to start your application or include in the title the word White - Ensure every video is engaging, entertaining, and never boring. - Maintain organized project files, naming conventions, and Frame/Trello workflow. - Constantly push creative limits and bring fresh editing ideas. How Our Hiring Works Step 1: Initial interview (mindset, experience, portfolio review). Step 2: Skill Assessment Test + Review Interview Step 3: Final culture & expectations interview. We hire within 7–10 days of starting interviews and value fast communication. Salary Expectation Range USD $15,000 – $30,000 per year (depending on experience) + performance-based bonuses. Deliverables • Screening Questions • When applying, please answer these: •  1. What about this role attracted you? • 2. How many years of experience you have editing ads for e-commerce brands? • 3. Can you share some e-commerce brands you worked with in the past that we may know? • 4. Share a link to your portfolio (must include different formats like AI videos like cartoon ads, VSLs, UGC, reels…). • 5. How many minutes of video editing you are able to do in a full week of work? (For example if you do x5 2 minutes video, it will be 10 minutes of editing) • 6. Which editing tools do you use daily? • 7. How do you handle tight deadlines and last-minute revisions? • 8. Are you ok working on weekends or overtime, when needed? • 9. What fixed monthly rate would make this role work for you? (keep in mind there will be big bonuses based on the performance as well)

title: Social Media Manager ( 8 Figures Skincare Brand)
job_title: Social Media Manager ( 8 Figures Skincare Brand)
description: Hi, I’m Loic, the founder of a fast-growing, 7-figure US-based direct-to-consumer skincare brand on track to hit 8 figures this year. We create targeted body care specifically designed for mature women. We are entering a critical growth phase. I am looking for a sharp, visually obsessed Fractional Social Media Manager (10–15 hours per week) to take complete ownership of our organic social media channels. The Reality of the Role: You are the "Curator." We already have a dedicated Influencer Manager hunting down raw content and UGC from creators. Your job is to take that raw content, filter it, write exceptional copy, and perfectly curate our Instagram and TikTok feeds. If you just want to blindly schedule generic posts using a social media tool without caring how the overall grid looks or how the audience reacts, this is not the role for you. CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: You must have a deep understanding of visual storytelling for DTC e-commerce brands and the ability to adapt your copywriting voice to speak respectfully and authentically to a mature (50+) demographic. What You Will Do: Grid Ownership: Schedule and publish all organic content across Instagram and TikTok. You own the visual flow and pacing of our feeds. Visual Curation: Filter incoming creator content to ensure it matches our brand identity. You must actively reject content that looks off-brand, over-processed, or inauthentic. Copywriting: Write intelligent, engaging captions that educate our audience and drive community interaction. No generic, robotic marketing speak. Community Cultivation: Act as the voice of the brand in the comments and DMs, engaging with our audience in a professional, warm, and direct tone. Who You Are: Aesthetic Filter: You know immediately what makes a post look native to a brand versus what looks like cheap filler. DTC Native: You understand the difference between a high-converting organic post and a vanity post. Empathetic Writer: You know how to write copy that resonates with a mature woman—treating her with respect, not talking down to her. Highly Reliable: You manage your own time efficiently. You don't need to be micromanaged to ensure posts go live and comments are answered. What We Provide: Direct Access: You report directly to me (the Founder). No middle management. Flexibility: This is a fractional, remote role designed to fit around your schedule, provided the grid stays flawless and the community is engaged. ???? HOW TO APPLY (Read Carefully) ???? We ignore all generic, AI-generated applications. To prove you read this, have the required attention to detail, and actually have an eye for brand curation, you must follow these exact steps: 1. The Subject Line: Make the subject line of your application: "Brand Curator: [Insert Your Favorite Animal]" 2. The Video Intro (Required): Record a 1 to 2-minute Loom video introducing yourself. Tell me why you want to work for a skincare brand targeting mature women, and briefly describe your philosophy on what makes a DTC brand's Instagram grid successful. Applications without a video link will be instantly deleted. 3. The Curation Test: Find one specific e-commerce brand on Instagram (in the wellness, beauty, or lifestyle space) that you believe has an exceptional, highly cohesive organic grid. Paste the link to their profile, and in two sentences, explain exactly why their curation works. 4. The Copywriting Test: Imagine we received a great, authentic video of a 58-year-old customer applying our body polish in her bathroom and raving about how incredibly soft and hydrated her skin feels after just one use. Write the exact Instagram caption you would use for this post. (Hint: Keep our mature demographic in mind. Be engaging, authentic, and include a clear call-to-action). Please attach your portfolio (or links to accounts you have managed) and send your application following the steps above. I look forward to meeting you!

title: Backlog Administration & Service Desk Specialist (Jira)
description: Backlog Administration & Service Desk Specialist (Jira / Jira Service Management)** We are a Dutch SaaS company building an AI-native platform on which organizations run their customer-facing and operational processes — CRM, customer journeys, and workflow management. Our enterprise customers operate in energy, telecom, and field operations, with new verticals coming. We are looking for a sharp, detail-obsessed specialist to run our service desk and product backlog administration. This is not a ticket-pushing job: customers bring us complex, often vague problems, and you are the one who untangles them, translates them into clear tickets, and thinks along with the customer about the right solution. You are the first responder on our customer service desks and the guardian of our Jira backlog. You make sure every customer request is acknowledged fast, turned into a well-written ticket, refined until the dev team can pick it up without questions, and kept in sync until it ships. You work alongside modern AI-assisted tooling — we automate the repetitive parts step by step, and you run the process, handle the judgment calls, and keep quality at 100%. ### Responsibilities - **Service desk first response** — acknowledge incoming customer requests within 15 minutes during working hours, across multiple customer service desks (Jira Service Management) - **Ticket intake** — convert each service desk request into exactly one well-structured Jira ticket (user story, acceptance criteria, correct type/labels/links/epic) - **Refinement** — drive tickets to Definition of Ready: clarify with stakeholders, attach context, route complex items through the refinement flow, escalate what you cannot resolve - **Complex problem analysis** — dig into vague or multi-layered customer problems, ask the right questions, find the root cause, and translate it into clear, actionable tickets — you think along with the customer instead of just logging what they say - **Status synchronisation** — keep service desk and Jira statuses in sync through the full lifecycle, so customers always see the true state - **Delivery & release validation** — closely involved in feature delivery: manually test and validate new features and configurations before they reach the customer, and confirm they work after release - **Configuration work** — resolve configuration-level issues in the platform yourself (settings, templates, setup) instead of routing everything to developers - **Customer communication drafts** — prepare release notes and pre/post-release customer updates - **Backlog hygiene & reporting** — periodic backlog clean-ups, sprint/cycle progress reports, flag bottlenecks and stale tickets - **Scrum collaboration** — participate in the daily scrum and sprint rituals with our (remote, English-speaking) dev team ### Requirements - 2+ years hands-on experience with **Jira and Jira Service Management** (workflows, boards, linking, JQL is a plus) - **Excellent written English** — you write user stories, acceptance criteria, and customer-facing updates - Extremely detail-oriented and process-driven — status accuracy and ticket quality are the core of this job - **High analytical intelligence (IQ 120+)** — you can break a complex, ambiguous problem down to its root cause and concrete next steps. We test cognitive ability as part of the hiring process. - Reliable availability with **overlap with European (CET) morning hours** — our response SLA is contractual - Experience working with Scrum/agile software teams - Comfortable working with AI-assisted tooling and structured runbooks (we document everything; you follow and improve the playbook) - Self-starter who escalates early instead of guessing ### Nice to have - Experience with manual QA / acceptance testing of web applications - Experience configuring SaaS platforms (workflows, templates, settings) - Experience at a SaaS / software product company - Confluence experience - Basic understanding of software release cycles (staging vs production) ### How to apply Reply with: 1. A short note on your Jira/JSM experience (which workflows you managed, team size) 2. One example of a user story + acceptance criteria you wrote (or write one for a feature of your choice) 3. A short description of a complex problem you untangled for a customer or team: what was unclear, what did you do, what was the outcome 4. Your available working hours in CET Shortlisted candidates will take a cognitive ability test and complete a small trial task. Applications without these three items will not be considered.

title: Loan Servicing Supervisor – U.S. Auto Finance

Strong problem-solving skills and ability to resolve operational issues without constant supervision. Comfortable reviewing calls, account notes, reports, and performance data. Strong Excel skills. Ability to manage multiple departments or work queues at the same time. High integrity when handling customer information, payment-related records, and confidential company data. Preferred Qualifications Experience with U.S. auto finance, consumer lending, debt collection, BPO collections, insurance verification, or payment processing. Experience with CRMs, loan servicing systems, dialers, ticketing systems, or call center platforms. Experience creating SOPs, call scripts, coaching forms, QA feedback, or agent scorecards. Experience working night shift or U.S. Central Time schedule. Bachelor’s degree required, exception possible if the candidate has strong relevant experience. Performance Expectations The successful candidate will be measured on: Team productivity and task completion. Collection agent performance and customer resolution rates. Customer service response quality and turnaround time. Insurance verification follow-up quality. Accuracy of account notes, documentation, and financial records. Chargeback and dispute documentation quality. Agent attendance, accountability, and coaching effectiveness. Call quality and compliance with company procedures. Compensation and Incentives We offer a competitive compensation package for a high-performing supervisor. Compensation includes: Competitive monthly base salary. Performance-based incentive plan. Long-term growth opportunity with a U.S.-based finance company. Remote work arrangement. Opportunity to supervise and improve a multi-function operations team. Final compensation will depend on experience, leadership ability, communication skills, and proven performance in collections, customer service, insurance, or financial operations. Ideal Candidate Profile You may be a strong fit if you are: An A player collections agent who wants to grow to a supervisory role, current collections supervisor, call center supervisor, BPO team leader, operations supervisor, customer service supervisor, or financial services team lead. Comfortable managing both people and detailed account records. Strict about documentation, follow-up, and accountability. Confident coaching agents and correcting performance issues. Able to work independently during U.S. business hours. Looking for a serious long-term role with performance-based growth potential. Technical and Remote Work Requirements Because this is a remote role supporting U.S.-based finance operations, candidates must have a reliable home-office setup and be able to work consistently during assigned U.S. Central Time hours. Required Equipment Candidate must have: A reliable desktop or laptop computer, not shared during working hours. Minimum computer specifications: Intel i5 / Ryzen 5 processor or better Minimum 8GB RAM, 16GB preferred Windows 10/11 or current macOS Working webcam Updated antivirus/security protection Professional USB noise-canceling headset with microphone. Backup headset or microphone available in case of equipment failure. Second monitor preferred, especially for supervising multiple systems, reports, and agent activity. Internet Requirements Candidate must have: Stable wired internet connection. Minimum internet speed: 25 Mbps download 10 Mbps upload Preferred internet speed: 50 Mbps+ download 20 Mbps+ upload Ability to join video meetings, use cloud-based systems, access call platforms, and work without frequent disconnections. Power and Backup Requirements Candidate must have: Reliable electricity at their work location. Ability to continue working during brief power interruptions. Candidate must proactively notify management if there are recurring power or connectivity issues. Workspace Requirements Candidate must have: Quiet, private, professional work area. No excessive background noise during calls or meetings. Ability to handle confidential customer and company information privately. No working from public places such as cafés, shared public spaces, or unsecured networks while accessing company systems. Professional appearance and camera-ready environment for meetings when needed. Reliability Expectations This role requires strong attendance, punctuality, and operational reliability. The supervisor must be available during scheduled hours, responsive to management, and able to maintain consistent communication with the team. Repeated internet outages, power interruptions, equipment failures, or inability to maintain a professional remote setup may affect eligibility for continued remote work. How to Apply Please submit your resume and answer the following questions: How many years of supervisory or team lead experience do you have? Have you supervised collections, customer service, insurance, or financial services agents? Please explain. Have you worked for a U.S.-based company or U.S. account before? What systems, CRMs, dialers, servicing platforms, or reporting tools have you used? Describe your experience with payment disputes, chargebacks, billing issues, or financial record maintenance. What is your expected monthly compensation in PHP? Are you available to work U.S. Central Time business hours?

job_title: Senior Automation & Web Developer — Zapier / Airtable / APIs / WordPress / GTM / AI
description: About Us We're a fast-growing Australian business finance company. We're a lean team that competes through automation — our tech stack does the work of 100 people, and we're hiring one senior person to own, extend, and improve it full-time. (Company details shared with shortlisted candidates at interview stage.) This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone). Our Stack (you'll work across most of this) -Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps) -Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API) -Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation) -ActiveCampaign (automations, API) -Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run) -REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job -LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API) -WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code. -Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API) -Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments -Softr (client portal on top of Airtable) -Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation. What You'll Do -Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems) -Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability -Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google -Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings -Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for. -Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms -Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break) -Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions. -Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this Compensation -Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience -Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance. -Annual base increases for strong performers -Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months Hours Of Work Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME. Who This Role Suits -5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool -You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail -You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround" -You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain) -You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked -You test your own work before calling it done -You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first -You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs Who This Role Does NOT Suit -Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps -Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role -Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs -Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours) -Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination. -Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point. Security Note (read this — it matters) We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great. SKILL REQUIREMENTS Required: -Zapier (Expert) -Airtable (Expert) -AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert) -API Integration / REST APIs (Expert) -WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced) -Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced) -Python (Advanced) -HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced) -Webhooks (Advanced) -Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced) Strongly preferred: -Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce) -ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo) -Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions) -Flask or similar Python web frameworks -Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking Nice to have: -Softr / no-code app builders -Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs -SQL HOW TO APPLY To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read: 1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post. 2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't. 3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.) 4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem? 5. Your expected monthly salary in USD. 6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively. 7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning. If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

Responsibilities * Call customers who did not complete a purchase and convert them into paying customers * Re-engage customers who did not make a repeat purchase * Reactivate inactive or dormant customers * Improve retention and repeat purchase rates through outbound communication * Build and optimize outbound calling workflows * Define required customer data and segmentation needs * Work with internal teams to request and structure customer exports/lists * Track and report KPIs including: * conversion rates * retention lift * reactivation rates * revenue generated * repeat purchase rate * call efficiency metrics * Maintain dashboards and performance reporting * Continuously test and improve messaging, scripts, and customer handling approaches * Identify friction points in the customer journey that impact conversion or retention ? Requirements * Proven experience in telehealth, pharmacy, healthcare, wellness, supplements, or related high-retention industries * Strong outbound calling and retention/reactivation experience * Experience converting warm or inactive leads into paying or returning customers * Understanding of retention metrics and customer lifecycle management * Ability to independently manage outbound operations * Experience working with CRMs, customer exports, reporting tools, and dashboards * Strong communication and persuasion skills * Data-driven mindset with focus on measurable business impact * Fluent English ? Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate: * understands how to recover lost revenue through outbound communication * knows how to structure retention campaigns independently * can identify which customer segments are worth calling * is comfortable taking ownership instead of waiting for instructions * already has systems, workflows, or infrastructure for managing outbound operations efficiently ? Required in Your Application Please include ALL of the following in your application: 1. Relevant Experience Share your experience in: * telehealth * pharmacy * healthcare * wellness * supplements * subscription businesses * retention/reactivation outbound sales 2. Performance Metrics / Case Studies Please provide real examples of results you achieved through outbound calls, such as: * conversion rate improvements * recovered revenue * retention increase * repeat purchase lift * reactivation numbers * call-to-conversion metrics * revenue generated per campaign Concrete numbers are strongly preferred. 3. Mini Test Assignment 3.1 Reactivation Strategy You receive a list of 5,000 customers who purchased once but never reordered. Describe: * which segments you would prioritize first * your call approach * what metrics you would track * how you would measure campaign success 3.2 Call Script Write a short outbound call script for a customer who: * started checkout * did not complete the purchase * has not responded to email /SMS follow-ups The goal is to recover the sale naturally without sounding overly aggressive. 3.3 KPI Dashboard Describe what metrics and dashboard structure you would use to manage an outbound retention/reactivation operation. Include: * KPIs * reporting frequency * conversion tracking * operational metrics * business impact metrics ? Compensation Compensation format is flexible and can include: * fixed monthly payment * performance-based bonuses * commission structure * hybrid model Please include your preferred compensation structure in your application.

title: AI Creative Operations Manager
description: Job Post: AI Creative Operations Manager Position: AI Creative Operations Manager / Technical Team Lead Location: Remote — Philippines Employment Type: Full-Time after a successful paid pilot Paid Pilot: 2 weeks — $400 USD flat project fee Full-Time Compensation: $1,500–$1,800 USD per month to start, depending on experience, with room for growth Company: Rudderr LLC This position is designed as a senior systems-builder and quality-control leader, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level graphic designer. The manager will build and operate a scalable AI-assisted content team, recruit and train junior editors, create repeatable workflows, and enforce strict product-accuracy standards. About Rudderr Rudderr is an e-commerce brand management and wholesale growth company that helps consumer brands expand across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Faire, and social media. We manage products across several categories, including outdoor and survival gear, home improvement, lawn and garden, wellness, beauty, and specialty consumer products. We are building an internal AI-assisted content production operation capable of producing high-quality product lifestyle images, short-form videos, and UGC-style content at scale. About the Role We are looking for an experienced AI Creative Operations Manager to build, lead, and manage our Philippines-based content production team. You will not be expected to create every image or video yourself. Your primary responsibility will be to build the people, systems, workflows, and quality-control process required to deliver accurate, realistic, and premium e-commerce content consistently. You will receive original product photography and creative direction from our U.S. team. You will then manage a team of junior AI image and video editors who transform those product photos into realistic lifestyle scenes, advertising assets, social media content, and short-form videos. Our most important standard is product fidelity. Logos, dimensions, materials, colors, proportions, accessories, controls, textures, and product features must remain accurate. Product distortion, invented features, incorrect branding, and visibly artificial imagery must be caught and corrected before delivery. Primary Responsibilities Build and Manage the Creative Team • Recruit and evaluate junior AI image editors, video editors, and creative production contractors. • Handle onboarding, training, performance reviews, coaching, and replacement of underperforming tea ---------- mbers. • Maintain sufficient staffing so content production does not stop when an editor becomes unavailable. • Assign work based on each editor’s skills, availability, and performance. • Build a reliable team capable of increasing or decreasing production based on demand. Build the Content Production System • Create repeatable workflows for AI-assisted product photography, lifestyle imagery, video, and synthetic UGC. • Develop SOPs, templates, prompt libraries, brand guidelines, file-naming systems, and quality-control checklists. • Establish a clear process from receiving original product photos through final asset approval. • Organize project files, source images, masks, models, prompts, revisions, and final exports. • Improve production speed without sacrificing product accuracy or visual quality. • Work toward a typical delivery time of approximately 24–48 hours for standard content requests. Own Quality Control • Review every asset before it reaches the U.S. team. • Enforce a zero-tolerance standard for distorted products, altered logos, incorrect colors, missing accessories, unrealistic shadows, and inconsistent proportions. • Check perspective, lighting direction, contact shadows, reflections, scale, resolution, texture, anatomy, and environmental realism. • Identify whether an asset can be corrected through inpainting, masking, compositing, relighting, regeneration, or manual Photoshop editing. • Train junior editors to recognize common AI generation errors. • Maintain consistency across image collections, recurring virtual models, brand campaigns, and product variations. Manage AI Image and Video Production • Oversee the creation of realistic lifestyle scenes using original product photography. • Ensure that the actual product remains accurate while environments, backgrounds, people, and scenarios are generated or composited around it. • Direct the creation of outdoor, camping, water-sports, home, wellness, and other product-specific lifestyle scenarios. • Manage short-form video production using still product images, generated environments, motion effects, and AI video tools. • Develop recurring virtual creators or product experts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, advertising, and educational content. • Ensure temporal consistency so products remain sharp and stable while backgrounds or surrounding elements move naturally. Manage Performance and Communication • Serve as the primary point of contact between Rudderr and the creative production team. • Translate creative requests into clear assignments for junior editors. • Track production volume, revision rates, approval rates, turnaround time, and editor performance. • Provide regular updates on project status, staffing, bottlenecks, and tool requirements. • Recommend workflow, staffing, and software improvements based on measurable results. • Manage software access and ensure company assets, trained models, and workflows remain organized and secure. The operational model including manager ownership of recruiting, onboarding, training, performance management, production continuity, and final quality is central to this position. Required Experience • At least 3 years of experience managing a creative, multimedia, design, post-production, or digital content team. • Demonstrated experience recruiting, training, and managing remote creative professionals. • Strong understanding of e-commerce product photography and lifestyle content. • Advanced ability to review and correct AI-generated images. • Strong attention to product accuracy, branding, visual realism, and fine details. • Experience building SOPs, creative workflows, quality-control systems, and performance standards. • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, including: o Layer-based compositing o Precise masking o Generative Fill o Color correction o Shadow and reflection creation o Perspective correction o Image cleanup and retouching • Strong written and spoken English. • Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of managing professional image and video workflows. • Ability to work independently, make decisions, and communicate problems before they affect deadlines. Preferred Technical Experience Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with several of the following: • ComfyUI or another node-based Stable Diffusion workflow • ControlNet, including Depth, Canny, and related control methods • IP-Adapter or product-reference conditioning • Advanced inpainting and outpainting • Product masking and image compositing • IC-Light or similar AI relighting tools • BiRefNet, InspyreNet, or advanced background-removal workflows • Photoroom Pro • Flair.ai • Adobe Photoshop and After Effects • Runway • Kling AI • Luma Dream Machine • PixVerse • HeyGen • Captions.ai • AI avatar or synthetic UGC workflows • Project-management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or ---------- We are specifically looking for candidates who understand controlled, repeatable AI production and not someone whose experience is limited to entering prompts into ChatGPT or Midjourney. The technical requirements reflect the need for node-based workflows, controlled product placement, advanced masking, relighting, motion consistency, and professional Photoshop correction. Helpful Additional Experience • Outdoor, survival, camping, water-sports, home-improvement, or consumer-product brands • Managing freelance or offshore production teams • Creating content for multiple brands at the same time • Developing recurring virtual models or AI-generated brand ambassadors • Capacity planning and creative production budgeting What Success Looks Like Within the first 30–60 days, the successful candidate will have: • Recruited and evaluated a dependable group of junior editors. • Established clear production and quality-control SOPs. • Created a dependable workflow for receiving, producing, reviewing, revising, and delivering assets. • Reduced preventable revisions caused by product distortion or overlooked AI defects. • Built a consistent pipeline for realistic product lifestyle imagery. • Established measurable expectations for turnaround time, asset quality, and editor performance. • Begun expanding the operation into video and UGC-style content. Two-Week Paid Pilot Finalists will begin with a paid two-week project. During the pilot, the candidate will be asked to: • Source and evaluate two to three potential junior editors. • Provide clear creative assignments using several test product photographs. • Direct the editors in creating distinct lifestyle-image concepts. • Develop a short-form video concept for each test product. • Review AI-generated images and identify product, lighting, anatomy, perspective, and realism problems. • Demonstrate how they would organize the workflow, manage revisions, and approve final assets. • Present a proposed team structure, production process, and quality-control checklist. The purpose of the pilot is not to determine whether the manager can personally create every asset. It is intended to evaluate the candidate’s ability to find talent, communicate standards, build systems, manage production, and prevent defective work from reaching the client. Junior editor expenses approved for the pilot or ongoing operation will be managed under a separate company-funded production budget and will not be deducted from the manager’s compensation. description: Go Home, LLC CEO Right-Hand / Property Operations VA Full-Time, Assertive, Proactive Operator Type of Work: Full Time Starting Rate: $3.00/hour Hours: 40 hours per week Schedule: 5 working days per week within a Monday through Saturday operating window. We manage rental properties in Chicago, including tenant issues, maintenance, rent collection, vendor coordination, paperwork, scheduling, and day-to-day operational fires. This role is for someone who wants to become the CEO’s operational backbone, not someone looking for easy admin work. ------------------Compensation Notice------------------ This role starts at $3.00/hour. The starting rate is fixed and not negotiable during the interview process. Do not apply with the idea that you will interview, impress me, and then ask for a higher starting rate. However, good people should not feel stuck. Strong performers can earn more responsibility and better compensation over time. Performance reviews may happen after 30 days and 90 days based on reliability, communication, ownership, judgment, attendance, throughput, and ability to close loops. If $3.00/hour is not acceptable as the starting rate, do not apply. If you are only looking for temporary work while searching for something better, do not apply. ------------------What You Will Do------------------ You will help with: • Tenant follow-up and rent/payment coordination • Calling or messaging tenants, vendors, and contractors • Scheduling maintenance and following up until work is done • Tracking open issues until they are fully closed • Updating spreadsheets, Trello cards, Google Drive files, and internal systems • Managing invoices, reminders, admin records, and documentation • Reviewing training videos and SOPs independently • Preparing summaries, updates, and next-step recommendations • Helping with scheduling, logistics, calendar coordination, and executive-support tasks This is not a narrow job-description role where you say, “That’s not my task.” If it is legal, professional, ethical, and helps buy back the CEO’s time, you should be willing to help handle it. ------------------Who This Role Is For------------------ This role is for you if: • You are assertive, not timid • You are comfortable making outbound calls • You can speak directly to tenants, vendors, and contractors • You do not freeze when someone is upset • You can self-train using videos, SOPs, screenshots, and written instructions • You ask good questions • You communicate clearly when something is unclear • You can handle direct feedback • You want to become a high-trust, long-term operator ------------------Who Should Not Apply------------------ Do not apply if: • You are shy on the phone • You avoid confrontation • You need step-by-step instructions for every task • You only want easy admin work • You disappear when confused • You say “done” when a task is only partially done • You dislike direct feedback • You cannot work consistently during agreed hours • You already have too many other clients or jobs • You plan to ask for more than $3.00/hour before proving yourself If you d ---------- the role is not for you, I expect professional communication and a clean handoff. Disappearing without notice is not acceptable. ------------------AI Tools and Throughput------------------ AI tools, including ChatGPT, are allowed. I care about throughput, judgment, and completed work. AI should help you move faster, organize better, summarize clearly, document work, and produce cleaner output. AI should not be used to avoid thinking, avoid phone calls, avoid decisions, avoid accountability, or send generic answers. If AI makes your work faster and more accurate, good. If AI makes you passive, vague, dependent, or generic, this role is not for you. ------------------Required Skills------------------ You must be strong in: • Spoken English • Written English • Phone communication • Tenant/customer service • Direct follow-up • Google Sheets or Excel • Gmail • Google Drive • Trello or similar task-management tools • Calendar/scheduling • Documentation • Self-learning • Prioritization • Problem-solving Property management, collections, dispatch, call center, executive assistant, legal admin, or operations experience is a major plus. ------------------Work Schedule------------------ This is a full-time role. Expected schedule: • 40 hours per week • 5 working days per week • Workdays may fall between Monday and Saturday • Sundays are always off • Must have meaningful overlap with Chicago business hours ------------------Application Instructions------------------ To apply, use this subject line: RIGHT HAND OPERATOR - $3 FIXED RATE Do not send a generic cover letter. Generic applications will be ignored. Answer every question below. ---------- . Rate Confirmation------------------ This role starts at $3.00/hour. Do you understand and accept that this is the fixed starting rate? Answer clearly: Yes, I accept the $3.00/hour fixed starting rate. ---------- . Direct Communication Test------------------ A tenant is late on rent and says: “I’m not paying the late fee. I had a hard month, and it’s unfair. Remove it.” Write exactly what you would say back to the tenant. Keep it short. Do not be rude. Do not be weak. ---------- . Judgment Test------------------ It is Monday morning. Three things happen at the same time: A tenant says there is no heat. A contractor missed a scheduled repair. A tenant is late on rent and avoiding payment. What do you handle first, second, and third? Explain why. ---------- . CEO Time-Buyback Test------------------ I tell you: “I am traveling tomorrow. I have a meeting, a workout plan, a meal schedule, a car issue, and several business tasks open. I need you to make tomorrow easier for me.” What steps would you take to help? Be specific. ---------- . Phone Confidence------------------ Are you comfortable making outbound calls to tenants, contractors, vendors, and leads? Answer clearly: Yes or No. Then explain your experience. ---------- . AI Judgment Test------------------ How do you use AI or ChatGPT to get more work done? Give one example. Also explain one situation where you should not rely on AI and should use your own judgment instead. ---------- . Availability------------------ What hours can you work in Chicago time? Are you available full-time? Do you currently have other jobs or clients? If yes, explain your current workload. ---------- . Long-Term Fit------------------ Are you looking for a long-term role or a temporary role? If you were offered a higher-paying opportunity after a few weeks or months, how would you handle that professionally? ---------- . Voice Sample------------------ Record a short 60 to 90 second voice note answering this: “Why would you be a strong right-hand operator for a direct, fast-moving CEO?” Include the link in your application. Applications without a voice sample may be ignored. ------------------Final Note------------------ I am not looking for someone who only interviews well. I am looking for someone who can work, communicate, follow up, learn quickly, and become useful fast. If you are reliable, assertive, direct, organized, and serious about growing into a long-term operator role, apply. If you want an easy role, vague expectations, flexible excuses, or a higher starting rate, do not apply.

title: Voice AI Intake Agent Developer — Retell / Vapi — Phase 1 Standalone Test
job_title: Voice AI Intake Agent Developer — Retell / Vapi — Phase 1 Standalone Test
description: Job Type: Project-based / paid test first Project Overview: I am looking for a Voice AI developer to build a **standalone Phase 1 intake-only voice agent** for a mobile mechanic / field service business. This is separate from my n8n / FieldPulse / CallTrackingMetrics automation build. Another developer is currently handling the first n8n automation proof test. For this role, I want to start with a small paid Voice AI test that proves the agent can answer calls, collect basic service request information, classify the call, and produce structured output that can later connect to n8n, CTM, and FieldPulse. Preferred platforms: **Retell AI or Vapi**. I am open to either, but I want the developer to explain which platform is better for this Phase 1 intake-only use case. ## Important Scope Boundary This first Voice AI agent is **intake only**. The agent must not: * diagnose mechanical problems, * estimate repair cost, * quote prices, * schedule appointments, * dispatch technicians, * assign technicians, * promise arrival times, * promise same-day service, * create live FieldPulse jobs, * make commitments on behalf of the business. The agent’s job is to collect information and route the call for human review/follow-up. ## What the Agent Should Do The Voice AI agent should: * Answer incoming calls professionally. * Explain that it will collect information so someone can follow up. * Collect required intake details. * Classify the call type. * Flag incomplete calls for human review. * Produce a transcript, summary, classification, missing fields, and structured JSON output. * Send or simulate an email recap and SMS alert during the test. * Be designed so it can later connect to n8n, CallTrackingMetrics, and FieldPulse. ## Required Intake Fields The agent should attempt to collect: * Caller name * Callback phone number * Whether the callback number can receive texts Suggested wording: “Is this a mobile number we can text if needed?” * City / ZIP where the vehicle or equipment is located * Vehicle or equipment description * Brief description of the issue * Urgency * Roadside / safety status * Existing customer vs. new caller if clear ## Call Classifications The agent should classify calls into categories such as: * Qualified service request * Incomplete intake / needs human review * Roadside or safety review * Existing customer follow-up * Non-service call / sales / spam * Out-of-area or maybe-out-of-area For incomplete calls, the agent should list the missing fields and mark the call as: **Needs Human Review — Incomplete Intake** ## Structured Output The test should produce structured output that can later be used by n8n. Example fields should include: * caller_name * callback_number * can_text_callback_number: true / false / null * city * zip * vehicle_or_equipment * issue_summary * urgency * roadside_or_safety_status * classification * incomplete_intake * missing_required_fields * human_review_required * transcript * summary * recording_or_call_link if available ## First Paid Test Deliverables For the first paid test, I expect: 1. Voice AI agent configured in my account. 2. Intake-only prompt / rules / behavior. 3. Guardrails to prevent diagnosis, pricing, scheduling, dispatching, or response-time promises. 4. 8–10 sample test calls. 5. Transcript and summary output. 6. Classification and missing-field handling. 7. Structured JSON output. 8. Email recap and SMS alert, or clearly mocked/sample alert output if full alert setup is not included. 9. Final prompt/configuration. 10. Setup notes. 11. Loom walkthrough explaining how the agent works. 12. Explanation of what I can safely edit later myself, such as script wording, approved responses, alert recipients, and minor rule changes. ## Future Expansion Later phases may include: * Connection to n8n * CallTrackingMetrics tracking number integration * FieldPulse-ready customer/job payloads * Better alert routing * More advanced review workflow * Miro flowchart update for the Voice AI portion These are not required for the first test unless specifically agreed. ## Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate has experience with: * Retell AI and/or Vapi * Voice AI prompt design * Intake call agents * Call classification * Webhooks * JSON outputs * n8n or Make * Twilio or SMS alert workflows * CRM or field service workflow integrations * Human-review routing * Clear documentation and Loom walkthroughs Direct experience with FieldPulse or CallTrackingMetrics is helpful but not required. ## Please Answer These Questions Start your reply with: **I can build the Voice AI intake agent.** Then answer: 1. Have you built voice agents using Retell, Vapi, or another voice AI platform? 2. Which platform do you recommend for this Phase 1 intake-only agent, and why? 3. How would you prevent the agent from diagnosing, estimating, scheduling, dispatching, assigning technicians, or promising response times? 4. How would you handle incomplete calls and missing required fields? 5. Can you produce structured JSON output for future n8n integration? 6. Can you include the field `can_text_callback_number: true / false / null`? 7. Can you send or simulate email recap and SMS alert output during the test? 8. What accounts/access would you need fro ---------- before starting? 9. Can the agent be built inside my account so I own the configuration? 10. What simple things would I be able to edit later myself? 11. Can you provide a Loom walkthrough at the end? 12. What fixed price and timeline would you quote for the first paid test? 13. Are you willing to send a short video reply before I make a final decision? ## Budget Please quote a fixed price for the first paid test. I am not looking for a full production system yet. I want a small controlled proof test first. If the test goes well, there may be additional work.

title: Social Media Manager
description: Social Media Manager — Role & Playbook Business: Website design for restaurants & local businesses Platforms: Instagram (primary), TikTok, Facebook The one job: Grow a relevant audience and turn it into DMs ? qualified leads ? paying clients. The Goal (read this first) Follower count is not the goal. The goal is DMs from restaurant owners that turn into paying clients. A 2,000-follower account full of local restaurant owners beats a 50,000-follower account full of random people every single time. At the same time this does not mean we do not want to grow the account the more followers we have the higher chance we can turn viewers and followers into leads. Every post must do one of three jobs: get discovered (Top of Funnel), build trust (Middle of Funnel), or drive a DM (Bottom of Funnel). If a post does none of these, don't post it. North-star metric: number of qualified DMs / leads passed to the owner per week. Secondary metrics: shares, saves, profile visits, follower growth (relevant followers only). Vanity metrics to ignore: raw likes, total followers without context. The Funnel — what to post and how much Use this mix as the default. Early on (under ~2k followers) lean heavier on Top of Funnel to grow reach; once the audience builds, shift more toward Middle and Bottom. Funnel tier % of posts Goal Metric that proves it worked Top (TOFU) ~50% Get discovered by people who don't know us Reach, shares, new follows Middle (MOFU) ~30% Prove we know our stuff Saves, comments, profile visits Bottom (BOFU) ~20% Turn warm followers into DMs DMs, link clicks, leads TOP OF FUNNEL — Viral Hooks, Broad Topics, Shares Purpose: reach strangers and get shared. These are broad, visual, and satisfying. No selling. Content types: Before/after redesigns of real restaurant sites "Redesigning a real local restaurant" series — pick a local spot with a bad site, rebuild it, reveal the transformation (this is the flagship format) Speed builds — sped-up "watch me build a restaurant site in 60 seconds" Broad relatable hooks about bad restaurant websites Hook bank (the first 1–2 seconds d ---------- everything): "This restaurant has amazing food and a website that's quietly killing their business." "I redesigned a local restaurant's website without them asking — here's what I changed." "POV: you Google a restaurant and this is their website." "Your restaurant's website is losing you customers every day. Here's proof." MIDDLE OF FUNNEL — Education, Frameworks, Saves Purpose: convince people who found us that we're the expert. Useful enough to save and send to a friend. Content types: Frameworks: "5 things every restaurant website needs (most miss #3)" Mistakes: "3 things wrong with most restaurant websites" Myth-busting: "Why relying on just a Facebook page is costing you money" Mini-explainers: online ordering, mobile speed, Google rankings — in plain English Hook bank: "5 things every restaurant website needs — most are missing at least two." "The 3-second test: if your site fails this, you're losing diners." "Stop relying on DoorDash for your online presence. Here's why." BOTTOM OF FUNNEL — Client Wins, Hard Pitches, DMs Purpose: turn warm followers into conversations. Direct, proof-driven, with a clear next step. Content types: Client wins / results: "We rebuilt [restaurant]'s site and their online orders went up — here's how." Transparent breakdowns: "Here's exactly what we did for this restaurant and what it cost." Direct offers: the comment-to-DM play (below) Hook bank: "We rebuilt this restaurant's website. Look at the difference." "Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview of your restaurant's new website." "Want to see what your restaurant's site could look like? DM us 'WEBSITE'." The Weekly Posting Schedule Start at 5 posts/week (one per weekday), batched and scheduled a week ahead. Same vertical video gets posted to all three platforms — produce once, repurpose everywhere. Day Funnel Post Monday TOFU Before/after of a recent build Tuesday MOFU Educational framework / mistakes post Wednesday TOFU Redesign series — Part 1 (the bad site + "let's fix it") Thursday BOFU Client win / testimonial / results Friday TOFU Redesign series — Part 2 (the reveal) + soft CTA Rotate so that over two weeks you hit roughly 6 TOFU, 2 MOFU, 2 BOFU. To push more leads, swap a TOFU slot for a second BOFU once the audience is warm. The Social Media Manager's Exact Responsibilities Every week (planning — sent to owner for approval) Build the week's content calendar: what posts, which funnel tier, what day. Write the script and hook for each post (the spoken/on-screen lines). Write the caption and CTA for each post. Edit the raw footage the owner provides into finished vertical reels — captions, hook on screen, trending audio, tight pacing, strong first frame. Schedule every post across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook . Every day Confirm the scheduled post went live on all three platforms. Engage in the first 60 minutes after posting — reply to every comment (this is when reach is d ---------- ). Reply to all DMs. Qualify lightly, log every lead in the tracker, and flag warm ones to the owner immediately. Spend 20–30 min commenting on target accounts — local restaurants, local business pages, food bloggers — to get the account in front of the right people. Every month Report: follower growth, top posts, saves/shares, DMs, leads passed. Note what worked and adjust the mix. How to Gain REAL Followers (not junk) Tag the restaurant in every redesign. When you feature a real local spot, tag them — they often reshare to their own followers (their customers and other owners). This is the single best source of relevant reach. Use local + niche tags: location tags for the city/region, plus restaurant/local-business hashtags. Skip giant generic tags. Reply to every comment and DM. Conversation tells the algorithm the content matters, and it builds real relationships. Be consistent. 5 posts every week beats 15 one week and none the next. Never buy followers, likes, or use engagement pods. It poisons your reach and brings zero buyers. The DM ? Lead Handoff (where the money is) This is the whole point. The conversion mechanic: BOTTOM-of-funnel posts end with a comment-to-DM call to action — "Comment SITE and I'll send you a free preview." Use a tool like ManyChat to auto-DM everyone who comments the keyword. This spikes engagement and drops a warm lead straight into the inbox. The SMM responds, asks 1–2 light qualifying questions (restaurant name, do they have a site now), and logs the lead in the tracker. Anyone who shows real interest gets flagged to the owner to close. Every DM is a potential client. The SMM's job is to start the conversation and hand the owner someone ready to talk. What the Owner Provides The SMM can't build the websites — that's you. Your weekly input is small: Raw footage: screen recordings of builds, before/after captures, the occasional talking-head hook. Batch it once a week into a shared folder. Approve the calendar the SMM sends. Close the warm leads the SMM hands you. Tools Scheduling:Google Calendar (or the free native Instagram/TikTok schedulers) Editing: CapCut Comment-to-DM automation: ManyChat Content calendar + lead log: Google Sheets or Notion (shared with the owner) The Rule That Keeps Everyone Honest Posts are judged by leads, not likes. A post with 200 likes and zero DMs failed. A post with 30 likes that produced two DMs from restaurant owners succeeded. Optimize relentlessly for the conversation, not the applause. We still do need followers, likes, and shares. It is not okay to not get leads or likes.

title: AI Creative Editor / UGC Video Producer for E-Commerce Ads
job_title: AI Creative Editor / UGC Video Producer for E-Commerce Ads
description: WE ONLY LOOK FOR PEOPLE WHO ARE REALLY WILLING TO WORK AND GROW. We're an established team of 10 people running high-volume direct-response ad creative for our own portfolio of e-commerce brands and products across multiple markets. These are our own products — we're not an agency making ads for clients. We're a very driven crew, always testing new products and always looking for new and better solutions — and we mostly produce AI ads. The way we make creative now starts with AI image and video generation, finished with editing and on-brand text overlays. We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented creative who's excited about AI tools, wants to grow with us as the workflow evolves, and — just as importantly — comes up with their own solutions. We don't want someone who only waits for instructions; we want someone who spots a better way to do something and brings it to the table. This is not a "just cut clips together" role. You'll be operating an AI creative pipeline end to end — turning prompts and references we provide into scroll-stopping ads that convert cold traffic. You'll start by making ads to test new products, and there's real room to grow from there (see below). What You'll Do Generate AI images & keyframes from prompts/references we provide (we use Higgsfield + Soul ID / Soul 2.0 for consistent characters — experience with similar tools is fine, we'll train you on ours). Turn images into video using AI image-to-video tools (we use Kling, including Lip Sync for talking-head UGC). Create and sync voiceover audio (we use ElevenLabs) and match it cleanly to video. Write, adapt and overlay headlines & text — not just placing text we give you, but writing and adjusting the headlines on image ads yourself so they hit harder. Hide existing on-screen text and add new text in the correct language, using Canva and/or Figma. Clean, pixel-accurate overlays matter. Work with hooks that already work — take proven, winning hooks and apply or adapt them to new image ads. The hook is the most important part of any ad, so this is a core part of the job. Build scroll-stoppers — strong hooks in the first 1–2 seconds to stop the feed. Combine and re-edit clips into fresh, high-quality ad creatives. Optimize every deliverable for Meta (Facebook /Instagram) and TikTok ad placements. Deliver on time, follow briefs precisely, and keep quality high and consistent. What We're Looking For Hands-on experience with AI creative tools — this is a must. Image and/or video generation (e.g. Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, Midjourney, Sora, ElevenLabs, Soul, or similar). You don't need to know our exact stack, but you must already be working with AI tools, not just curious about them. Experience writing and working with prompts — also a must. You're comfortable crafting and tweaking prompts to get the output you want, and ideally with structured prompt files (JSON). A solutions-first mindset. You don't just execute tasks — you spot problems, test ideas, and bring better ways of doing things to the team. Solid video editing skills in tools like CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, ---------- , or similar. Comfort with Canva and/or Figma for text overlays and basic design. An understanding of human psychology — you get why people stop, click and buy. You can write and tweak headlines and hooks that tap into real emotions and motivations, not just text that "sounds nice." A strong eye for direct-response e-commerce ads — you understand what makes an ad stop the scroll and convert, not just what looks "pretty." Excellent attention to detail and the ability to follow detailed instructions and briefs. Fluent English and clear communication with our team. Reliable, organized, and able to hit deadlines consistently. Big Bonus Skills (Not Required, But Highly Valued) AI UGC video — selfie/confessional, problem-to-solution, talking-head, before/after transformations made with AI. This is not required, but it's a fast-growing part of what we do. If you can produce great AI UGC, it will set you apart and earn you extra bonuses and more work. Experience with Meta / TikTok ad creative specifically. Additional languages — especially Swedish or Finnish — for localization work. A track record of producing creatives at volume. Room to Grow (and Earn More) This role has a clear path forward for people who deliver: Test-product ad creator — where you start. You make ads to test new products across our brands. UGC creator — as you prove yourself, you can move into producing AI UGC content, which earns more. Winning ads creator — the top track: building and scaling the proven, high-performing ads. This is the highest-earning level. If you're driven and your work performs, you won't stay in one place — you'll grow into more responsibility and better pay. How to Apply Share your portfolio — examples of your previous work, ideally e-commerce ads, UGC-style content, or AI-generated image/video. If you've made anything with AI tools, show us. In one or two sentences, in your own words, tell us which AI tool you've enjoyed using most and why. (We're looking for a real answer, not a generated one.) Start your application with the word NORTHSTAR so we know you actually read this post and aren't mass-applying. We review every application that follows these steps. People who can't follow the instructions above won't be considered — attention to detail is the job.?Share

We are expanding our acquisitions team and looking for highly motivated sales professionals who thrive in a performance-driven environment. This is not a customer service position. This is a high-performance sales role for individuals who enjoy building relationships, handling objections, negotiating, and closing deals. If you are hungry to earn more, coachable, competitive, and willing to put in the work required to succeed, this opportunity offers significant income potential and long-term career growth. THE OPPORTUNITY As a Real Estate Acquisition Manager, your primary responsibility will be converting motivated property owners into signed purchase agreements. You will speak directly with homeowners, uncover their motivations, evaluate their situations, present offers, negotiate terms, and guide them through the sales process until a contract is secured. Your success will be measured by your activity levels, conversion rates, and signed contracts. Top performers have the opportunity to increase their commission structure, receive higher-quality lead flow, advance into leadership positions, manage acquisition teams, and earn override commissions based on team production. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Handle inbound and outbound seller leads. • Make 120–160 outbound calls daily. • Build rapport and establish trust with property owners. • Identify seller motivation and pain points. • Qualify leads based on ownership status, property condition, timeline, and motivation to sell. • Gather property details and relevant information accurately. • Present offers and pricing options to sellers. • Negotiate directly with homeowners while maintaining professionalism and empathy. • Overcome objections using both structured sales techniques and adaptive communication. • Follow up consistently with leads who are not ready to make an immediate decision. • Close signed purchase agreements. • Maintain accurate CRM records and update lead statuses in real time. • Track daily activity and performance metrics. • Participate in sales training, coaching sessions, and performance reviews. • Implement feedback and continuously improve conversion rates. • Assist with mentoring and coaching tea ---------- mbers once leadership benchmarks are achieved. PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS Success in this role is measured by results. Expected minimum performance includes: • 120–160 outbound dials per day • 20+ meaningful seller conversations per day • 1–3 offer presentations per day • 25%+ weekly show rate • 1–2 signed contracts per week after onboarding • 20–30% offer-to-contract conversion rate WHAT QUALIFIES AS AN OFFER PRESENTATION? An offer presentation is only counted when: • Ownership has been confirmed • Seller motivation has been identified • Timeline has been established • Property condition has been discussed • A specific offer or offer range has been presented • The seller is actively engaged in negotiation or has provided a clear decision-making path Simple information-gathering calls do not qualify as offer presentations. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for individuals who: • Have proven outbound sales experience • Are comfortable speaking with people all day • Understand how to build rapport quickly • Can confidently negotiate and close deals • Are coachable and open to feedback • Possess strong communication and listening skills • Stay motivated despite rejection • Take ownership of results • Thrive in a competitive environment • Have a strong desire to increase their income and grow professionally REQUIRED EXPERIENCE • Proven outbound sales experience • Cold calling experience required • Verifiable sales performance metrics • Experience handling objections and negotiations • Experience meeting or exceeding sales quotas • Real estate experience is a plus but not required REQUIRED SKILLS • Sales Closing • Cold Calling • Lead Qualification • Negotiation • Objection Handling • Prospecting • CRM Management • Follow-Up Management • Relationship Building • Time Management • Problem Solving • Strong Verbal English Communication • Active Listening WORK-FROM-HOME REQUIREMENTS • Reliable computer or laptop • Noise-cancelling headset • Stable internet connection with a minimum speed of 50 Mbps • Quiet and professional workspace • Ability to work during CST business hours COMPENSATION • $5–$10 USD per hour base pay (depending on experience) • Uncapped commissions • Performance-based commission increases • Leadership override opportunities • Growth into management positions EARNING POTENTIAL • Average performers can significantly increase earnings through commissions. • Strong performers consistently exceed monthly income targets. • Top performers can earn $3,000–$8,000+ per month through commissions, bonuses, and leadership opportunities. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Please submit the following: 1. Full Name 2. Email Address 3. Updated Resume 4. Voice Recording #1 (2–3 Minutes) Handle the objection: "I'm not interested." Respond naturally as if you were speaking with a real seller. Demonstrate your ability to continue the conversation and move toward a next step. 5. Voice Recording #2 (2–3 Minutes) Tell us: • Who you are • Your professional background • What motivates you • Why you are driven to succeed • What keeps you pushing through rejection 6. Sales Performance History Please provide: • Daily call volume • Conversations per day • Deals or contracts closed per month • Conversion rate 7. Availability Please provide your available working hours in CST. 8. Mindset Question What is the highest number of consecutive rejections you have experienced before closing a deal, and what kept you motivated? 9. Compensation Expectations • Minimum hourly rate you will accept • Target monthly earnings at full performance IMPORTANT Applications missing any required information will not be considered. We are looking for serious professionals who are committed to performance, growth, accountability, and long-term success.

description: Product Development Manager The Product Development Manager is responsible for leading end-to-end product development, supplier sourcing, and distributor relationship management across multiple product categories and markets. This role oversees the complete lifecycle of product creation from market research and sourcing to launch and post-launch performance monitoring while considering profitability, quality standards, and timely execution. The ideal candidate has strong experience in product sourcing, supplier negotiations, private label development, and e-commerce operations, particularly within Amazon and Shopify-based businesses. D.E-Commerce & Marketplace Management • Oversee product listings across e-commerce platforms including Shopify, Amazon, and other marketplaces. • Ensure accurate product descriptions, specifications, images, pricing, SEO keywords, and inventory updates. • Monitor listing performance, conversion rates, customer feedback, and sales analytics to improve product visibility and sales performance. • Coordinate with customer service teams regarding product inquiries, returns, and issue resolution. Assist in optimizing Amazon product launches, keyword strategies, and listing enhancements. E. Sales & Cross-Functional Collaboration • Collaborate with the sales team to develop product specifications and support strategic sales initiatives. • Assist sales representatives in identifying client needs and recommending suitable product solutions. • Coordinate with the marketing and design teams for product launches, branding materials, packaging designs, and promotional campaigns. • Work closely with supply chain and logistics teams to ensure accurate forecasting, inventory management, and on-time fulfillment. • Support warehouse and operations teams with inventory tracking, shipping coordination, and production planning. F.Reporting & Performance Monitoring • Develop and maintain tracking systems for product development progress, supplier performance, sales metrics, and inventory movement. • Prepare reports related to product profitability, sourcing efficiency, sales trends, and operational performance. • Analyze data to identify opportunities for cost reduction, process improvements, and business growth. • Monitor KPIs related to sourcing, product launch timelines, quality control, and sales performance. Qualifications: -Education & Experience • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Product Development, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in product development, sourcing, account management, or e-commerce operations. • Proven experience in product sourcing and supplier management, particularly with international suppliers and manufacturers. • Hands-on experience using Jungle Scout, Helium 10, Alibaba, and similar product research and sourcing tools. • Experience managing Amazon, Shopify, or other e-commerce marketplace operations is highly preferred. • Strong understanding of private label product development and product launch processes. -Skills & Competencies • Strong project management and organizational abilities with the capability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills. • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with data-driven decision-making capabilities. • Ability to identify profitable product opportunities through market research and trend analysis. •  Strong attention to detail in product specifications, sourcing, pricing, and quality assurance. • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high operational standards. • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Shopify, Canva, and project management platforms. • Knowledge of Amazon marketplace operations, product ranking strategies, and listing optimization is an advantage. Preferred Qualifications: • Experience working with suppliers and distributors in the U.S., China, Europe, and Middle East markets. • Familiarity with Amazon FBA operations and e-commerce fulfillment processes. • Experience in quality assurance, compliance standards, and manufacturing coordination. • Background in consumer products, retail, collectibles, or private label industries is a plus.
