You will work closely with the Director and play an important role in helping the business operate efficiently on a day-to-day basis. No two days will be the same. One day you may be responding to tenant enquiries and arranging viewings, while the next you may be researching suppliers, obtaining quotations, or assisting with a property development project. We are looking for someone who enjoys variety, takes ownership of tasks, communicates well, and can work independently. Key Responsibilities Tenant & Applicant Communication - Respond to enquiries from prospective tenants via email and property portals. - Answer questions about available rooms and properties. - Arrange and schedule property viewings. - Follow up with applicants and prospective tenants. - Maintain professional and friendly communication at all times. - Support tenant onboarding processes. Property Management Administration - Prepare tenancy paperwork and documentation. - Organise and maintain digital records and files. - Update spreadsheets and internal databases. - Assist with deposit administration. - Track tenancy renewals and important dates. - Assist with referencing and application processes. - Ensure property records remain accurate and up to date. Maintenance Coordination - Log maintenance issues reported by tenants. - Communicate with contractors and maintenance personnel. - Schedule repairs and maintenance appointments. - Track progress of ongoing works. - Follow up to ensure maintenance issues are resolved. - Maintain accurate records of maintenance requests. Executive & Property Development Support You will provide direct support to the Director across a variety of property-related businesses and projects. Responsibilities may include: - Assisting with property development projects. - Researching suppliers, contractors, products, and services. - Obtaining quotations and comparing costs. - Preparing reports and spreadsheets. - Coordinating with solicitors, surveyors, architects, estate agents, and contractors. - Organising project documentation and records. - Managing appointments and diary scheduling. - Assisting with marketing and advertising tasks. - Conducting online research. - Helping implement systems and processes to improve business efficiency. - Supporting the Director with ad hoc administrative and business tasks. General Administration - Managing shared email inboxes. - Data entry and record keeping. - Preparing reports when required. - Calendar management and scheduling. - Document preparation and organisation. - Supporting the wider business with administrative tasks. Essential Requirements - Excellent written and spoken English. - Strong organisational skills. - High attention to detail. - Professional and confident communication skills. - Ability to work independently. - Strong problem-solving abilities. - Reliable internet connection. - Quiet and professional working environment. - Good computer skills. - Experience using Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace. - Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Preferred Experience While not essential, experience in any of the following areas would be beneficial: - Property management. - Real estate administration. - Lettings administration. - Virtual assistant roles. - Executive assistant roles. - Customer service. - Project coordination. - CRM systems. - Maintenance coordination. - Bookkeeping or basic accounts administration. Working Hours This role is specifically designed to provide support outside normal UK office hours while still maintaining some overlap with our daytime team. The successful candidate will primarily work during hours that cover: - UK evenings and overnight periods. - Approximately 3:00pm to 11:00pm UK time. - Weekend coverage (Saturday and Sunday). A small overlap with standard UK business hours to allow communication and handover with the rest of the team. Typical duties during these hours will include: - Responding to tenant and applicant enquiries. - Scheduling viewings and appointments. - Following up prospective tenants. - Coordinating maintenance requests. - Preparing administrative tasks for the daytime team. - Ensuring enquiries are responded to promptly outside normal office hours. - The exact schedule can be agreed with the successful candidate, but we are seeking someone who can provide consistent coverage during evenings, weekends, and other periods when our UK-based team is less available. There will also be regular communication and handovers with our UK office team to ensure continuity of service and efficient operation of the business. What We Are Looking For We value attitude and character as much as experience. The ideal candidate will be: - Detail-oriented. - Reliable and trustworthy. - Professional. - Proactive. - Resourceful. - Organised. - Able to think independently. - Comfortable taking ownership of tasks. - Interested in property, business, and personal development. Salary - Competitive and based on experience. - Please include your expected hourly rate when applying. - Application Requirements To apply, please provide: - Your CV. - A short summary of your previous experience. - Details of any property, real estate, administration, or virtual assistant experience. - Your expected hourly rate. - A 60-second video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this role. Application Test To demonstrate attention to detail, please begin your application with the following sentence: "I am detail-oriented and organised." Applications that do not include this sentence may not be considered. We look forward to hearing from you and finding someone who can become a valued long-term member of our team. This role has the potential to grow into an Operations Manager position for the right candidate.

title: Billing & Collections Specialist (Accounts Receivable + QuickBooks)
description: Job Title: Billing & Collections Specialist (Accounts Receivable + QuickBooks) Salary: $1,400 to $1,600/month USD + performance bonuses Type of Work: Full-time English Level: Fluent Hours per Week: 40, EST business hours (night shift in PH) Skills / Keywords: Stripe, QuickBooks, accounts receivable, collections, bookkeeping, GoHighLevel, ClickUp, data entry WHO WE ARE RoofIgnite runs Meta advertising systems for roofing contractors doing $2.5M and up per year. We're a small, lean team that moves fast: founders, a Director of Ops, account managers, setters, and closers. We do great work for our clients. The problem is on our side of the desk: billing happens late because nobody on the team has time to do it on schedule. Money we've earned sits uncollected. That's wrecking our cash flow, and we're done with it. That's why this role exists. You fix it. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS This is not an admin job. You own the money side of the business. You d ---------- that clients get billed on time, that failed payments get chased without flinching, and that overdue accounts actually get recovered. When you do this well, the whole company feels it. We're giving one person real control over our cash flow. That takes trust, and it takes someone who treats other people's money like it's their own. If that sounds like pressure, it is. If it sounds like the kind of responsibility you've been waiting for, keep reading. This is an urgent hire. We want someone starting immediately. WHAT YOU'LL OWN CORE (this is the heart of the job): Stripe Billing Manually create and send charges in Stripe the ---------- nt the team notifies you. Roughly 60 to 70 bills a month, backend payments averaging $3,500 to $5,000, some larger. You own the billing calendar so nothing slips. On-time collection is priority number one. Collections Build and run the failed-payment workflow. The escalation ladder: reminder, firm follow-up, call, flag to leadership for a service pause, final notice. You send and chase from a dedicated ---------- address, and you'll email and call clients (US roofing contractors) directly. Bad Debt Recovery Recover overdue accounts. A "bad debt" is a client who has missed a full billing cycle or is 14 or more days past due with no response. You go get it. AR Reporting Report regularly on late-payment cycles, at-risk revenue, and recovered debt, so leadership always knows where the money stands. There's real money on the line here every month, and it's your job to protect it. SECONDARY (steady, but not the main event): QuickBooks Categorize expenses. The rules and SOPs already exist and most transactions auto-route. You handle the uncategorized ones and send edge cases for approval. Roughly 500 to 600 transactions a month. You're running the system, not building it. Data QA Audit our B2B Sales Tracker and client check-in system (both in Google Sheets) for missing or incomplete data, then go find the right data and fill the gaps. Example: a lead marked "set and confirmed" but the "setter qualified" field is blank. You flag it and fix it. Sales / Marketing Data Watch Keep an eye on key sales and marketing numbers and flag anything that looks off to the team. OCCASIONAL: HR Onboarding Occasionally onboard new hires in BambooHR. Low frequency, as needed. You'll work closely with leadership throughout. When a client needs their service paused for non-payment, you flag our CEO (Oscar), who directs the account managers. You're the one who sees the problem coming and raises the flag. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - Stripe and QuickBooks: real, hands-on experience. Not "familiar with." You've actually run billing and bookkeeping in these tools. - 2 or more years in accounts receivable, bookkeeping, or collections. - Fluent English, written and spoken. You'll represent RoofIgnite to US clients over email and phone, so both matter. - Strongly preferred: ClickUp, GoHighLevel, BambooHR, Google Sheets. THE PART MOST PEOPLE GET WRONG: This role needs two things that rarely live in the same person: elite attention to detail AND the backbone to chase money without flinching. Most applicants have one. The detail people are often too soft to push a late payer. The pushy people miss the small errors that make an invoice wrong. We need both in one person. If you're missing either, this isn't your role, and that's okay. PAY AND BONUSES Base is $1,400 to $1,600 USD per month depending on experience. On top of that, you earn performance bonuses tied to things like bad debt recovered, on-time collection, and data accuracy. Do the job well and you make more. Simple as that. THE SCREENING TEST (REQUIRED) Before you apply, open the billing accuracy check here and complete it: ---------- This is a real test of the work you'd do every day. Completing it is required, not optional. To apply, start your application with the word INVOICE so we know you read this whole post. Any application that skips the test, skips the INVOICE keyword, or doesn't include a recording will not be considered for an interview. This is a hard gate. HOW TO APPLY A recording is mandatory. Submit either a Loom video (strongly preferred) or a Vocaroo voice recording ( ---------- ). In your recording, cover: 1. Your name and location. 2. Your AR, billing, and collections experience. 3. The tools you've actually used. 4. Your spoken answers to the three questions inside the test: - Which rows have an incorrect Total Charged, and the correct amount for each. - What went wrong in each case (a fee applied when it shouldn't be, a fee missing, or the ad spend math). - What you'd do before sending the invoice. Applicants who complete the test correctly and submit a recording are the only ones we'll consider for an interview. No recording, no interview. The recording is also how we screen English fluency and personality for a client-facing collections role, so speak clearly and naturally. Be yourself.

title: Web Developer | GEO & AI Search Technical Specialist
job_title: Web Developer | GEO & AI Search Technical Specialist
description: We are an AI marketing firm based in Atlanta, Georgia. We specialize in Generative Engine Optimization, helping local businesses appear in AI-generated search results on ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot. We are building a scalable service delivery operation and need a technically strong web developer to implement backend fixes that make our clients' websites readable, crawlable, and citable by AI search engines. This is not a design role. This is a technical implementation role focused on schema markup, site performance, crawlability, structured data, and CMS-level content publishing. You will receive clear task lists generated from our OtterlyAI audit platform and execute them precisely. What You Will Do Schema Markup Implementation (Primary Focus) This is the most important technical task in our service delivery. You will build and deploy JSON-LD structured data for every client website. Every new client requires a complete schema implementation in Month 1. Ongoing clients receive schema updates as their services or information changes. Specific schema types you will implement regularly: LocalBusiness schema with full NAP data (name, address, phone), service area, business hours, geo coordinates, and founding date where available. Service schema for each individual service a client offers, linked to the parent LocalBusiness entity. FAQPage schema on all key service pages. BreadcrumbList schema for site navigation. Review and AggregateRating schema where client has verifiable review data. OpeningHoursSpecification for businesses with complex or 24/7 schedules, which is critical for HVAC and towing clients. All schema is implemented as JSON-LD in the page head. Never inline RDFa. Test every implementation using Google's Rich Results Test and ---------- validator before marking complete. AI Crawlability Fixes You will receive crawlability reports from OtterlyAI identifying technical barriers preventing AI bots from reading client websites. Your job is to resolve each flagged item. Common fixes you will execute: Robots.txt audits and corrections. Many client websites block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, or other AI crawlers either intentionally or by a ---------- through legacy configurations. You will identify blocked bots and add the appropriate allow directives. JavaScript rendering fixes. Content loaded via JavaScript is invisible to most AI crawlers. You will identify pages where key service content, contact information, or structured data is rendered client-side and implement server-side rendering or static fallback content so AI bots see the full page. Page speed improvements affecting crawl budget. Compress images, implement lazy loading, clean up unused scripts, and verify Core Web Vitals are not causing crawlers to time out or deprioritize the site. XML sitemap verification and submission. Confirm sitemaps are current, include all key service pages, and are submitted to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools. Canonical tag review to ensure AI crawlers are not indexing duplicate or thin content pages. WordPress and CMS Implementation The majority of our clients are on WordPress. Some may be on Wix, Squarespace, or custom HTML sites. You will: Publish GEO-optimized content written by our Claude AI workflow. Content arrives formatted and ready. Your job is to publish it correctly with proper heading structure (H1, H2, H3 hierarchy), internal links to relevant service pages, meta title and meta description populated, correct category and tag assignments, and featured image added if provided. Install and configure Yoast SEO or Rank Math on WordPress sites that do not already have an SEO plugin. Configure site-wide settings: organization schema at site level, social profiles linked, XML sitemap enabled. Create new service pages when our content team produces content for services a client has not previously featured on their website. These pages need to match the existing site design, load correctly on mobile, and pass the OtterlyAI crawlability check before being marked complete. Monthly Technical Maintenance Each month you will receive a short technical task list per active client based on the latest OtterlyAI audit recommendations. Typical monthly tasks include updating schema when client hours, services, or pricing changes, fixing any crawlability issues flagged in the weekly audit, publishing new content articles produced by the VA and Claude workflow, and verifying that previously implemented schema is still valid and rendering correctly. You will log all completed tasks in our shared Google Sheet client tracker with the date completed and any notes for the team. Occasional Development Projects As we grows you may be asked to build simple landing pages for specific service areas, implement tracking pixels for Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager, connect client websites to Google Business Profile APIs for automated data syncing, and support the eventual integration of OtterlyAI API data into client reporting dashboards. Tools and Technologies You must be proficient in these before applying: WordPress (theme editing, plugin configuration, page publishing, settings management) JSON-LD schema markup (LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList at minimum) HTML and CSS (sufficient to edit page templates and fix rendering issues) Google Search Console (sitemap submission, crawl error identification, index coverage review) Bing Webmaster Tools (sitemap submission, crawl verification) Google Rich Results Test and ---------- Validator robots.txt configuration Basic JavaScript debugging (sufficient to identify JS-rendered content problems) Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager (basic implementation) Familiarity with these is a strong advantage: Yoast SEO or Rank Math plugin configuration Core Web Vitals optimization Cloudflare or similar CDN configuration Wix, Squarespace, or Webflow (for non-WordPress clients) Google Business Profile API n8n or ---------- (for future automation work) Who You Are You are technically precise. Schema errors, unclosed tags, and broken robots.txt configurations are things you catch before they cause problems, not after. You are fast but not careless. Our clients pay monthly retainers and their monthly deliverables need to go out on schedule. You understand deadlines and communicate proactively when something will take longer than expected. You can work from a task list without needing to redesign everything. We are not asking you to rebuild client websites. We are asking you to implement specific technical improvements to existing sites. You follow the brief exactly and ask for clarification before making assumptions. You understand why the technical work you are doing matters to AI search. You do not need to be a GEO expert, but you should understand at the level of "schema markup helps AI tools understand what this business is and where it is" so you can make intelligent decisions when the task list has ambiguity. You communicate in English clearly and professionally. You will interact with the team lead and occasionally with the VA team. Written communication needs to be clean and unambiguous. Requirements Minimum 2 years of professional web development experience Demonstrated experience with schema markup implementation, with examples you can show Strong WordPress proficiency across multiple client sites simultaneously Reliable high-speed internet with backup option Available for a minimum of 10 to 15 hours per week with potential to grow Ability to turn around standard technical tasks (schema implementation, robots.txt fix, content publishing) within 24 to 48 hours of receiving the task What We Offer Good base pay. A team of strong, integrous individuals. Part-time to start (10 to 15 hours per week) with clear growth path as client volume increases Fully remote and asynchronous work Clear task lists generated from our audit platform, no ambiguity about what needs to be done Long-term stable engagement built on monthly client retainers, not project-based gigs Paid training on OtterlyAI audit outputs and GEO-specific technical requirements Direct access to the firm owner for priority questions How to Apply Cover letter - Include the following: Two examples of schema markup you have implemented on live websites. Paste the JSON-LD code directly in your email or provide URLs where we can verify it with Google's Rich Results Test. If you have never implemented a schema, do not apply. A brief description of a robots.txt problem you identified and fixed on a client site. What was blocked, how did you find it, and what did you change? Your WordPress experience summary: how many sites have you managed simultaneously, which plugins you know well, and whether you have worked in multisite environments. Your available hours, time zone, and typical turnaround time for a standard schema implementation task. Applications without all four items will not be reviewed. Applications that say "see my portfolio" instead of answering the questions directly will not be reviewed.

title: Private Online Psychiatric Mental Health Tutor, Nurse practitioner, Doctor (Nonprofit initiative)
job_title: Private Online Psychiatric Mental Health Tutor, Nurse practitioner, Doctor (Nonprofit initiative)
description: Private Online Psychiatric Mental Health Tutor (Doctor or equivalent) Nonprofit Educational Initiative About This Opportunity This opportunity is part of a nonprofit educational mission focused on supporting learning and development in the field of mental health. The goal is to help equip individuals with strong foundational knowledge in psychiatric mental health, especially for future service, education, and mission driven work. By participating, you will be contributing to a meaningful initiative that aims to expand understanding and access to mental health education. Role Overview We are looking for a licensed doctor, preferably a psychiatrist, or another highly qualified licensed mental health professional based in the Philippines to provide private one on one online tutoring in psychiatric mental health. This is a paid education project. It is not a clinical role, not for patient care, not for independent practice, and not a substitute for formal school, certification, or licensure. The purpose of this role is to deliver structured, high quality education in the core areas of psychiatric mental health knowledge. About the Student The student has a healthcare background, strong CDI and clinical documentation experience, and a strong ability to learn quickly. She already understands medical documentation and clinical workflows, but now wants to build deeper knowledge in psychiatric mental health. She works full time, so the program must be: • practical • organized • efficient • flexible What We Are Looking For We are not looking for casual tutoring. We are looking for someone who can: • mentor and guide the student in a structured way • design a clear learning pathway from start to finish • build a condensed, goal oriented program • help bridge clinical documentation knowledge into psychiatric thinking Your role is to equip and develop the student’s understanding in a serious and structured way, similar to a mentor or preceptor style relationship, but strictly for education only. You should be able to take someone with a strong documentation background and help her understand how mental health professionals: • assess patients • think through symptoms • form diagnoses • choose treatment approaches • understand medication logic • document psychiatric encounters • plan ongoing care Program Expectations The program should be structured and intentional, not random sessions. We are especially interested in applicants who can propose a clear and realistic learning plan explaining: • how you would take the student from point A to point Z • how you would structure the learning, such as weekly sessions, modules, exercises, or guided case discussions • how you would pace the program for someone working full time • what outcomes the student should achieve by the end We expect approximately one session per week, although you may recommend the structure you believe is best. Ideally, we hope the program can be taught in a boot camp style format, with the goal of bringing the student to a strong crash course level of psychiatric mental health knowledge in about 12 weeks or less, if realistic. We are open to your professional judgment on how best to structure this. Core Topics to Cover The program should build strong knowledge in areas such as: • psychiatric assessment • psychiatric interviewing • mental status examination • DSM based diagnosis • differential diagnosis • psychopharmacology • medication selection and reasoning for learning purposes only • treatment planning • care planning • psychiatric documentation, including SOAP style notes • case based discussion • clinical reasoning • safety and risk assessment • crisis awareness and escalation thinking • basic psychotherapy concepts • patient education • follow up thinking and longitudinal care planning We are also especially interested in candidates who can teach the core foundation often associated with advanced psychiatric training, including the 3 Ps: • advanced pathophysiology • advanced pharmacology • advanced health assessment The overall goal is to help the student build the type of psychiatric mental health knowledge commonly developed in PMHNP style training, while fully understanding that this tutoring program is for education only. End Goal By the end of the program, the student should have a strong educational foundation in how psychiatric mental health professionals think and approach: • assessment • diagnosis • treatment options • medication reasoning • documentation • care planning This is about developing clinical thinking and understanding, not simply memorizing information. Important Clarification This program is strictly for education and knowledge building only. It does not replace formal PMHNP education, certification, or licensure. The student is not seeking to practice based on this program alone. Who This Is Best For We are looking for: • licensed doctor preferred • psychiatrist strongly preferred • other licensed mental health professionals with strong psychiatric experience may be considered Ideal candidates will be: • experienced in psychiatric or mental health care • able to teach clearly in English • comfortable with one on one online teaching • organized, reliable, and professional • experienced in teaching, mentoring, tutoring, precepting, or curriculum building • able to design a structured learning program A practicing doctor in the Philippines who wants flexible remote teaching work may be a strong fit. Program Setup • fully remote and online • private one on one format • flexible schedule • approximately one session per week, or as proposed • short term, structured program preferred • Zoom based sessions are acceptable Budget • total budget: PHP 35,000 for the full program Application Requirements To apply, please send to: ---------- • your CV or resume • your professional background • your license and credentials • your psychiatric or mental health experience • any teaching, tutoring, mentoring, or precepting experience • a short introduction video of 3 minutes or less introducing yourself, your experience, and your teaching style • a brief proposal explaining: ?• how you would structure the program ?• how you would take the student from a clinical documentation background to strong psychiatric mental health knowledge ?• what your teaching approach would be ?• what outcomes you expect by the end • your availability for an interview Final Note This is a unique opportunity to combine professional expertise with meaningful educational impact. As part of this nonprofit initiative, your contribution helps support mental health education and future service in this field. We are looking for someone who takes teaching seriously and is willing to guide the student with clarity, structure, and purpose.

description: Read this first I run a lean team and I check the work. Hard requirements (these will be verified — don't claim what you can't show) 5+ years of active, hands-on lead generation experience in this exact type of role — not adjacent, not "I've used a tool once." Active means you've been doing it recently and continuously. ---------- power user. You can build ICP-targeted lists from scratch using filters, manage credits, run email verification, control bounce rates, and export clean data. You'll demonstrate this live (see "How to apply"). GoHighLevel (GHL) hands-on experience. You can import contacts, map custom fields, dedupe, tag, and route leads into the right pipelines/workflows without creating a mess. US and international sourcing. You know how the process changes between US and international markets — data availability, verification, and compliance (GDPR, anti-spam) — not just "I change the country filter." Daily reporting discipline. You produce a clean data report every working day without being asked. Strong written English and the ability to explain your own process in your own words. What you'll actually do every day Pull targeted leads from ---------- against the ICP/segments I assign (US + international). Filter and enrich for fit — title, industry, company size, region, technologies, etc. Verify email s and keep bounce rates low; flag and discard junk rather than padding counts. Export clean data and import it into GHL with correct field mapping. Dedupe against existing GHL contacts so we never double-load. Tag and route leads into the correct pipelines/workflows. Send me a daily report (template below). Keep the lists healthy — ongoing hygiene, not just dumping. The full lead process you must own Sourcing ? ICP filtering ? enrichment ? email /phone verification ? export ? GHL import with field mapping ? deduplication ? tagging & pipeline routing ? daily reporting ? list hygiene. If any step in that chain is unfamiliar to you, you don't have the experience this role needs. Daily report (this is roughly what I expect to see) Total leads pulled today Breakdown by segment and by region (US / International) Verified email s vs. discarded Phone coverage New vs. duplicates removed Count successfully imported to GHL + tags applied Bounce rate / data quality notes Any blockers Real numbers only. A bad day reported honestly is fine. A good day that's made up is not. How we work (the honesty part, in plain terms) Transparency about your methods is required. You tell me exactly what tools and data sources you use — not just Apollo — and you tell me plainly whether you ever buy, scrape, or reuse lists. I'm not trying to trap you; I just won't tolerate being misled about how the leads were produced. Reports must be truthful. Inflated counts, fake or unverified contacts, and copied-forward old data are instant disqualifiers, in hiring and after. "I'm not sure" and "I made a mistake" are acceptable answers. Lying to cover it is not. What I provide ---------- and GoHighLevel access Clear ICPs and segments Payment via Payoneer, on time A boss who actually reviews the work and promotes people who earn it How to apply (this is the screen — skip a step and you're out) A 5–10 minute Loom/screen recording. Show the filters you choose and why, then show how you'd verify and export the data and prep it for a GHL import. I want to watch you actually do it, not hear you describe it. Two professional references from past lead-gen roles, with contact details I can reach. Answer the screening questions below in your own words. Copy-pasted or AI-generated boilerplate gets deleted. Disclose every tool and data source you use beyond Apollo, and state plainly whether you buy, scrape, or recycle lists. Be ready for a short paid test task (1–2 hours) before any ongoing commitment — real work, real pay, my real data quality standards. Start your application with the word "SEALANT" so I know you read this all the way through. Screening questions Walk me through exactly how you build a targeted list in Apollo for the ICP above — which filters, in what order, and why. title: Full-Time Graphic Designer & Social Video Content Creator
job_title: Full-Time Graphic Designer & Social Video Content Creator
description: About Us Reputation Elevation provides a full suite of digital marketing services, with a special focus on the autism therapy (ABA) space. Innovation, exceptional client service, and real results are at our core. Our design team produces a high volume of paid-social and Google ad creative — fast, on-brand, and built to perform. The Role We’re hiring a full-time Graphic Designer and Social Media Video Creator with genuine taste and creative instinct. You have a sharp eye for design, you can write a headline that stops the scroll, and you can turn a brief into polished image and video ads quickly. You’ll work closely with our ads team to concept and produce creative that wins attention and drives leads. This is a high-output, direct-response role. You’ll often work within strict brand and content constraints (more on that below) and still find a way to make the work feel fresh. If you love the craft of making one ad clearly outperform another, you’ll fit in here. Creativity is only half the job. The other half is execution: being quick, organized, and meticulous. A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos due in 3 business days — and “due in 3 business days” means done in 3 business days. Many clients run campaigns in multiple cities, so you’ll often produce near-identical creative sets that differ only in the details — the Atlanta set says Atlanta, the Savannah set says Savannah, and every location-specific element is right in each one. If that level of precision sounds tedious, this isn’t the role; if it sounds obvious, read on. What You’ll Do • Concept and produce high-quality image and video ads for Facebook /Instagram and Google. • Write short, punchy on-asset copy and headlines — not just lay out design. • Tailor creative to ABA therapy providers and our other client industries. • Localize creative sets for multi-market clients — same campaign, different city — getting every location-specific detail right on every version. • Use generative AI as a core part of your workflow to move fast without sacrificing taste. • Partner with the ads team to understand each client and ship creative that hits the campaign goal. • Turn work around on schedule — a standard set of graphics and short videos is assigned with a 3-business-day deadline, and it ships on time, every time. • Deliver organized, editable source files for everything you make. • Keep current on what’s working in paid-social creative and bring ideas to the table. Tools You’ll Use We care about output and taste more than any specific software, but you should be fluent across these categories: • Canva — core to our workflow; you should be very comfortable here. • AI video generation — comfort with current AI video tools for generating and animating ad footage. • Image editing — a professional editor such as Photoshop (or equivalent). • AI image generation — generating and refining on-brand still imagery. • Video editing — assembling short-form video with text, captions, and music. How We Work • Schedule — Full-time. You set your own hours, but you must be reliably available for live overlap from 3:00–6:00 PM Israel time for calls and feedback. • Deadlines — A typical assignment is a set of graphics and short videos with a 3-business-day turnaround. Deadlines are firm; if something threatens one, you flag it early, not on the due date. • Project management — Assignments are managed in ClickUp. • File handling — All work, including editable source files, is uploaded to our shared Google Drive. • Ad accounts — You may be added to our clients’ Facebook Ads accounts to upload creative. Content Standards (Please Read) Our ABA therapy clients require brand-safe, conservative creative. The first rule applies to every asset; the depiction rules apply whenever people appear: • The word “autism” or “ABA therapy” must be clearly visible in the text of every ad. • When people are shown, they’re conservatively dressed — elbows, knees, and collarbones covered — with conservative hairstyles. • Any children depicted read as ordinary, neurotypical kids. • When therapists are shown, they wear casual professional clothing — no lab coats or scrubs. If tightly constrained creative frustrates you, this likely isn’t the right role. If you see constraints as a fun problem to solve, you’ll thrive. We only view job applications from people who really read this through. Prove you read this by including the word “elephant” in your application message. Creative Range (Also Please Read) The rules above govern what appears on an asset — they do not mean every ad shows a therapy session, a child, or even a person. Many of our best-performing creatives don’t. Styles in our rotation include: • Text-only — typographic ads where the headline is the design. • Mood-setting — e.g., aerial footage of a beautiful landscape with a line about autism or ABA written over it. • Animated — animation works when it’s tasteful; it must never read as anime or feel immature. • UGC-style — an image or video of a parent at home, or a therapist working while a parent watches, with text on top. Feels authentic rather than produced. That list isn’t a menu to pick from — it’s a starting point. There are endless creative styles to innovate, and part of this job is bringing us formats we haven’t tried. We want someone who works within our rules and keeps pushing the style range. What We’re Looking For • Proven experience designing paid-social / direct-response ad creative (image and video). Please share a portfolio of ad work specifically — not only brand or editorial pieces. • A strong eye for layout, type, and what makes a scroll-stopping ad. • A style innovator — someone who moves fluently between text-only, mood-driven, animated, and UGC-style formats, and keeps proposing new ones we haven’t tried. • Solid short-form copy/headline instincts. • Real, current experience using generative AI for images and graphics. • Sharp attention to detail — especially across near-duplicate versions of the same creative (different cities, phone numbers, offers) where one wrong detail means a wrong ad goes live. • Organized and dependably on time — you manage multiple clients and deadlines at once, hit a 3-business-day turnaround consistently, and never drop quality to do it. • Clear communicator who collaborates well with a remote team. • Pluses: experience in the ABA therapy / autism space, and the ability to produce high-quality AI-generated video ads. Our Hiring Process Four steps, in this order: 1. Video screener — a short, asynchronous video Q&A via VideoAsk. A few quick questions you answer on camera, on your own schedule. No preparation needed. 2. Portfolio — send a portfolio of paid-social / direct-response ad work (image and video). Given the conservative standards of our client base, portfolios must contain no indecent or risqué imagery — submissions that include it will not be reviewed. 3. Paid test assignment — a small, paid creative brief done to a real deadline, so we can see your taste, your process, and your reliability under our actual working conditions. 4. Interview — a live conversation about your work, your test, and the role. What We Offer • Full-time remote role with flexibility in how you structure your day. • A supportive, collaborative team that ships a lot of work. • Real impact on our clients’ marketing results. • Competitive compensation based on experience and skill. Join us in creating visually stunning, high-performing ad campaigns that make a difference.

job_title: Email Marketing Specialist — Savaya Botanicals (DTC Supplement Brand)
description: We're a DTC supplement brand selling through Shopify with Meta Ads as our primary acquisition channel. We're scaling and we need someone who can turn our email marketing into a serious revenue channel — not just a newsletter, but a full retention machine that drives lifetime value, repeat purchases, and subscriptions. We use Klaviyo. We need someone who lives in Klaviyo. The Role You own email . The flows, the campaigns, the segments, the copy, the design, the testing, the data. This isn't a role where we tell you what to send — we need someone who builds the strategy, executes it, and reports on what's working. You'll work closely with our Creative Strategist on visual direction, but the email domain is yours. Our goal is simple: email should drive 30%+ of total revenue. If you've done that before, we want to talk. What You'll Do ? Build, optimise, and manage all Klaviyo email flows from scratch — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned browse, post-purchase, win-back, sunset, VIP, replenishment, subscription nudge, review request ? Write high-converting email copy — direct response style, not corporate newsletter. You understand pain points, urgency, social proof, and how to make someone click "buy" from an email ? Design or direct the design of all email templates — clean, on-brand, mobile-first. If you can design in Klaviyo or Canva yourself, even better. If not, you brief our designer with precision ? Plan and execute weekly/bi-weekly campaign sends — promotions, content, education, launches, seasonal ? Build and maintain smart segmentation — by purchase behavior, engagement level, product interest, lifecycle stage, subscription status. No batch-and-blast ? A/B test everything — subject lines, send times, copy, design, offers, flow timing. You test with structure, not gut feeling ? Monitor deliverability — inbox placement, spam rates, list hygiene, domain reputation. You keep us out of the promotions tab ? Analyze and report on email performance — revenue attribution, flow performance, campaign ROI, list growth, churn. Weekly report to the founders ? Focus on LTV and subscriptions — our biggest lever is turning first-time buyers into subscribers. Your flows and campaigns should be engineered to drive recurring revenue ? Build a replenishment strategy — supplements run out. You know when. You email at the right time with the right message ? Coordinate with our Creative Strategist to ensure email creative is congruent with ads and landing pages What You Won't Do ? Run ads — separate team ? Build landing pages — separate workflow ? Customer support — separate team ? Guess — everything you do is backed by data or a structured test What We're Looking For ? Deep Klaviyo expertise — you've built flows from scratch, not just tweaked templates. You know the platform inside out: flow filters, conditional splits, dynamic content, custom properties, API events ? DTC e-commerce email experience — ideally supplements, beauty, wellness, or health. You understand the buying psychology in this space ? Direct response copywriting skills — your email s read like a good sales page, not a corporate memo. You write hooks, you build urgency, you close ? Data-driven — you can pull a Klaviyo report and tell us exactly where the revenue is leaking and what to fix ? Experience with subscription models — you've worked with brands that sell subscriptions or replenishment products and you know how to use email to drive and retain subscribers ? Experience building segments that actually drive results — not just "engaged vs. unengaged" but sophisticated behavioral segments that change how you communicate ? Deliverability knowledge — you understand SPF, DKIM, DMARC, warm-up schedules, list cleaning, and why engagement-based sending matters How You Work (This Matters as Much as Your Skills) ? You build systems, not just email s. Your flow architecture, your testing calendar, your segmentation logic, your reporting cadence — all of it is documented and repeatable ? You create SOPs for everything you build. If you set up a flow, there's a document that explains the logic, the triggers, the timing, and the reason behind every decision ? You organise your work so that someone could take over your email program and understand exactly what's running, why, and what's next ? You take full ownership — you don't wait for us to tell you what to send. You look at the data, see the opportunity, propose the test, and execute ? You report proactively — every week we know what's performing, what's underperforming, and what you're doing about it ? You think about email as part of the full customer journey, not an isolated channel. How does the email experience connect to the ad they clicked, the landing page they saw, and the product they received? What Success Looks Like ? Email revenue grows from current levels to 30%+ of total revenue within 90 days ? All core flows are live, tested, and optimised within 30 days ? Subscription conversion rate from email increases measurably within 60 days ? Weekly reporting cadence established and maintained ? Full SOP documentation for every flow and process within 60 days ? List health metrics stay strong: deliverability above 95%, unsubscribe rate below 0.3% Screening Questions — Answer These in Your Proposal Share a Klaviyo flow you built from scratch. Walk us through the logic: what triggers it, how many email s, what are the conditional splits, and what results did it drive? A DTC supplement brand has a 12% repeat purchase rate and no subscription program yet. How would you use email to increase that? Be specific about which flows and campaigns you'd build. What's your process for writing a high-converting email ? Walk us through from blank page to final send — including how you decide on the angle, subject line, and CTA. You notice that your welcome flow has a 45% open rate on email 1 but drops to 12% by email 4. What do you do? Have you built SOPs or documentation for an email program before? Describe what you documented and why. What's your weekly reporting structure? What metrics do you report on and what do you do with the insights? Details ? Remote, ongoing contract ? Klaviyo is non-negotiable — if you don't know Klaviyo deeply, this isn't the right fit ? Reports to: Founders + coordinates with Creative Strategist ? Brand: Savaya Botanicals (supplements, DTC, Shopify) Apply with: ? 2–3 examples of Klaviyo flows or campaigns you've built (screenshots or case studies) ? A short message about your experience with DTC email marketing and subscription-based brands ? Your answers to the screening questions above ? Your monthly or hourly rate We're looking for someone who treats email like a revenue engine, not a checkbox. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Ad Editor Who Thinks Like a Buyer
job_title: Ad Editor Who Thinks Like a Buyer
description: We're looking for an editor who understands why people buy — not just how to cut clips. Most editors we talk to are technically good. They know their software. They know their transitions. But they don't know why someone stops scrolling at 0.3 seconds — or why they click at the end. That's the gap. And that's who we need. The opportunity We're a Swedish brand building the international market for Digg-it! — a product that's replacing one of the most widely used (and misused) everyday items in the world: the cotton swab. The category is massive. We're early. And we're building the team that scales it. This isn't a one-off project. This is a long-term partnership with a fixed monthly retainer plus a percentage on every winning ad we build together. If you're good — and you stay good — this compounds fast. What you can earn Fixed Monthly retainer — negotiated by experience + % On every ad that hits our winning threshold ~$10K Monthly ceiling for top performers as we scale The more winning ads you produce, the more you earn. There's no ceiling on the performance side. What we actually need You understand that the first 3 seconds of an ad are not an intro, they're a contract. You either earn the next 15 seconds or you don't. You think about awareness. Someone who's never heard of earwax problems needs a completely different hook than someone already looking for a solution, and you know how to edit for both. You use juxtaposition. Tension. Contrast. You know that curiosity gaps don't come from text alone, they come from what you put next to what. You can take raw UGC footage, a mom talking to her phone, and turn it into something that stops a thumb at 11pm. You care about why the ad worked. Not just that it looked good. What we don't care about Your software setup. Use what works. Years of experience. We care about thinking, not tenure. Agency-style polish. We care about performance, not pretty. Three questions, answer these Before you send your portfolio, answer these. Written answers only, no video needed. We can tell a lot from how you think. Question 1 Someone is scrolling Instagram at 11pm. They've never once thought about earwax, not theirs, not their kid's. What do you open the ad with, visually and on screen, to make them stop? Walk us through your thinking, not just your answer. What this tells us: whether you understand the hardest ad to make — reaching someone who doesn't know they have a problem yet. Question 2 What's the single biggest mistake editors make when cutting a direct response ad, and what do you do differently? What this tells us: whether you think about conversion, not just content. Question 3 You receive a clip: a mom looks at the camera and says "I used cotton swabs on my kids for years, then I found out you're not supposed to." How do you open the ad? What's the first visual? What text goes on screen, and when? Take us through the first 10 seconds. What this tells us: whether you can build tension, create a bridge, and use real footage to do emotional work. Portfolio Send 3–5 ads you've edited. Direct response preferred, but anything built to make someone take action works. For each one: what was the goal, and what happened. A sentence or two is enough. We're not building a freelance roster. We're building a small, serious team. If you're the kind of editor who obsesses over why an ad worked, not just that it did, this is the right place to grow.

TIMELINE - Applications close in 10 days - Top 5 candidates get a 30-minute Zoom interview with the founder - Hire starts within 1 week of interview - Two-week paid trial at full base + bonuses We're not in a rush. description: About the Role We are a fast growing performance marketing agency generating leads across multiple industries. Our Google campaigns are already live and spending. This role is not about building accounts from the ground up. It is about stepping into active campaigns, identifying what is dragging performance down, and fixing it decisively with clear reasoning behind every move. You will report directly to our Operations Manager and Founders. No layers, no waiting. Your work gets seen and acted on right away. What You Will Be Doing >Monitor all active Google Ads campaigns daily with a strong focus on YouTube and keep a close eye on performance trends before they turn into bigger problems. >Dig into the data to find real CPL improvement opportunities across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, and campaign structure. >When performance drops, you diagnose it quickly, fix it with intention, and document your reasoning clearly so the team stays aligned. >Catch creative fatigue before it hurts results and brief new hooks and testing angles backed by what the numbers are telling you. >Stay on top of what is trending on YouTube and proactively bring fresh ideas to the table. We want someone who notices what is gaining traction on the platform before it shows up in our metrics. >Come up with new hook concepts and creative angles regularly. You do not need to produce the content yourself, but you should always have suggestions ready and know how to brief the team clearly on what to test next. >Adjust targeting, audiences, budgets, bid strategies, and campaign structure based on evidence, not gut feel. >Research what competitors are running on YouTube and translate those insights into creative briefs the content team can act on immediately. >Send a concise weekly performance report with clear, actionable next steps every single week. >Stay in close communication with the team through Slack and manage your own tasks in ClickUp without needing to be followed up on. What We Are Looking For >At least 3 years of hands on experience managing Google Ads with YouTube as a primary channel in a performance focused, lead generation environment. >Someone who has a proven track record of improving existing accounts, not just launching them and moving on. >Deep understanding of how YouTube ad formats work inside Google Ads Manager, including In Stream, In Feed, and Shorts placements, and when to use each one. >A solid grasp of lead generation funnels and what actually drives CPL down over time. >Comfortable working inside large scale Google Ads Manager accounts with meaningful daily spend. >A genuine interest in YouTube as a platform. You should be someone who actively watches trends, pays attention to what is getting views and engagement, and brings that awareness directly into your campaign decisions. >Strong creative instincts around hooks and angles. You know what stops a scroll and holds attention in the first 5 seconds, and you can explain why something will or will not work before it ever goes live. >Able to produce clear and actionable creative briefs that a content team can run with straight away, no back and forth needed. >Proficient with ClickUp and Slack as part of a remote, self managed workflow. >Strong written communicator who takes ownership and gets things done without being micromanaged. Logic Question (Required) You are managing a YouTube lead generation campaign inside Google Ads. Over the past 7 days CPL has increased by 60% even though budget, audience, and creative have not changed. Your In Stream skippable ads are showing a view through rate that has dropped from 40% to 19%. Impression share has remained stable. Landing page conversion rate is holding steady at 13%. Walk us through your full diagnostic process. What do you check first, in what order, and why? What is your hypothesis and what action do you take? We are not looking for a perfect answer. We want to see how you think, how you structure a problem, and how deep your knowledge of the platform actually goes. Video Introduction (Required) ****Record a 2 to 3 minute video and upload it to Loom or Google Drive.**** Include the link in your application. Tell us who you are, walk us through your Google and YouTube Ads experience, share a specific result you are proud of with real numbers, and explain why this role makes sense for where you are right now. Read This Before You Apply To confirm you have read this post in full, begin your cover letter with the exact phrase "I want to grow lucky". Applications that do not start with this phrase will not be reviewed. What We Offer $10-$12.5 per hour based on experience, with a formal review after probation. A full time remote position with a stable, growing agency that has no plans of slowing down. Direct access to the Founders and Operations Manager with no middlemen in between. A fast moving environment where the decisions you make today show up in the numbers tomorrow. How to Apply Send in your CV and a cover letter starting with the required phrase, along with your video link. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.

title: Landing Page Specialist
description: Landing Page Specialist (CRO-Focused) SALARY + PERFORMANCE BASED About the Role: We are looking for a Landing Page Specialist who understands that a landing page is not a brochure — it is a conversion system. Your job is to close the gap between ad click and purchase (or lead). You will own the design, copy, and continuous optimization of every landing page we run traffic to across Meta and Google campaigns. If you think a "good-looking" page is the goal, this is not the role for you. If you obsess over above-the-fold messaging, page speed, and why a visitor didn't convert, keep reading. What You Will Do: Design, build, and iterate high-converting landing pages for paid traffic (Meta, Google) across product pages, advertorials, lead gen pages, and VSLs. Ensure every page is tightly aligned to the ad that sent the visitor there — matching the hook, the angle, and the offer. Message match is non-negotiable. Write or closely collaborate on conversion copy: headlines, subheads, benefit stacks, objection handling, social proof, and CTAs. Run structured A/B and multivariate tests with clear hypotheses, proper statistical significance thresholds, and documented learnings. Optimize for page speed and Core Web Vitals, as both directly affect Quality Score on Google and conversion rates across all channels. Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, and funnel drop-off data (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent) to identify friction points and prioritize fixes. Build landing page variants tailored to different funnel stages — top-of-funnel prospecting traffic requires a fundamentally different page than bottom-of-funnel retargeting traffic. Who You Are: Copy-First Thinker: You understand that design serves copy, not the other way around. You know that the headline is responsible for the majority of conversion outcomes and you treat it accordingly. Analytically Rigorous: You do not declare a test a winner based on gut feel or small sample sizes. You understand statistical significance and know when to call a test and when to let it run. Platform-Proficient: You are hands-on with at least one major page builder (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, or Webflow) and can move fast without sacrificing quality. Funnel-Aware: You understand how the landing page fits into the broader acquisition funnel. You know what a Media Buyer needs from you and you can translate ad creative angles into page structure. Speed-Obsessed: You know that a 1-second delay in page load time can meaningfully reduce conversions and you treat performance optimization as a core responsibility, not an afterthought. Requirements: Portfolio of landing pages with documented conversion rate improvements (before/after data required — no portfolio without performance data will be considered). Proficiency in at least one page builder platform (Replo, GemPages, Pagefly, Unbounce, Webflow, or similar). Working knowledge of CRO principles: above-the-fold optimization, trust signals, social proof hierarchy, urgency/scarcity mechanics, and offer framing. Familiarity with heatmap and session recording tools (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or equivalent). Basic understanding of how Google Ads Quality Score and Meta ad relevance diagnostics are affected by landing page experience. Excellent written English — you will be writing or editing copy directly. To Apply: Please include the phrase "Message Match First" at the top of your application. Along with your resume, attach or link to 2–3 landing pages you have built, and for each one, include the conversion rate before and after your involvement. Applications without performance data will not be reviewed.

Monitor call scores, conversation quality, objection handling, buyer sentiment, follow-up quality, and close attempts. Help sales reps understand their AI-generated feedback and turn it into better sales behavior. Identify patterns across the team, including weak openers, poor discovery, missed closes, pricing objections, or lack of urgency. Sales Reporting Prepare weekly sales performance reports for leadership. Track key sales metrics, including: Calls made Conversations started Appointments booked Show rate Follow-up completion Pipeline created Deals closed Close rate Average call score Rep-by-rep performance trends Flag underperforming reps and recommend corrective action. Sales Process Improvement Help improve scripts, sales workflows, CRM automations, objection handling, and follow-up sequences. Listen to feedback from business owners and sales reps to identify gaps in our offers, sales materials, or AI Agent catalog. Relay market feedback to leadership and the development team so Cynergists can improve its products and sales process. Training and Onboarding Assist with onboarding new sales representatives. Teach reps how to use the CRM, follow the sales process, review AI feedback, and manage their pipeline. Help create simple SOPs, checklists, and training materials for the sales team. Run roleplays and objection-handling practice when needed. What We Are Looking For Strong Accountability You must be comfortable holding sales reps accountable. This role is not just admin support. You need to be able to say, “This was not completed,” “This follow-up was missed,” or “Your call score dropped and we need to fix it.” Sales or Appointment Setting Experience You do not need to be a world-class closer, but you should understand sales activity, follow-up, objections, CRM pipelines, and appointment setting. Experience managing or supporting outbound sales teams is a major plus. CRM Experience Experience with Go High Level, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, Pipedrive, or another CRM is preferred. You must be comfortable learning software quickly and working inside dashboards every day. Tech-Savvy Mindset You do not need to be a developer, but you must be excited about AI, automation, and software. You should be comfortable using AI tools to review performance, summarize activity, identify problems, and improve sales execution. Organized and Detail-Oriented You must be able to manage multiple reps, tasks, follow-ups, reports, and deadlines without letting things fall through the cracks. Clear Communication Strong written and verbal English communication is required. You will communicate with sales reps, leadership, and occasionally other departments, so clarity matters. Calm Under Pressure Sales teams move fast. Leads get missed. Reps get frustrated. Deals stall. We need someone who stays calm, solves problems, and keeps the team moving. Preferred Qualifications Experience managing appointment setters, sales reps, or virtual sales teams Experience working remotely Experience with Go High Level Experience with AI tools or sales automation Experience reviewing call recordings or sales performance Experience creating SOPs or training materials Experience working with U.S.-based companies Strong spreadsheet and reporting skills Performance Expectations Success in this role will be measured by: Sales reps completing required daily activity CRM records staying clean and updated Follow-ups being completed on time Pipeline stages being accurate Improvement in rep call scores Increase in appointments booked Increase in close rate Reduction in missed leads and stalled deals Clear weekly reporting to leadership Why Join Cynergists? Work in the Future of AI Sales You will be helping build and manage an AI-powered sales organization, not an outdated manual sales team. Real Leadership Opportunity As Cynergists grows, this role can become a larger leadership position managing more reps, more processes, and more revenue operations. Remote Work This is a remote position. You can work from your own space while supporting a fast-growing U.S.-based AI company. AI-Powered Training and Support You will have access to our AI Sales Trainer, CRM tools, call scoring, and internal systems to help you manage the team effectively. Growth-Oriented Culture We are building fast. The right person will have room to grow with the company. Schedule Full-time preferred. Must be available during core U.S. business hours for sales team check-ins, reporting, and leadership communication. Compensation Competitive monthly compensation based on experience. Performance bonuses may be available based on team sales activity, booked appointments, closed revenue, and CRM compliance. Our approach combines smart technology, clear strategies, and straight-talking coaching to make a real difference for our clients. We’re also building something exciting ourselves. We use AI and the latest systems to keep ahead, and we’re on an ambitious path of growth through innovation and acquisitions. For our team, this means being part of a company where: • Everyone knows the bigger picture and where we’re headed. • There’s space to grow your skills and take on new challenges. • We combine professionalism with a fun, relaxed working environment. • Work-life balance is valued and supported. *Joining MBS Accountants* At MBS Accountants we are fuelled by helping business owners to stop surviving and start thriving. We are looking for people who fit our values Do what you say – Nobody likes being let down and we think it’s key you don’t set unrealistic expectations. Seek to understand the importance of the task and any deadlines and agree realistic timescales and stick to them or communicate early regarding challenges. Open and honest – Being a closed book doesn’t help anyone. We don’t believe work and home are two different lives. Life is just life. By being open and honest about your whole life we can be empathetic to your circumstances and together we can work towards growth and positivity. Take responsibility – Work-life balance is key and fundamental we believe to living a healthy life. We have core hours but each role also has key outcomes and responsibilities. There will be occasions where flexibility may be needed in order to achieve those outcomes and responsibilities and taking responsibility to act accordingly is key. Team player – As a team we support and empower each other. There will be occasions where you will need to go outside of the standard scope of your role to help out a colleague. This shouldn’t be because we expect it but because you think it’s the right thing to do. Respect – Respect is everything. It should be a given. It should not come just because of somebodies position but simply because we are all human beings. Being able to be candid with someone about their weaknesses and mistakes when done with love is an absolute sign of respect. *Is this role right for you?* If you can answer yes to all the below then this role is perfect for you! Do you love being organised? Do you have a can-do attitude? Do you like data to be stored accurately? Do you like things to be easy to find? Do you question things that don't seem right? Do you ask questions to understand how you can make a greater impact? Do you enjoy challenges and recognise when to ask for help and when to keep pushing on? Are you keen to practice regular self-improvement/personal development? Do you like being recognised for all the hard work you put in? *Want to work with us?* If this sounds like your dream job then we’d love for you to join our team. 1 - Apply here on onlinejobs.ph 2 - Record an intro video (see below) 3 - head to the following webpage - (copy and paste it into a new browser page) and complete the skills test, upload your CV and video - ---------- The video should: A - Make sure we know which applicant you are and can match you up B - Answer the following questions (give us an idea of you as a person) i) A quick introduction name, age, where you live ii) Tell us about what you like doing in your spare time (hobbies, interests, etc)? iii) Who is in your family? iv) Which is your favourite of our values and why? v) Why you would love to work for us? vi) What is the best thing you can bring to us?

Transition campaigns from Max Conversions/Manual CPC to tROAS/tCPA once proof of concept is established. You respect learning phases (minimum 50-75 conversions on Meta) and scale budgets systematically (e.g., 20-30% bumps on Google). A Continuous Learner: You stay up-to-date with the bleeding edge of ad tech. You know why interest stacking is dead on Meta and how to properly structure a PMax campaign without cannibalizing search. Fluent in the Metrics that Matter: You look past vanity metrics. You speak the language of MER (Marketing Efficiency Ratio), Thumbstop Ratio, and true CPA. Requirements: Proven track record of managing profitable Meta and Google Ads campaigns (portfolio/case studies required). Deep understanding of Meta's current retrieval engine (Andromeda) and Google's automated bidding strategies. Experience with tracking and attribution tools (e.g., Triple Whale, Northbeam, GA4, Server-Side Tracking). Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal. To Apply: Please include the phrase "Creative is Targeting" at the top of your application so we know you read this description. Funnel Optimization: Proven track record of reducing funnel friction and improving MQL-to-SQL conversion rates. Inbound Knowledge: Strong understanding of inbound marketing methodologies and content-led lead generation. ### Qualifications & Skills -Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience managing HubSpot in a B2B environment. -Certifications: Active HubSpot Certifications (Marketing, Sales, and Reporting) are highly preferred. -Technical Proficiency: Deep understanding of custom objects, API integrations, and advanced workflow logic. -Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and the ability to interpret complex data sets. -Communication: Ability to translate technical CRM requirements into plain language for non-technical stakeholders. -Detail-Oriented: A "zero-mistake" approach to data management and email automation. ### Performance Indicators (KPIs) -Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs): Volume and quality of leads generated. -Conversion Rate: Percentage of leads moving through each funnel stage. -Sales Feedback Loop: Consistency and speed of lead follow-up by the sales team. -Database Health: Percentage of "marketable" contacts and bounce rate management. ### Why Join Us? This is a pivotal role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital infrastructure. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your work directly impacts revenue and the efficiency of the entire team

title: VIDEO EDITOR STANDARD — EMOTION & PERSUASION
description: VIDEO EDITOR STANDARD — EMOTION & PERSUASION Can be guys from Cinema school 1?? He understands that the script is NOT the final work A top-tier editor understands that: The script = intention The edit = emotional amplification His role is not to execute the script literally, but to amplify it visually by: proving what the script claims, reinforcing every message through imagery, creating emotion where words only suggest it. The edit must make the viewer feel what the script is saying. 2?? He can create emotion without showing the product This is non-negotiable. A strong editor can instinctively make the viewer feel something through editing alone. He knows how to use: Faces Gestures Situations Visual silence Micro- ---------- nts: eye contact breathing discomfort relief ?? He must be able to create an ad that generates emotion and desire even with no sound and no captions. If the message only works with text or audio, the edit is not good enough. 3?? He understands that pacing is a persuasion weapon A top editor uses rhythm as a psychological tool: 1–3 seconds max per shot (often less) Tempo variations to create tension and release Intentional pauses to let emotion land A great edit: is felt, not noticed holds attention without the viewer knowing why never feels “edited” ???? RED FLAGS (INSTANT DISQUALIFIERS) ? Script-execution mindset “I follow the script exactly” “I edit what’s written” Treats the script as the final output ? Needs product shots to create impact Asks immediately for product footage Can’t create emotion without showing the product Relies on features instead of feeling ? Text-dependent editing The ad only works with captions Overuses on-screen text to explain Emotion disappears when muted ? Flat or generic pacing Long shots with no tension Same rhythm from start to finish No sense of buildup or release ? “Pretty but empty” edits Clean transitions but no emotion Cinematic for the sake of style Focused on aesthetics, not persuasion ? Overused, stock-looking visuals Generic smiling people Obvious stock footage No real micro- ---------- nts or human imperfection ? Explains instead of making you feel Tries to inform before creating emotion Prioritizes clarity over impact No visceral reaction from the viewer ???? GOLDEN RULE (NON-NEGOTIABLE) If the ad doesn’t make you feel something and want to keep watching — and buying — even on mute, with no captions, it’s not a good ad.

description: A fast-growing botanical beauty and skincare brand. title: Web Developer for
description: Looking for a developer to build an interactive design tool for me. I run a construction company. When I start a project, I need to sit down with the customer and have them pick out a series of materials/color choices for their project (flooring, cabinets, paint, plumbing fixtures, etc.) I currently have a Word document that I'm using for these selections, but it's a bit cumbersome and doesn't scale. description: AI UGC Video Creator / Video Editor / Creative Designer (Supplements & Problem-Solving Products) We are looking for a full-time AI UGC Video Creator / Video Editor / Creative Designer to join our e-commerce team immediately. This role is perfect for someone who understands AI video creation, UGC-style ads, supplement and health products, Meta/Facebook advertising, and realistic customer-style testimonial videos. We are not just looking for a basic video editor. We are looking for a creative person who can take a product image, create a realistic person or model, build a strong UGC-style video concept, write or improve the script, add voiceover, and deliver polished ad creatives that are ready to run on Facebook , Instagram, TikTok, and other platforms. ## What You Will Create You will create daily ad creatives for supplements, wellness, and problem-solving products, including: - AI-generated UGC-style videos - Realistic customer testimonial-style videos - Problem and solution videos (show the problem, then the product as the answer) - Before/after style result videos - Product unboxing videos - "My daily routine" videos (someone using the product in their morning or night routine) - Mirror selfie / talking-to-camera videos - Voiceover ads - Product highlight videos for supplements, capsules, gummies, powders, drinks, skincare, and other health or problem-solving products - Short-form ads for Meta, Instagram Reels, TikTok, and Facebook Ads ### Example video concepts: - A person receives a parcel, opens it, shows the supplement, and talks about why they ordered it and what problem they wanted to fix. - A 45+ person talks about how they struggled with low energy (or sleep, joints, bloating, focus, hair, skin, etc.) and how this product helped. - A simple "3 reasons I take this every day" talking video with text on screen. - A customer-style UGC video where the person talks about how easy the product is to use, how it tastes or feels, and why it fits into a busy day. - A "problem ? solution ? result" video that hooks the viewer in the first 3 seconds with a relatable problem. ## Tools You Should Know You should have experience using AI tools such as: - Seedance - Kling AI - Higgsfield - Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro - ChatGPT - HeyGen - Runway - Google Veo - ElevenLabs - CapCut - Canva - Premiere Pro - Photoshop or similar tools You do not need to use every tool, but you must be confident creating realistic AI videos and improving them with editing, voiceover, captions, music, and strong ad structure. ## Main Responsibilities You will be responsible for: - Turning product images into realistic lifestyle images and videos - Creating realistic AI people/models using or talking about our products - Writing or improving UGC scripts and hooks built around a clear problem and solution - Creating natural voiceovers and customer-style dialogue that sounds real, not scripted - Editing videos with captions, music, transitions, product close-ups, and strong hooks - Making creatives that feel real, natural, and not overly AI-generated - Creating ads designed to stop scrolling and drive clicks, sales, and conversions - Testing different angles for supplements and problem-solving products - Following platform rules around health and supplement claims (no fake or extreme "cure" promises) - Working quickly and delivering creatives daily - Taking feedback and improving creatives based on performance ## What We Are Looking For We want someone who can think like a creative strategist, not just a video editor. You should be able to look at a product and suggest strong ad angles such as: - "The natural way to fix [problem]" - "What I wish I knew sooner" - "I tried everything before this" - "My honest 30-day results" - "Energy after 40/50" - "The 10-second part of my morning routine" - "If you struggle with [sleep / bloating / focus / joints], watch this" - "Doctor-formulated and easy to take" - "Simple daily habit that changed everything" - "Customer try-it-yourself style" The goal is not just to make beautiful videos. The goal is to create ads that help generate sales. ## Editing Skills We Look For - **Pacing:** Fast-paced editing and fast at revisions - **Visual Hooks:** Strong use of text overlays, B-roll, and sound effects - **Direct Response Focus:** Understands different styles of creatives (AI, UGC, compilation, etc.) - **Iteration Speed:** Able to quickly test new concepts ## Requirements You must have: - Experience creating UGC-style video ads - Experience creating videos for supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or problem-solving products - Experience with AI video generation tools - Strong video editing skills - Good understanding of Meta/Facebook ad creatives - A good eye for realism, lighting, colors, and clean product presentation - Ability to create realistic human/model videos using AI - Ability to write or improve hooks, scripts, and voiceovers - An understanding of advertising rules for health and supplement products - Strong attention to detail - Fast delivery and reliable communication - A creative mindset and willingness to test new ideas ## Work Style This is a full-time remote position with an **immediate start**. We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with our supplement and wellness brands. You must be available daily, work quickly, and be comfortable receiving feedback. You should be excited about AI, health and wellness products, video creation, and direct-response advertising. ## Bonus Structure In addition to your monthly salary, we offer monthly performance bonuses based on how well your creatives perform. If your videos help create winning ads, strong sales, and profitable campaigns, you will be rewarded with extra bonuses. ## To Apply Please send: - A short introduction about yourself - Your portfolio or links to AI/UGC video ads you created - Examples of supplement, health, beauty, or e-commerce ad creatives you have made - The AI tools and editing software you use - Your experience with Facebook /Meta ad creatives - Your monthly full-time rate - Your availability and when you can start **Please start your application with the word ICANDOIT so we know you read the full job post.** ## Test Task Shortlisted candidates may be asked to create FREE sample creatives using our product images. This will help us understand your creativity, AI video quality, editing skills, and ability to create realistic UGC-style ads for supplements and problem-solving products. We are actively hiring and ready to onboard the right person immediately.
