job_title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper — Multi-Entity (QuickBooks Online + Tekmetric) | US Auto Repair Group
description: We're a US-based holding company that owns and operates a growing group of independent automotive repair shops across Texas. We acquire shops and bring them onto a shared accounting platform, so the books span multiple legal entities (operating companies, a holding company, and property-holding entities) with transactions flowing between them. You'll own the day-to-day and month-end books across all entities in QuickBooks Online. A US CPA reviews and files; your job is to deliver clean, reconciled, close-ready books and supporting schedules every month so that review is fast and the filings are accurate. This is a finance-operations role, not data entry. As we close new acquisitions, you'll onboard each new shop into the books — so the role grows with the portfolio. What you'll own - Multi-entity bookkeeping in QBO — maintain accurate books across the holding company, multiple operating shops, and property entities. - Accounts payable — enter and code vendor bills (including auto parts and tire suppliers), manage the AP schedule, prep payment runs for approval. - Accounts receivable — record customer invoicing where applicable and follow up on open balances. - Payroll — record and reconcile payroll across entities. - Reconciliations — monthly bank and credit-card reconciliations for every entity, plus loan and liability accounts. - Parts cost reconciliation — match parts purchases and repair orders from our shop-management system (Tekmetric) against QuickBooks using a reconciliation tool (WickedFile); investigate and flag variances between what was bought, what was billed, and what was booked. - Intercompany — track and keep clean the transactions between entities (rent between property and operating companies, management fees from the holding company, owner draws/loans). - Month-end close — accruals, prepaids, reconciliations, and supporting schedules; deliver close-ready books to our CPA for review and filing. - Reporting — monthly P&L and balance sheet by entity plus a consolidated view; proactively flag anomalies, margin movements, and anything that looks off. - New-shop onboarding — when we acquire a shop, set up or clean its chart of accounts, load opening balances, and standardize it onto our platform. - Documentation & support — maintain a clean audit trail and support diligence, lender/SBA reporting, and annual tax prep. Requirements - 5+ years of full-charge bookkeeping for US-based clients (multi-entity experience strongly preferred). - Expert in QuickBooks Online — you'll be asked to complete a short QBO test. - Comfortable working on the accrual basis and running a month-end close. - Strong reconciliation discipline and obsessive accuracy — you catch the small stuff before it compounds. - Clear written English and proactive communication — you flag issues early instead of sitting on them. - Reliable computer (i5 or better, 8GB+ RAM) and internet ? 50 Mbps; able to work the overlap window above. - Looking for a long-term, full-time, single-client commitment. Bonus (not required, but moves you to the top of the pile) - QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification. - Experience with auto repair, multi-location retail, or field-service businesses. - Familiarity with a shop-management system (Tekmetric, Shopmonkey, Mitchell, etc.) and/or a parts/spend reconciliation tool (WickedFile, Ramp). - Experience supporting a US CPA through close and tax filing. - Experience onboarding newly acquired entities (roll-up / M&A bookkeeping). Why this role You'll be the financial backbone of a fast-growing operator, with real ownership and visibility into how acquisitions are run. As the portfolio grows, there's room to take on more responsibility and eventually help build out a small finance team. We pay above the local market for the right person and reward people who take ownership.

title: Personal Research & Executive Support Assistant
description: ## Overview I'm a busy professional and father based in Portugal. I need a sharp, AI-powered research assistant who can take a brief and come back with organized, actionable options. This is not a virtual receptionist role. This is research, sourcing, coordination, and organization across personal life projects — property renovation, education planning, health, travel, and more. ## AI Is Central to This Role I use AI extensively and I expect you to as well — ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, or whatever makes you fastest. The best person for this role is someone who already uses AI tools daily and understands how to get great results from them. **What great looks like:** - You use AI to find leads faster, compare options, and draft clear summaries - You know which tool works best for which task - You verify everything AI gives you — every link works, every supplier is real, every price is current - Your output is AI-accelerated but human-verified. Speed AND accuracy The difference between good and great in this role is judgment. AI can find 50 results in seconds. Your job is to verify the best 5 and present them clearly. In your application, tell me which AI tools you use and how they fit into your workflow. I'm genuinely interested in how you work. ## What You'll Actually Do **Research & Sourcing (Primary — ~60% of time)** - Product sourcing: building materials, tiles, fixtures, equipment, furniture — find suppliers, compare pricing, compile options with photos and links - Service provider research: find specialists, coaches, practitioners across multiple domains. Compile profiles, availability, pricing, contact details - Education research: homeschooling resources, curricula, programs, activities for a young child - Travel logistics: flights, accommodation, itineraries, visa requirements - Health & wellness: research practitioners, equipment, suppliers (natural/holistic focus) - General: anything I need investigated, compared, or compiled **Organization & Coordination (~25% of time)** - Maintain organized research files and shared documents - Follow up with vendors/contacts on my behalf (English-language) - Schedule coordination (not calendar management — more like "find 3 available slots with this person") - Track project progress and outstanding items - Compile weekly summary of open tasks and findings **Ad-Hoc Support (~15% of time)** - Surprise tasks that don't fit a category - "Can you find out..." questions that need digging - Price monitoring on specific items - Booking confirmations, reservation management ## What I'm Looking For **Must have:** - Excellent English (written and spoken) - Daily AI user — you already use AI tools as part of your workflow, not experimenting with them - Strong research skills — you know how to dig deep, cross-reference, and verify - Self-directed. I give you a brief, you come back with results. You don't wait for step-by-step instructions - Organized. Your output is clean — tables, links, photos, pricing, contact details. Not a wall of text - Reliable. You hit deadlines. If something is going to be late, you tell me before it's due, not after - Available during European morning hours (CET/WEST — Portugal is GMT+0/+1). Core overlap needed: 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time - Comfortable working independently - Meetings will happen daily at the beginning to share context and get started. **Nice to have:** - Experience supporting someone in a personal (non-corporate) capacity - Familiarity with European suppliers and shipping - Interest in health, wellness, natural living, or property renovation (you'll be researching these constantly) - Basic Portuguese or Spanish (helpful for reading supplier websites, not required) **Personality fit:** - High agency. You see a problem, you solve it. You don't flag it and wait - Low drama. Professional, clear communication - Hungry. You take pride in delivering excellent work, not just completing tasks - Honest. If you can't find something, say so. Don't pad results to look productive ## Hours & Compensation - **Full-time: 40 hours/week** (Monday-Friday) - **Schedule:** work your own hours but core overlap 08:00-12:00 Lisbon time required - **Rate:** Competitive for experience level — please include your expected monthly rate - **Tools:** Google Workspace, AI tools, messaging app (Slack/Signal/whatsapp), task management tool (Notion) - **Payment:** Bi-weekly, via Wise or equivalent ## How to Apply **Step 1:** Send me a brief message covering: (please create a loom video addressing me by name) 1. Your relevant experience (keep it to 3-4 sentences) 2. Why this role appeals to you specifically 3. Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your research workflow (be specific) 4. Your expected monthly rate for full-time (40 hours/week) --- *I respond to every serious application. If you put in the effort on the test task, you'll hear back within 48 hours.*

description: Remote, Philippines | Part-time, long-term | US Evening hours BEFORE YOU APPLY: Read this entire post. The first line of your application MUST start with the phrase "REDLINE-READY" followed by your favorite two-digit number (for example, "REDLINE-READY 27"). Applications that skip this step are auto-rejected without review. ABOUT THE ROLE We are a U.S. underground fiber-optic construction company. Every evening our field crews (called "foremen") finish their digging and send in "redline" reports. These are marked-up screenshots of engineering prints where the crew highlights the section of pipe they installed that day and writes the footage by hand. Your job is to turn those daily screenshots into clean records: read the footage and location off each redline, transcribe it onto the master project PDF, double-check that everything reads correctly, and log it in our Excel tracker by foreman, work type, and footage. Accuracy matters, because these numbers feed our weekly billing. This is a recurring daily task (about 1 to 2 hours per evening). It is the first thing we want off our plate, and there is room to grow into more work for the right person. WHAT YOU WILL DO EACH DAY - Collect the day's redline screenshots from each foreman (they arrive around 8:00 PM US time). - Read each redline: identify the highlighted (bored) section, read the handwritten footage number, and identify which print section or tag it belongs to. - Transcribe those footage amounts onto the master "After" PDF for the job. - Double-check your reading against the print to catch mis-reads or numbers that do not line up. - Log each entry in our Excel workbook: one row per entry (Date, Foreman, Work Type which is Bore or Structure, Footage, Notes). - Flag anything unclear or inconsistent instead of guessing. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR (MUST-HAVES) - Strong Excel skills. You are comfortable with data entry, SUMIFS/SUMIF, filtering, and spotting when a total does not match. - Ability to read technical prints or drawings. Secure, password-protected computer used for professional work. Updated operating system and software. Active anti-malware / antivirus protection. Properly configured firewall protection. UGC Editing Edit raw UGC footage into authentic, natural-looking advertisements. Remove pauses, mistakes, weak lines, and unnecessary sections without making the creator sound unnatural. Add relevant B-roll, product footage, screenshots, reviews, graphics, captions, and visual proof. Understand when UGC should look polished and when it should feel casual or imperfect. Create testimonials, founder videos, demonstrations, problem-solution ads, listicles, comparisons, and other UGC formats. Work effectively with footage that may have poor framing, inconsistent audio, or limited B-roll. AI Video Production Create AI-generated and AI-assisted video advertisements. Generate believable AI spokesperson videos Create AI B-roll that supports the script and remains visually consistent. Produce AI voices that sound natural, conversational, emotionally appropriate, and human. Adjust pacing, pauses, pronunciation, emphasis, breaths, and delivery to avoid robotic audio. Identify and correct unnatural lip movement, facial expressions, body movement, hands, objects, backgrounds, and other AI artifacts. Document AI tools, prompts, settings, and generated assets. Motion Graphics Create custom motion graphics that improve clarity and retention. Animate headlines, benefits, features, reviews, statistics, offers, calls to action, and product information. Use professional easing, timing, hierarchy, and visual direction. Create motion that supports the message without distracting from it. Avoid excessive effects, random transitions, and template-heavy editing. Build reusable motion systems while maintaining each brand’s distinct style. Mix voice, music, and sound effects appropriately. Use sound effects intentionally to reinforce visual changes, transitions, text, and product ---------- nts. Correct poor pronunciation and unnatural AI voice delivery. Ensure dialogue remains clear on mobile devices. Captions and Typography Create readable captions designed for mobile viewing. Use clear hierarchy between spoken captions, hooks, benefits, offers, and calls to action. Follow brand fonts, colors, and style guidelines. Keep important text inside platform-safe areas. Check every video for spelling, grammar, capitalization, and punctuation errors. Avoid overcrowded layouts and excessive on-screen text. Brand and Compliance Accuracy Follow each client’s brand guidelines precisely. Use approved product images, packaging, logos, fonts, colors, and claims. Review briefs carefully before beginning work. Understand that many clients operate in restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. Avoid introducing unapproved health, medical, financial, performance, or product claims. Flag potential compliance issues before publishing. Maintain consistency between the advertisement, landing page, offer, and product. Agency Workflow Manage projects across multiple client accounts. Follow naming conventions, folder structures, deadlines, and project-management systems. Maintain organized project files that another editor can easily open and revise. Submit editable source files for all completed work. Communicate blockers and deadline risks before they become problems. Respond professionally to revisions and client feedback. Complete revisions quickly without repeating previous mistakes. Record Loom videos when needed to explain creative decisions. Provide clear beginning-of-day and end-of-day updates. Strong knowledge of motion graphics, sound design, captions, pacing, visual hierarchy, color correction, and editing fundamentals. EXCELLENT WRITTEN AND SPOKEN ENGLISH Comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your work. Organized, responsive, fast, and able to manage multiple deadlines. Comfortable receiving direct feedback and completing revisions. Able to provide editable project files and organized source assets. Comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories. Experience with wellness, supplements, CBD, telemedicine, research compounds, or other restricted categories. Experience reviewing creative performance data. Experience creating multiple hook variations from one concept. Experience working with UGC creators. Experience writing or improving UGC scripts. Experience building repeatable editing systems and templates. Experience reviewing or managing junior editors. Experience with AI prompt engineering. description: Remote · [Full-time / Contract-to-hire — TBD] This is a brand-new role — the first dedicated hire for Bitrograde Labs. You won't slot into someone else's process; you'll help define how a small studio ships complete games fast by directing AI. Ground floor, real latitude, real ownership. About Bitrograde Labs Bitrograde Labs ships small, complete, fairly-priced games on a fast cadence — and helps outside creators finish and launch theirs. No DLC. No microtransactions. Complete games at honest prices. Remember when gaming was fun? We build by directing AI agents, not by typing code line by line. Your job is to make that produce shippable games — not demos that fall apart in the wild. How You'll Work (read this part twice) You will not hand-write most of the code. You'll orchestrate AI agents (Claude Code and similar) to do it. But "doesn't type code" is not "doesn't read code." You are the judgment in the loop: you architect the approach, review what the agents produce, catch them when they're confidently wrong, and refuse to ship what you can't explain. This is the difference between agentic engineering — which works — and vibe coding — which passes a quick test and breaks later. We do the former. The Role You alternate between two modes, never both at once: Build mode: direct AI agents to take a prototype to a finished, shippable game — ~80% in Godot (GDScript), the rest in web tech (JavaScript/TypeScript). Port mode (after a game ships): get finished titles onto every platform that makes sense. This is roughly a 50/50 split — you'll spend about as much time porting finished titles as building new ones. The team handles go-to-market, so you stay focused on the game and the build. What You'll Do In build mode: Direct AI agents to build games in Godot (primary) and web/JS (occasional) Architect the approach and write tight specs/constraints before the agents start Read, review, and debug everything the agents produce — own it as if you'd typed it Run adversarial cross-checks (e.g. a second model reviewing significant changes) and fix what they surface Polish, harden, and ship In port mode: Godot titles: desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux) and mobile via Godot export; console (Switch 1 & 2 / PS5 / Xbox Series) via W4 Consoles middleware Web titles: desktop via Electron/Tauri, mobile via Capacitor, plus Steam and Apple TV Handle platform integration (controllers, achievements, saves), certification, and store submission For a web title that earns a console release: scope and coordinate a native rebuild or an external porting partner (no push-button path exists for web ? console) Must Have You're a gamer. You play, you have taste, you know what "finished and fun" feels like. Hands-on agentic AI development experience. You've actually shipped by orchestrating AI coding agents — not just chatted with a model. You can read, review, and debug Godot / GDScript fluently. You don't have to love typing it, but you must catch a bad implementation, reason about architecture, and explain any line the AI wrote. If you can't read it, you don't ship it — and we treat "the AI wrote it and nobody understands it" as a fireable risk, not a feature. At least one shipped game. Any size — you've crossed the finish line before. Comfortable with build pipelines (GitHub Actions / CI-CD, multi-platform builds). Nice to Have Web game experience (JavaScript/TypeScript, Electron/Tauri/Capacitor) for the ~20% non-Godot titles Prior console work (W4 Consoles; certification for Nintendo / Sony / Microsoft) Mobile and Apple TV deployment Familiarity with agent orchestration workflows and ---------- build tooling You'll Thrive Here If You actually finish things You think a complete game at a fair price is a moral stance, not just a business model "Remember when gaming was fun" makes you nod APPLY HERE: ----------

title: Financial Operations Manager
description: We’re Hiring: Financial Operations Manager We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Financial Operations Manager to support bookkeeping, reporting, payroll coordination, cash flow tracking, tax coordination, and operational financial analytics across multiple business and personal entities. Financial Records * Maintain bookkeeping and financial records across multiple business and personal entities. * Keep transactions properly categorized and reconciled. * Ensure financial records are accurate, organized, and up to date. * Maintain clean documentation for expenses, income, transfers, contractor payments, affiliate payouts, and business obligations. * Identify inconsistencies, missing records, or unusual activity and flag them proactively. ### Financial Reporting & Cash Flow * Prepare monthly financial reports and cash flow updates. * Monitor cash balances across accounts and flag upcoming funding needs. * Advise ownership when transfers are needed to cover payroll, taxes, contractor payments, subscriptions, affiliate payouts, and other obligations. * Support forecasting and financial planning through clear reporting and analysis. * Help leadership understand what the numbers mean, not just what the numbers are. ### Tax Coordination & Compliance Support * Coordinate with tax consultants and assist with tax preparation. * Help organize tax documents, tax organizers, contractor records, and compliance-related files. * Monitor contractors and affiliates for payment tracking and 1099 compliance. * Ensure financial documentation is organized and accessible for tax professionals. * Track recurring tax-related deadlines and follow up before they become urgent. ### Payroll & Contractor Payments * Process or coordinate payroll for business ownership and tea ---------- mbers where applicable. * Track contractor and affiliate payouts. * Review payout approvals and ensure payment information is accurate. * Maintain records of completed and pending payments. * Help improve payment tracking systems so there is clear visibility into who has been paid, who is pending, and what requires approval. ### SaaS / Operational Analytics * Manage Stride CRM user sign-up databases and related financial tracking. * Monitor user analytics, affiliate performance, and payout approvals. * Help track revenue, churn, signups, affiliate activity, and related SaaS metrics. * Support leadership with insights that connect financial data to business performance. * Identify trends, gaps, or anomalies in business performance data. ### Process Improvement & AI Leverage * Use AI tools to reduce repetitive manual work and improve reporting speed. * Use AI to help organize financial data, summarize reports, analyze spreadsheets, create checklists, draft documentation, and identify process gaps. * Look for recurring finance tasks that can be automated, systemized, or simplified. * Document repeatable workflows so the finance function becomes easier to manage over time. * Help turn messy information into clean, usable trackers, reports, and decision-making tools. ### Financial Liaison & Communication * Serve as the primary financial coordination point between ownership, tax professionals, contractors, affiliates, and financial service providers. * Communicate clearly when information is missing, deadlines are approaching, or decisions are needed. * Help keep leadership informed without requiring constant follow-up. * Ask smart questions when something is unclear instead of guessing. ## What We’re Looking For ### Required * Strong bookkeeping and financial operations experience. * Experience preparing financial reports and cash flow updates. * Comfortable managing financial records across multiple entities or business units. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Clear written communication. * Highly organized and reliable. * Able to work independently and follow through without constant supervision. * Comfortable handling sensitive financial information with discretion. * Willing to document processes and improve systems over time. * Proactive enough to flag risks, missing information, or upcoming obligations before being asked. * Comfortable using AI tools to improve speed, organization, documentation, reporting, and analysis. ### Strongly Preferred * Experience working with U.S.-based businesses. * Experience coordinating with tax preparers, accountants, or CPAs. * Familiarity with payroll, contractor payments, and 1099 tracking. * Experience supporting entrepreneurs, real estate businesses, SaaS companies, or multi-entity owners. * Experience with financial dashboards, spreadsheets, and operational reporting. * Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills. * Ability to use AI tools thoughtfully and responsibly in financial operations. ### Bonus Points * Experience with Xero, QuickBooks, Google Sheets, Stripe, payroll tools, or affiliate tracking. * Experience with real estate, land investing, or SaaS metrics. * CPA, accounting degree, bookkeeping certification, or tax-related experience. * Ability to build or improve financial dashboards. * Experience building SOPs or documentation for finance workflows. * Experience creating financial trackers, forecasting models, or automated reporting systems. ## Who You Are You are someone who: * Takes initiative instead of waiting to be chased. * Uses AI and automation to reduce repetitive manual work. * Thinks critically about financial systems, reporting, and process gaps. * Notices risks early and communicates them clearly. * Can turn messy information into organized reports, trackers, and next steps. * Looks for better ways to complete recurring finance tasks. * Understands that this role is not just bookkeeping, but financial operations support for leadership decision-making. * Protects sensitive information and handles financial data with care. * Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with multiple businesses and priorities. * Can balance accuracy, speed, and good judgment. ## Success in This Role In the first 30 days, success would look like understanding the financial structure, current reporting process, recurring obligations, payroll/payment cadence, and key entities involved. You should be able to identify what reports exist, what is missing, what needs cleanup, and what recurring workflows must be protected. By 60–90 days, we would expect you to own the recurring finance cadence more independently, provide clear monthly reports, flag cash flow needs ahead of time, maintain organized records, support tax coordination, and help improve overall financial visibility across the businesses. Long term, success means leadership has cleaner visibility into cash flow, reporting, taxes, contractor payments, affiliate payouts, and business performance without constantly having to chase information. ## Compensation & Details * Remote position * Part-time or full-time depending on experience and fit * Long-term opportunity for the right person * Compensation based on experience, skill level, and communication ability * Must be available for some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time * Reports directly to leadership ## How to Apply We’d love to get to know the person behind the resume, not just look through generic links or a basic application. How do you stay organized when managing finances across multiple entities, people, accounts, or deadlines? 3. What recurring finance tasks do you think should be automated or systemized? We personally review applications and videos because we’re looking for someone who brings more than bookkeeping experience. We’re looking for someone thoughtful, proactive, organized, and able to bring real financial clarity to the team.

description: # Short-Form Video Editor for TikTok — Detail-Oriented, Long-Term **Job Type:** Full-time **Salary:** $500–650/month (USD), based on ramp-up, plus performance bonuses ## About the role I run a TikTok content operation producing short-form product videos at volume. I'm looking for a reliable, detail-obsessed editor to take over the production *and* posting side of my pipeline so I can focus on strategy and product research. This is a long-term role with room to grow as output scales. You will **not** need to come up with ideas or do research — I provide the raw assets and an exact formula. Your job is to execute it consistently and catch mistakes before they go live. ## What you'll do (daily) - Turn provided reference images into short video clips using **Veo**, with the exact prompt I supply (and a second supplied prompt when a video needs two clips) — no creative prompting required, just careful, consistent execution - Assemble the resulting clips into finished videos directly inside the TikTok app's native editor (so the content looks native to the platform) - Add text overlays following an exact format (word-by-word captions, specific font / stroke / position — full SOP provided) - Add trending native sounds, relevant hashtags, and TikTok's in-app tagging / product tagging as part of each post - Run each video through a compliance checklist before it's approved — **this is the most important part of the job** - Publish each approved video to the account using TikTok's native scheduler - Log performance data into a tracking sheet Target output is around **30 finished videos per day** once you're fully up to speed. You'll start with a smaller batch during training and scale up steadily as you get faster with the formula. ## You must have - Hands-on experience editing **and posting** inside the TikTok app (native editor, captions, text, sounds, hashtags, scheduling) — this is non-negotiable, it's where you'll work all day - Excellent written English — on-screen text must be perfect, with no typos or awkward phrasing - Sharp attention to detail and the discipline to follow rules exactly, even when it's repetitive - Reliability and consistent daily availability - Both a **computer** (for generating clips in Veo) and a **smartphone that runs the TikTok app smoothly** — you'll switch between the two daily — plus a stable internet connection - Availability across a consistent daily schedule; you can work in your own timezone since posts are scheduled, not published live in the ---------- nt ## Nice to have - Experience with TikTok Shop / affiliate or e-commerce content - Familiarity with AI video tools like Veo or Kling — a plus, not a must, since I supply the exact prompts ## The way I work There are hard content rules that protect the accounts. Breaking one can get content taken down or the account penalized. I care far more about someone who follows the rules carefully and flags problems than someone who is fast but sloppy. You won't be thrown in the deep end — I provide full step-by-step training and clear written SOPs so you know exactly how I want everything done. There is a **paid trial period** before any long-term commitment so we can both make sure it's a good fit. ## Pay and bonuses Base pay starts at **$500/month** during the trial and early weeks, rising to **$650/month** once you're consistently producing at full volume with a clean track record. On top of that, there are **performance bonuses** when the accounts hit weekly revenue milestones — when the operation does well, you do well. The full bonus structure is shared once you're onboarded. ## How to apply Read this carefully — applications that don't follow these steps will be ignored: 1. Start your message with the word **GREENHOUSE** so I know you read the full post. 2. In 2-3 sentences, describe your experience editing video inside the TikTok app and the kind of videos you've made. 3. Answer this: I send you a finished video and tell you to post it, but you notice the on-screen text shows an exact price that I've told you we are never allowed to display. What do you do? 4. (Optional) Link to a sample of short-form video work you've edited. I read every application that follows these steps and reply to the strong ones quickly.

The brief A growing Australian digital marketing agency is hiring a full-time Digital Marketing Campaign Manager to join the team remotely from the Philippines. You plan the campaign, execute across paid and organic channels, report what worked and what didn't, and talk the client through it — calmly, in clear English, on camera. The team you'll work with You'll sit alongside the agency director (who handles sales and overall direction), the agency's design team (creative and ad assets), the build team (web and tech), and a small group of specialist partners. Develop integrated campaign plans spanning SEO, Google Ads, email , and social — paid and organic, across Facebook , Instagram, LinkedIn and other channels. Set up, monitor, and optimise Google Ads — keyword research, ad copy, audience targeting, bid management. Manage social media accounts — organic posting, community engagement, and paid execution across Meta and LinkedIn. Track performance live and adjust based on data, not on quarterly reviews. Flag what isn't working early and propose the change. 04 — Client engagement. Join discovery calls and ongoing client meetings alongside the agency director. Help prepare strategy presentations and campaign proposals for new and existing clients. Walk clients through progress, insights, and recommendations — clearly, in writing and on video. Handle questions and pushback without losing the room. Be the trusted face of the agency on the campaigns you run. Essential 5+ years hands-on digital marketing experience, preferably in an agency managing multiple client accounts. Excellent spoken and written English — you'll be on video calls with Australian SME owners and senior marketers, presenting strategy and walking through results. Proven ability to plan and execute integrated campaigns across SEO, Google Ads, and social (paid and organic). Strong working knowledge of: Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, SEMrush or Ahrefs, Meta Ads Manager, and social scheduling tools. Track record of building campaign plans that articulate strategy, rationale, channels, and expected outcomes. Experience translating competitor analysis into actionable campaign moves. Self-motivated and able to work independently without close supervision. Reliable home internet and a dedicated, professional home workspace. Nice to have (not required) Marketing copywriting — taglines, calls to action, ad copy, social captions. Familiarity with WordPress for blog posting and basic content updates. Canva or similar for social media graphics. Email marketing platforms and campaign execution. Meta advertising compliance, including 18+ ad categories. Comfort contributing to client-facing meetings and presenting strategy. Out of scope Graphic design specialism — the agency has a design team. Sales and new-business development — the agency director handles client acquisition. Production-level web development — handled by the build team. Who you are You're a strategist who also ships. You can sit on a discovery call with an Australian SME owner, draw the goal out of them, and walk out with a campaign plan you can defend. You like the discipline of Looker Studio more than the noise of vanity metrics. You're comfortable on camera — you can hold the room when a client pushes back, concede what should be conceded, and defend what shouldn't. description: About Us: We are a premium, US-based women's supplement brand. Our brand voice is warm, intelligent, and deeply grounded. Your primary goal is to build natural, authentic account histories so they look like real US-based women in their 40s and 50s. Once warmed up, you will subtly mention our brand in highly specific conversations. This is NOT a generic spamming job. Reddit hates marketing. Success in this role means being a "stealth" community member who provides genuine value. What You Will Do: * Manage a few Reddit accounts using anti-detect browsers and proxies to ensure no overlapping IP footprints. * Daily karma farming in non-health subreddits to build realistic account histories. * Scrape target subreddits daily for keywords like "3 AM waking," "brain fog," and "wired but tired." Write highly authentic, conversational comments that sound like an American woman in her mid-40s. Requirements: * Fluent, native-sounding written American English. * Experience managing multiple Reddit accounts without getting shadowbanned. * Understanding of proxies, unique browser fingerprints, and Reddit anti-spam triggers. * Ability to adapt to a strict brand voice (no hype, no medical claims, no generic marketing speak). Our Hiring Process: We value your time and transparency. Here is our exact process: 1. Apply: Answer the 3 screener questions below. 2. Short Trial Task: Shortlisted candidates will be given a quick, 2-part test to show off their Reddit research and writing skills. 3. Quick Interview: A 15-minute video call to ensure we are a good fit and discuss the final workflow. To Apply, please answer the 3 questions below. 1. If I ask you to manage 5 Reddit accounts from your computer in the Philippines, exactly what tools and setup will you use to ensure Reddit does not realize they are all run by the same person? 2. A user in r/workingmoms posts: "I'm 44 and I feel like I'm losing my mind. I'm snapping at my kids over nothing and have zero patience lately. Is this just burnout?" Write a natural, empathetic reply that subtly recommends a fake herbal supplement called "ZenRoots." Your goal is to sound like a helpful peer, not a marketer. 3. Please share links or screenshots of Reddit accounts you have warmed up/managed, or specific examples of high-performing posts/comments you have written.

job_title: Full-Stack Developer — Ventured Hub App & GoHighLevel Integration
description: Purpose of the Role Ventured Business Hub is a boutique agency that helps small business owners grow through virtual assistance, systems, and strategy. We have been building Ventured Hub — a custom web application designed to replace our current ClickUp setup and become the central operating system for our team and clients. The application is approximately 70% complete, with the core look, structure, and key functionality already in place. This role exists to get it across the finish line. The developer in this role will take ownership of an existing, partially built codebase and complete the remaining features, fix outstanding issues, and optimise performance and usability so the application is ready for daily use by our team. Critically, they will also be responsible for ensuring that Ventured Hub integrates seamlessly with GoHighLevel (GHL) — our CRM and marketing automation platform — so that client data, leads, and workflows flow between both systems without duplication or manual effort. This is a focused, time-bound engagement with a clear goal: a polished, fully functional application delivered within 2–3 weeks. It suits a developer who is confident jumping into an existing codebase, can quickly identify what needs to be done, and delivers clean, working code without needing hand-holding. Background: Where the App Is Now Ventured Hub is a React + Node.js web application built on the following stack: Frontend: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui Backend: Express 4, tRPC 11 Database: MySQL (via Drizzle ORM) Auth: Manus OAuth Hosting: Manus platform (cloud-deployed) can change if required The application is approximately 70% complete. The overall design direction, layout, navigation structure, and core UI components are in place. The remaining work falls into three buckets: 1. Feature completion — several features are partially built or stubbed out and need to be finished to a production-ready standard. This includes the time tracking system, timesheet view, client management structure, and task detail interactions. 2. Optimisation and polish — existing features need performance review, UX refinement, and edge-case handling. The app should feel fast, reliable, and intuitive for a small team using it daily. 3. GoHighLevel integration — the application needs to connect to our GoHighLevel CRM to: Sync client contact records between GHL and Ventured Hub Trigger GHL automations when task statuses change (e.g. when a client project moves to “Complete”, fire a GHL follow-up sequence) Pull lead pipeline data from GHL into Ventured Hub dashboards Optionally: create GHL contacts or update opportunity stages from within Ventured Hub A detailed gap analysis report (comparing our current ClickUp setup to the planned Ventured Hub feature set) and access to the existing codebase are available for shortlisted candidates. Key Responsibilities This is a completion and optimisation engagement, not a greenfield build. The developer will: -Review and onboard quickly. -Spend the first 1–2 days reviewing the existing codebase, identifying what is complete, what is partially built, and what is missing. -Deliver a short written assessment of the remaining work and a proposed completion schedule before starting any code changes. Complete the remaining features. Finish all partially built features to a production-ready standard. Priority areas include: the time tracking and timesheet system (per-task timer, weekly grid, approval workflow), the client management structure (client records, Ongoing Clients / Build Clients views), the Kanban board view, and task detail interactions (subtasks, checklists, attachments, comments, activity log). Optimise existing functionality. Review the completed portions of the app for performance, UX consistency, and edge-case handling. Fix bugs, improve loading states, and ensure the app feels polished and reliable under real daily use. Build the GoHighLevel integration. Design and implement the GHL integration layer: contact sync between GHL and the Ventured Hub database, webhook handling for status-triggered automations, lead pipeline data pull into dashboards, and (optionally) bidirectional opportunity stage updates. Document the integration architecture clearly so it can be maintained and extended after handover. Hand over cleanly. Deliver a brief handover document covering what was built, how the GHL integration works, any known limitations, and recommended next steps. Ensure all backend procedures have Vitest unit tests and the README is current. Communication throughout the engagement should be proactive — a brief daily or every-otherday update via message, and a short video check-in with Paige at the midpoint and on completion. Essential Skills and Qualifications The following are non-negotiable requirements for this role: Technical Minimum 2 years of professional experience building full-stack web applications Proficiency in React (hooks, context, component architecture) and TypeScript Experience with Node.js and REST or RPC-style APIs (tRPC experience is a strong plus) Solid understanding of relational databases and ORM tools (MySQL, Drizzle, Prisma, or similar) Experience integrating third-party APIs via webhooks and REST (GoHighLevel API experience is a strong plus; CRM integration experience is acceptable) Ability to read and extend an existing codebase without breaking existing functionality Familiarity with Git, pull requests, and collaborative development workflows GoHighLevel Specific Working knowledge of the GoHighLevel platform — understanding of contacts, pipelines, automations, workflows, and sub-accounts Experience using the GHL API or webhooks to build integrations (or demonstrated ability to learn quickly from API documentation) Understanding of how GHL automations trigger and how to design integration logic that does not create duplicate records or infinite loops Soft Skills Strong written English communication (all async communication is in English) Ability to work independently, manage your own time, and flag blockers proactively Comfortable asking clarifying questions rather than making assumptions Detail-oriented — our clients rely on accurate time tracking and task data Preferred Skills The following skills are not required but would set a candidate apart: Prior experience building task management or project management tools Experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component libraries Familiarity with Drizzle ORM and schema-first database workflows Experience with ClickUp API or migrating data from ClickUp Experience building approval workflows or multi-step state machines Knowledge of Australian business context or experience working with Australian clients If you have got this far, thank you. As part of your submissions, the first word is to be Stacked (just to ensure you have read the whole instructions), als ensure that the writing is in Aus english. This role involves working closely with patients enrolled in Chronic Care Management (CCM), Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), and Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) programs. Position Responsibilities: Complete comprehensive monthly CCM calls with patients to review symptoms, medications, appointments, barriers to care, and overall health concerns. Support patients enrolled in RPM by reviewing vitals, clearing alerts, following up on abnormal readings, and encouraging patients to submit readings consistently. RPM — Remote Patient Monitoring: Monitoring patients’ home health readings such as blood pressure, blood sugar, weight, pulse, or oxygen levels and following up when readings are abnormal. BHI — Behavioral Health Integration: Supporting patients with mental health or emotional wellness needs by completing check-ins, identifying concerns, and helping connect them with appropriate care. Requirements: Medical Assistant experience preferred. Strong phone communication skills. Excellent documentation skills. Must be reliable, punctual, and able to work independently. Must be compassionate, patient-centered, and professional. Experience with CCM, RPM, BHI, EMR systems, or remote healthcare is a plus. title: SENIOR MSP ENGINEER  - Microsoft 365 Projects and Service Escalations
job_title: SENIOR MSP ENGINEER  - Microsoft 365 Projects and Service Escalations
description: ============================================================ SENIOR MSP ENGINEER Microsoft 365 Projects and Service Escalations ============================================================ We're a small MSP based in Colorado. 26 clients, mostly in healthcare, manufacturing, and compliance focused companies who rely on us as their full IT department. Five people on the team. We're growing and we're looking for a senior MSP engineer who can own project execution from scoping through delivery, and who's ready to step in on the tougher escalations when the team needs you. This is a senior role. It is not helpdesk and it is not entry level. We're looking for someone who can take a project scope, think through the best approach, write a clear project plan, and run with it. Onboard a new client into our full service stack. Configure a Fortinet firewall remotely while a local tech racks the hardware. Harden a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Document everything thoroughly so the next person doesn't have to start from scratch. Most of your week is project work. A real part of it is spent with the team on the service board, taking the escalations that need an experienced hand and jumping in on tickets where you can help. We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys both. You like the focus and ownership of running a project from scope to delivery, and you also like being part of a team, talking problems through together, and being the person others can lean on when something tricky comes in. If you get satisfaction from variety and from being useful to the people around you, this rhythm will suit you well. We value first principles thinking and expert troubleshooting. When you hit a situation you haven't seen before, we expect you to research it, reason through it, suggest your approach, and execute once we align. You'll be solving real problems across a diverse client base, and no two weeks look the same. You'll report to our Service Delivery Manager. As we get to know your work and communication, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility over time. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING ------------------------------------------------------------ -  Project planning and execution. Taking a scope of work, writing a clear plan, and delivering it with minimal oversight. This is the heart of the role. -  Full client onboardings: RMM deployment, M365 tenant baselining, security hardening, service stack tooling, documentation buildout. -  Microsoft 365 security and identity work: conditional access policies, Entra ID configuration, compliance policies, DLP, MFA. -  Remote network and firewall configuration: IP schema design, VLANs, security policies, VPN setup. Fortinet or UniFi experience is ideal. -  Migration projects: tenant to tenant, Google to M365, IMAP, SharePoint, and on premises Active Directory to Entra ID. -  Intune and endpoint management: enrollment, compliance policies, app deployment, Autopilot. Migrating endpoints from RMM only management to Intune managed. Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS environments. -  Automation and scripting. Building and maintaining scripts to streamline internal processes and client environments. You'll also work with AI development tools on internal systems projects. -  Escalations. During Mountain Time hours, picking up the harder service board issues and jumping in on tickets when the team needs an experienced hand. -  Documentation of everything you touch in our internal knowledge base. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ------------------------------------------------------------ -  Someone genuinely strong on both sides. Deep in Microsoft 365 security and identity, and just as comfortable designing and configuring networks and firewalls. That combination is what makes someone effective across our client base, and it's exactly what we're after. -  3 to 5 years in an MSP environment. You've managed multiple client tenants at once, worked within a PSA and ticketing system, and you understand the pace and context switching that comes with supporting a diverse client base. -  A strong project planner. You can take a scope, map out the approach, and write a plan someone else could follow. You execute it, flag blockers, and submit milestones for review without being managed step by step. -  Someone who likes the variety. You enjoy the focus of owning a project, and you also enjoy being part of the team, jumping onto the service board, working through a tricky ticket, and being the person others turn to when they are stuck. For the right person, the mix is the best part of the role. -  Deep Microsoft 365 administration and security experience. Not just mailbox management. We mean conditional access, Entra ID, identity governance, compliance policies. -  Real Intune proficiency: enrollment, compliance baselines, app deployment, Autopilot. Comfortable migrating endpoints from RMM only management into Intune managed environments. -  Cybersecurity proficiency. You understand conditional access policy design, security baselines, MFA enforcement, and identity protection. Experience with HIPAA, SOC 2, or other compliance frameworks is important. We serve regulated industries and our clients depend on us to get this right. -  Automation and scripting experience. PowerShell, bash, or similar. You look for ways to automate repetitive work in tools like your RMM, PSA, or other platform APIs. Experience with AI coding tools or workflow automation platforms is a strong plus. -  Solid networking fundamentals with hands on firewall configuration experience. Fortinet or UniFi preferred, others considered. -  Migration experience across different scenarios (tenant to tenant, Google Workspace, IMAP, on premises Active Directory to Entra ID). -  Strong documentation habits. If you didn't document it, it didn't happen. -  Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be communicating with tea ---------- mbers in the US in Teams throughout the day and occasionally joining client calls. -  First principles thinker. When something breaks or a project takes an unexpected turn, you research, reason through it, and come back with a recommended path forward. -  Self directed. You'll receive a scope of work and we trust you to execute it. ------------------------------------------------------------ CERTIFICATIONS ------------------------------------------------------------ We require Microsoft SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator) and MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), or a genuine willingness to earn them within your first six months. We cover the exam fees and study materials. If you already hold either or both, that puts you ahead. ------------------------------------------------------------ NICE TO HAVE ------------------------------------------------------------ -  Experience with any of our toolstack: NinjaRMM, HaloPSA, Huntress, ImmyBot, CIPP, Hudu. -  Apple Business Manager and MDM experience for macOS endpoint management. -  Fortinet NSE or Unifi certification or equivalent. -  Experience with AI coding tools, workflow automation or building internal tooling. We're an AI forward team and actively building in this space. - Present and committed. You work Mountain Time business hours, 8:30 to 5:30, and this is your only job. Once you're well established with us and as the team grows, there may be room to talk about adjusting your hours. ------------------------------------------------------------ WHAT WE OFFER ------------------------------------------------------------ -  Full time remote work. -  Competitive pay with permanent increases tied to certifications earned. -  Interesting project work across a diverse client base. -  A team that communicates well and trusts you to own your work. ------------------------------------------------------------ HOW TO APPLY ------------------------------------------------------------ We're hiring immediately and will begin interviews within days of posting. To be considered, please include BOTH your resume and a short video (5 to 8 minutes). In the video, pick one of the prompts below and walk us through your approach, using a real example from your experience where you can. We care most about how you think and how you approach a problem, so talk us through it the way you would in a tea ---------- eting with your peers. 1.  A client is moving about 50 people onto Microsoft 365, coming from Google Workspace or another platform. This is a comprehensive move covering files, email , identity, and endpoints. We are most interested in the order you would run it and why. Where do you slot the files into SharePoint, the identity setup in Entra, the endpoints into Intune, and the email cutover itself, and what makes you put them in that sequence? Point out the gotchas along the way too, the things you have learned to be careful about. If you have run a migration like this, walk us through how you actually approached it. 2.  A client needs a firewall configured remotely, Fortinet or UniFi. A local tech will rack it and give you access. Walk us through how you would plan the deployment: IP schema, VLANs, security policies, and what you would document when you are done. What is the part of a remote deployment like this that you are most careful about, and why? 3.  You are hardening a Microsoft 365 tenant for a client pursuing SOC 2 compliance. Which conditional access policies do you put in place first, and why in that order? If you have done this for a real client, walk us through how you approached it. ============================================================

title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description: Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. This role is for that special person who wants to become truly exceptional. If that’s you, you already know this message is your signal. What You Get If You Win Here - High autonomy: once you’re ramped, you own your queue, schedule, and methods as long as the KPIs are hit. Lots of freedom to figure it out, great for someone that loves building with Legos - Direct proximity to leadership: you work daily with the Ops Manager on the most important projects in the company. - Clear advancement path: your growth is tied to visible numbers (tasks shipped, zero-miss cadence, freed founder/ops time, profit/leading metrics), not politics. - Insane skill growth: the pace and standards here mean every 12 months with us will feel like 3 years of experience in a normal VA/ops role. You can leapfrog your friends. If you join this will change your life. You will work harder than you’ve ever worked before and grow faster than you’ve ever grown before. - Comic Books!: you’re not just pushing random SaaS tickets; you’re inside a real comic book store seeing rare old comic books, private deals, and the business behind the Hollywood Marvel Movies that everyone loves! If you’re that person who enjoys working really hard to the point that it takes 2-3 people to do what you did listen up: Our tasks in asana for projects and ongoing operations are moving at a snail’s pace. Ops Manager + CEO is chasing tasks, slack policing, cleaning up Asana, and re-explaining context instead of focusing on their jobs. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.” Who This Is NOT For You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence. You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/ You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side. You are mass applying to dozens of jobs and just want to see who bites first. Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs. You hate corporate BS– endless meetings, vague goals, and politics – and would rather be rewarded for what you actually create. You’re happy to grind 50–60 hours/week no issues. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth (All of this is written into your contract.) Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial • $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit. • No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors. Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside • Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward. • On top of base, you can earn: $400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them). $1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard. • In practice, that means: Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture. Training & Growth Investment (on top of pay) We actively invest in making you a sharper teammate. Over time, we’ll put thousands of dollars into your development (courses, coaching, playbooks, and tools) that we choose together based on what will make you more effective in this seat. We also protect uninterrupted deep work blocks for you every week (no rando ---------- etings, no Slack spam). You’re paid to ship outcomes, not sit in back to back Zoom calls. Important: This is an ON FIELD role. You will not have a team under you to delegate to. 95% of your time is doing the work yourself, 5% is light coordination. If your default mode is to make plans and pass tasks to others, this will be a bad fit. Compensation here is performance based. Raises are earned through clearly exceeding KPIs and demonstrating core values consistently. If you want “stability” to mean “I can coast and still get raises,” this won’t feel stable. If you want stability to mean “the better I get, the more valuable and secure I become,” you’ll like it here. How To Apply (24-Hour Test) Our Hiring Process (So There Are No Surprises) If your 24 hour answers impress us, the next steps are: A short interview focused on your past execution. A live 60 minute work trial inside our real tools where you’ll work directly with the Ops Manager. We do this because talk is cheap. If you don’t like being tested on real work before getting hired, this won’t be a fit. Do NOT click quick-apply. In the next 24 hours, you must: Reply with answers to ALL of these (short but specific; bullets are fine): Q1: Describe the most complex project you personally drove fro ---------- ssy start to completion where you did most of the execution yourself, not just assigning tasks. Include at least one example of how you set your own deadlines and moved forward when other people were slow to respond.” Q2: Share 3 links or screenshots (Google Docs, Sheets, Asana boards, trackers, automations, etc.) that you built yourself which show how you organize and drive work. Briefly explain each. Q3: You have 30 tasks due this week and realize you’ll miss 5. Walk me through, step-by-step, how you handle it with your manager and stakeholders. Q4:  Below are 6 messy “tasks” we actually see (all dumped into one list): – “Fix Asana, it’s a mess” – “Seller lead texting follow up??” – “Finance com/projections cadence d2 ” – “Inventory backlog insane” – “Need better reporting” – “Update SOPs In this role you will NOT have anyone to delegate to assume it’s just you and the Ops Manager. In a Google Doc, please: Rewrite these into clear tasks with: Owner (you or Ops Manager), Due Date (next 7–30 days), and a concrete Done Check + proof required. “Write your task descriptions as if you are committing: ‘I will do X by Y time. If Z doesn’t happen by [time], here’s my fallback.’ Generic ‘follow up / request access’ answers will fail you.” Put them in the order you’d actually do them and explain why in 3–5 bullet points. Link the Google Doc here (view access). Spend no more than 30–45 minutes. If you can’t figure this out on your own, this role will be too hard in real life – that’s okay, just skip applying. Attach your PDF resume/Google Drive link.

title: Recruiter Manager-Manage a High Volume Recruiting Team for USA Projects
job_title: Recruiter Manager-Manage a High Volume Recruiting Team for USA Projects
description: Position: Recruiter Manager-Manage a High Volume Recruiting Team for USA Projects You must be a highly experienced Recruiting Manager experienced in hiring, training and managing a team of expert US experienced recruiters specialized with reviewing a high volume of resumes daily spanning 7 days per week 14 hours per day. Average volume of resumes that are currently being reviewed ranges from 400 to 600 per day which will increase to 750 to 1250 per day. In addition to resume reviewing are our Job Ad Team who create post and manage from 1,000 to 1,200 job ads currently which will increase to 1,750 to 2,500 job ads within 6 months and much higher volume within 1 year. Your schedule will need to be flexible during EST hours Monday to Friday and some hours may be required to monitor or in some instances fill in for a recruiter that is not available to provide service on a weekend day. Responsibilities: • Review and Quality Control all resumes being reviewed daily for approval and make necessary corrections and train team • Monitor Daily KPI's for resumes being reviewed and Job ads being created and posted • Consistently maintain a high level of motivation and culture on a daily basis for the team • Collaborate with management team to ensure alignment between job requirements and daily priorities • Conduct research for better software, technology, services and methods of improving and streamlining operations. • Hire, train and add on addition team recruiters to continue growing the department on an as needed basis • Create various reports on a daily basis for review with Management If you feel you are qualified for this management role, please apply for this position, we look forward to hearing from you if you are, thank you! Here is more detailed info for the ad creator poster and the resumes reviewers that we use to explain the positions so you will have a better idea if this role is for you! NOTE: Please keep in mind that you must be highly experienced with US Recruiting including hiring training and managing High Volume US recruiting experts. Here is some details for the roles you would be managing: PHONE SCREENERS-We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and proactive Resume Screener to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for reviewing and evaluating ---------- incoming resumes everyday for a variety of job positions. Your primary task will be to qualify or disqualify candidates based on their prior experience, answers to questions, location, and skill sets that align with employers' needs. This position requires someone with strong attention to detail, a keen eye for spotting key qualifications, and the ability to work efficiently in a very high-volume, fast-paced environment. IMPORTANT: Please let us know how many years of experience you have reviewing US candidate resumes and if you have the experience to review 300 to 500 resumes per day accurately......Please list these details in your response...Thank you! Responsibilities: • Review and assess incoming resumes to ensure alignment with job requirements. • Evaluate candidates based on their experience, answers to questions, location, and relevant skills • Consistently maintain a high level of accuracy in identifying qualified applicants. • Collaborate with hiring teams to ensure alignment between job requirements and candidate profiles. • Manage a high volume of resumes while ensuring quality and consistency in evaluations. Requirements: **CANDIDATE NEEDS TO BE 100% FLUENT IN SPEAKING, READING AND WRITING ENGLISH** • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot key qualifications quickly. • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of resumes. • Ability to work efficiently and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal. • Previous experience in resume screening or recruitment in the US is a MUST • Able to work 6 days per week during EST/eastern standard time hours • Proficiency in Job Websites such as ZipRecruiter, Indeed, etc. JOB AD CREATOR -Job Ad Creator (MUST be an Expert navigating and posting ads on Indeed)-We are seeking an expert recruiting professional not to recruit but to focus 100% on Developing effective job ad copy to maximize quality and quantity of applying candidates. You must really be an expert at creating compelling job ads and have a vast amount of experience working with and positing on the job boards and social media. You will be creating new fresh and compelling job ads daily and manage over 2,000 live job ads posted on all the major job boards including social media platforms. You will be responsible for creating and developing engaging job ad campaigns and content on major job boards and social media. We are seeking a highly detail-oriented creative writing professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for writing compelling self- created ads for various job board websites. Your primary task will be to self- create new fresh compelling ad copy daily (Not looking for an AI Copy Cat) You will need to always be analyzing the market and geographical areas ads are being posted in so you can create ads that will attract high quality and high quantity of candidates for all types of positions. description: #About Us We are a technology-driven real estate investment company buying homes directly from property owners. Performance Targets After training, we expect consistent daily activity and quality conversations, including: * 300–600 outbound dials per day, depending on dialer setup and list quality * 10–25 real homeowner conversations per day * 3–8 qualified seller leads per week * 1–4 qualified appointments per week * Clean CRM notes and accurate follow-up tasks * Daily end-of-shift reporting We care about real seller conversations and qualified opportunities, not just dialing numbers. ## What We’re Looking For * At least 1 year of U.S. real estate cold calling experience * Experience calling homeowners such as absentee owners, expired listings, FSBOs, probate, pre-foreclosure, tired landlords, or similar lists * Clear, confident spoken English * Comfortable making outbound calls every day * Experience using a dialer and real estate CRM * Strong listening and note-taking skills * Ability to follow a call structure while still sounding conversational * Reliable computer or laptop * Noise-cancelling headset * Stable high-speed internet * Quiet workspace * Availability during U.S. business hours in Eastern Time ## Helpful Experience Experience with any of the following is a plus: * Real estate wholesaling or investor lead generation * GoHighLevel, REsimpli, Podio, Follow Up Boss, Mojo Dialer, BatchDialer, ReadyMode, CallTools, or similar tools * SMS or email follow-up * Appointment setting for real estate acquisitions teams ## Compensation * Starting pay: $4/hour for the first 60 days * After 60 days, pay may increase to $5/hour based on reliability, call quality, CRM accuracy, and performance * After 6 months, pay may increase to $6/hour based on proven performance * $20 bonus per qualified appointment set * $250 bonus per closed deal from a lead you generated * Additional bonuses may be available for consistent appointment setting and strong lead quality ## Please Do Not Apply If * You have never cold called U.S. homeowners * Your only experience is general VA, customer service, or basic appointment setting * You are not comfortable making outbound calls daily * You cannot work during U.S. business hours in Eastern Time * You have no experience using a real estate CRM or dialer * You are not comfortable doing a live cold call role-play during the interview process * You cannot provide voice recordings with your application ## How to Apply Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Voice Recording #2: 1–2 minute introduction covering your background, real estate cold calling experience, motivation, and how you handle rejection. 6. Cold calling performance history: daily call volume, conversations per day, qualified leads per week, appointments set per week, and list types you have called before. 7. Dialers and CRMs you have used. 8. Available working hours in Eastern Time. 9. Minimum hourly rate and target monthly earnings with bonuses.
