description: Technical Lead / Software Architect Real Estate Data, CRM & AI Automation Platform Remote | Contract, Part-Time, or Full-Time Preferred Regions: Ukraine, Eastern Europe, India, Philippines, Vietnam, or other experienced remote development markets Time Zone Requirement: Must have regular overlap with U.S. Eastern Time About the Company We are building a real estate data and lead generation platform for internal business use. The platform will combine property records, owner information, contact data, CRM history, public data sources, lead scoring, campaign workflows, and AI-assisted recommendations into one centralized operating system. The purpose of the platform is to help identify real estate opportunities, organize leads, prioritize follow-up, support outreach campaigns, and track business outcomes across multiple real estate-related services. This is not a basic website or a simple chatbot. This is a data-driven internal software platform with CRM, dashboard, automation, and AI components. We are looking for a Technical Lead / Software Architect who can help turn the business requirements into a practical, scalable technical plan and guide the development team through the first MVP and future phases. Platform Overview The platform will support several real estate business workflows, including: Property acquisition leads Off-market owner opportunities Distressed property leads Rental and leasing opportunities Property management opportunities Renovation and repair opportunities Insurance-related property events Financing and loan opportunities Legal and public-record-driven opportunities The system will collect and organize property and owner data, classify leads into the correct business category, score opportunities, display them in a dashboard, support CRM follow-up, and eventually power AI-assisted workflows. Role Overview We are hiring a Technical Lead / Software Architect to help design the foundation of the platform and oversee the technical direction of development. This person will work closely with the founder and development team to define the architecture, database structure, backend APIs, frontend requirements, AI integration plan, development roadmap, and engineering workflow. The right candidate should be able to understand both technical systems and business workflows. We need someone who can take a large product vision and break it into a practical, organized MVP that can be built, tested, and improved. This role may begin as part-time or contract-based, with the possibility of becoming a long-term leadership role. Key Responsibilities Translate business requirements into technical architecture Define the MVP scope and development priorities Design the database structure for properties, owners, contacts, CRM activity, source tracking, lead categories, and opportunity scoring Define backend API requirements Plan the frontend dashboard structure Design the AI assistant integration approach Help select the appropriate technology stack Create a 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day technical roadmap Break development into clear tasks for frontend, backend, data, and AI developers Review code, architecture decisions, and database design Set up or improve GitHub workflow, branches, pull requests, and development standards Help evaluate developers and review paid test tasks Prevent disconnected development between frontend, backend, data, and AI components Identify technical risks early Help d ---------- what should be built now versus later Communicate clearly with a non-technical founder Core Modules to Architect The initial platform will include: 1. Data Management Import real estate data from CSV, Excel, APIs, and future public data sources Clean and normalize property, owner, company, contact, and CRM data Track the source of each record Support deduplication and relationship mapping 2. Property & Owner Profiles Property detail pages Owner and company detail pages Contact information Related properties Public record indicators CRM history Notes, activity, and follow-up status 3. Lead Classification Assign properties and owners to relevant lead categories Support multiple opportunity types per property Create queues for different business workflows Track lead status and next action 4. Opportunity Scoring Score leads based on available data Consider motivation signals, urgency, property condition, public records, CRM activity, and estimated revenue potential Display clear reasoning behind scores 5. CRM & Campaign Workflow Track calls, SMS, email s, notes, and follow-ups Manage lead status Support campaign planning Prepare for future SMS, email , voi cemail , and calling integrations 6. AI Assistant Layer Generate property summaries Summarize owner and company information Review CRM history Recommend next actions Generate SMS, email , and call script drafts Explain why a lead may be an opportunity Highlight risks or missing information Use only available data and avoid unsupported assumptions 7. Dashboard & Reporting Dashboard overview Lead categories Lead sources Opportunity queues Recent alerts AI insights Revenue tracking Data quality reporting First MVP Goal The first MVP should prove the core workflow: Data Import ? Clean Database ? Property Profile ? Lead Category ? Opportunity Score ? Dashboard Queue ? AI Recommendation ? title: Bookkeeper — QuickBooks Online (Australian Tax & GST)
description: Cleanup, Restructure & Ongoing Bookkeeping  ·  Remote (Philippines) Long-term role with a family-run Queensland agribusiness Engagement Part-time, long-term — around 15-20 hours/week once established (more during the initial cleanup) Hours Flexible and deadline-based — we care that the work is done well and on time, not that you sit set hours each day Software QuickBooks Online (we are staying on QuickBooks — this is a QBO role) Reports to Business owner Start As soon as we find the right person About us We are a family-run agribusiness in rural Queensland, Australia, running several enterprises under one roof. Our main business is a paddock-to-plate meat operation selling premium Wagyu and grass-fed beef direct to customers at markets and online. Alongside this we run cattle, produce hay, do contract farm work, and make a natural tallow-based skincare range. We need one reliable, long-term person to take ownership of our bookkeeping so we can focus on running the business. The role We have used QuickBooks for many years and have a lot of history in the file. We are staying on QuickBooks — we are NOT migrating to Xero. The first big job is a thorough cleanup and restructure of our existing QuickBooks Online file so that each of our enterprises reports clearly and our GST is correct. After that, you keep everything reconciled, accurately coded, and ready for our Business Activity Statements (BAS) and end-of-year tax. Important: BAS and tax documents are prepared by you and reviewed/lodged by the owner. You prepare; we review and lodge. What you will do • Clean up and restructure our existing QuickBooks Online file — review the chart of accounts, remove duplicates, fix inconsistent coding, and set up a clean, consistent structure (you would confirm the proposed structure with us before making major changes). • Set up each enterprise to report separately (meat, cattle, hay, contract work, skincare) using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations where helpful), so we can see income and expenses for each part of the business. • Process and reconcile all bank and credit card transactions across multiple accounts. • Handle Australian GST correctly. Most of our food/meat sales are GST-free, while many of our supplier purchases include GST that we can claim. You apply the right GST code to every transaction, and review and correct existing coding during the cleanup. • Prepare Business Activity Statements (BAS) and supporting documents for the owner to review and lodge. • Produce regular reports — profit & loss by enterprise, GST position, and cash position — so we can see how each part of the business is tracking. • Flag any errors, unusual transactions, or anything without supporting documentation, rather than guessing. We value someone who asks and flags rather than assumes. Must have • Solid hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online — including cleaning up and restructuring an established file, not just data entry. (This is essential. Please only apply if you are genuinely experienced in QuickBooks Online.) • Good understanding of Australian GST, including the difference between GST-free sales and GST-inclusive purchases, and BAS preparation. • Experience using QuickBooks Classes (and Locations) for separating and reporting on different parts of a business. • A bookkeeping or accounting qualification, with real experience keeping books for businesses. • Strong attention to detail and accuracy — this matters more to us than speed. • Reliable, responsive, and able to work independently to deadlines. Good written English, reliable internet, and your own computer. • Honesty and discretion handling confidential financial information. Nice to have • Experience with Australian clients and Australian BAS/tax. • Experience with multi-enterprise, farming, or primary-production accounts. • Payroll / STP experience. Why work with us • Long-term, stable role with room to grow your hours and responsibility. • Real ownership of the books — you run the system, not just data entry. • Flexible, deadline-based hours — we trust you to manage your own time and deliver. How to apply Applications that answer the questions below will be prioritised — it shows us you read the ad and helps us find the right person quickly. Please send: 1. Your CV / resume (pasted into your reply or attached through OnlineJobs.ph please — not a Google Drive link). 2. A short note on your QuickBooks Online experience — in particular, any file cleanups or restructures you’ve done. 3. Your experience with Australian GST and BAS. 4. Your hourly rate (in USD) and the hours per day you are available. And please answer these three quick questions in your application: • In QuickBooks Online, how would you set up the file so that income and expenses can be reported separately for several different parts of one business? • If a sale is GST-free but the supplier invoice for that product included GST, how do you treat each side in the books? • If you took over a messy QuickBooks file with duplicate accounts and inconsistent coding, how would you approach cleaning it up? Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task before we make an offer.

description: READ THIS FIRST I am hiring a few elite AI VSL editors, and I am ready to pay for real talent. If you are one of the best at editing and creating direct response Meta ads, keep reading. I am looking for the best, and I will pay accordingly. ------------------------------------------- THE ROLE IN ONE LINE I send you a script I wrote, a 60 second Loom, and sometimes a reference video. You go and build a finished direct response VSL that beats the reference and is ready to run with zero fixing fro ---------- . ------------------------------------------- WHO WE ARE We are the number one brand in our DTC product category and one of the biggest advertisers in our space. We are scaling fast and we need a small team of editors who can ship winning ads quickly and consistently. ------------------------------------------- THE STYLES YOU MUST BE ELITE AT This role is for specialists, not generalists. You must be excellent at at least one of these, and ideally all of them. The more of these you can do at a high level, the more I want you and the more I will pay you. - Voiceover b-roll style VSLs (our core format) - Clay style AI animation - Skeleton style AI animation - Pixar style AI animation If all you can do is basic talking-head cuts, this is not for you. ------------------------------------------- YOU PROMPT EVERYTHING YOURSELF You write your own prompts and you get elite results out of them. I am not going to prompt for you. I tell you "we need to make this," and you already know the software, the workflow, and how to prompt it to a high standard. - You prompt hyper realistic AI video yourself in Veo3, Grok, Kling, Seedance, and similar models, and you know which tool is best for which shot. - You prompt your own AI images so they look real, not like AI slop. - You prompt the best AI voices in ElevenLabs and build clean, real-sounding AI avatars in HeyGen, with lipsync that actually matches. - You are at the tip of the iceberg on current Meta ads formats and visuals, and you keep up as the tools change. ------------------------------------------- WHAT EVERY VIDEO YOU SHIP HAS You build scroll stopping VSLs, 3 to 10 minutes long, that feel like content and not like an ad. Every video has: - A hook in the first 3 seconds that stops the scroll, then a story and pacing that holds attention all the way to the offer. - High quality effects and edits, done cleanly, never cheap or overdone. - Strong scene selection. You know exactly which scenes to use for each part of the video and why, and what visual needs to be on screen at every ---------- nt to keep the customer watching. - Hyper realistic AI b-roll and images, AI avatars, and AI voices with real emotion. No robotic voices, no fake-looking visuals. - Clean, styled captions plus music and SFX that hit on the beats and lift the emotion. - Delivered ready to upload in the placements we run (typically 9:16 and 4:5), with everything burned in. ------------------------------------------- YOU UNDERSTAND THE CUSTOMER AND YOU HAVE TASTE - Once you know our target customer, you build the whole video to resonate with exactly that person, without being told how. You pick the avatar, the voice, the visuals, and the tone that match who we are selling to. If we are targeting older men, you instinctively choose an avatar, voice, and style that lands with older men. If we are targeting young women, you choose differently. You get it right because you actually understand the customer. - You know the difference between high quality visuals and bad AI slop, and you only ship the good stuff. You have real taste and you do not need me to tell you what looks good. ------------------------------------------- TRAINING (REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE) You have real training and a background from Ecom Talent or a similar ecommerce Meta ads editing course or community. This role is for people who have already put in the reps to learn these specific skills. ------------------------------------------- HOW FAST YOU NEED TO MOVE This is high volume. We push out a lot of concepts, so you need to turn around full VSLs quickly and consistently, e.g. 10 to 20 videos per week, full VSL within 24 to 48 hours. Fast execution at a high standard is the whole job. If you are slow or you need a lot of revisions to get it right, this is not the role for you. ------------------------------------------- PAY, BONUSES, AND GROWTH - Pay starts at $6 per finished video and increases to $8 as you prove your quality and speed. - If you are truly exceptional, one of the best at editing and creating these videos, I am willing to pay more. We will talk. - Cash bonuses on top when an ad you made wins and scales. - Full time, not part time, because of the volume needed. - Pay is sent every 2 weeks for the first month, then weekly from month 2. - After month 1, the best editor moves into a paid lead role building our SOPs and training a team of 5 to 10 editors, at significantly higher pay. ------------------------------------------- DO NOT APPLY IF - You are not an experienced direct response Meta ads editor. - You are a general video editor or a beginner. - You cannot prompt your own AI video, images, voices, and avatars to a high standard. - Your English is not strong. You need to speak and understand English clearly. I am not going back and forth dealing with miscommunication. ------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY (READ THIS CAREFULLY) Do not send me a resume or a profile. I want to see your actual best work with proof that you made it. Send your portfolio as one Google Doc (make sure commenter access is on) that shows and explains at least 5 of your best pieces in different styles. For example a voiceover b-roll VSL, a clay AI animation, a skeleton AI animation, a Pixar style AI animation, and an AI avatar ad, all for direct response Meta ads brands. Send what you personally believe is your best work, whether or not it was the best performing. I just want to see how good you actually are. At the bottom of that same doc, add your single highest performing Meta ads edit that you made yourself, with the result if you have it. Then send a 30 second Loom with your camera on, showing your face, telling me in clear English why I should hire you over everyone else, based on your specific skills. First come first served, and I am onboarding within 24 to 40 hours, so send it fast. Text me on WhatsApp at ---------- and start your message with the word CONVERT. Do NOT message me through OnlineJobs, there are too many messages there and yours will get lost. My name is Xanth.

description: College Career Pathways — College Counseling Practice Website Remote  •  Project-Based Overview We are looking for a skilled Webflow developer, website designer, and systems integrator to build a polished, professional website for College Career Pathways — a premium college counseling practice based in Katy, Texas. We help high school students and families navigate the college admissions process with personalized, organized, stress-reducing guidance. This is not a SaaS build. This is not a custom student portal. This is not a complicated software platform. We need a beautiful, modern, easy-to-edit marketing website that helps families understand our services, book consultations, sign up, and transition smoothly into our existing counseling workflow. HoneyBook handles our contracts, payments, scheduling, and onboarding. CounselMore handles our student counseling operations. The website connects everything in a clean, branded, seamless experience. The goal: Integration-ready, not custom-platform. We want a professional website that works well now, while keeping the structure clean enough to add deeper integrations later if needed. Do not build backend complexity. Do not recreate HoneyBook or CounselMore. Connect existing tools cleanly and leave clear pathways for future additions. How the Business Works — The Client Journey Understanding this flow is essential. The website must support every step of it: Parent finds ---------- ? AI chatbot answers initial questions and routes to booking — Tidio or Chatbase ? Books a free or paid intro consultation — HoneyBook scheduler ? Selects a service package ? Receives contract auto-populated with their details — HoneyBook ? E-signs contract and sets up payment plan — HoneyBook built-in payments ? Receives welcome email and onboarding instructions — HoneyBook automation ? Your job is to implement them well, not choose alternatives. Website + CMS Webflow — all public pages, CMS collections, and design Contracts + Payments HoneyBook — inquiry forms, proposals, contracts, e-signature, payment plans, onboarding automations Scheduling HoneyBook built-in scheduler, connected with Google Calendar where appropriate AI Chatbot Tidio or Chatbase (developer to evaluate and recommend — see chatbot section below) Counseling Portal CounselMore — linked from the site; stays separate at launch Calendar Google Calendar via HoneyBook calendar sync Analytics Google Analytics 4 + Google Search Console Email Google Workspace, already existing What We Are NOT Looking For Please do not propose any of the following. These decisions are already made. A custom SaaS platform A custom student or parent portal A custom CRM A custom payment system or payment plan builder A custom scheduling system A replacement for HoneyBook A replacement for CounselMore A custom backend or database unless there is a specific reason discussed and agreed upfront If your instinct is to build something custom that an existing tool already handles — that is not what this project needs. We want clean integrations with great tools, not reinvention. Website Pages The first version of the site should include the following pages. We are open to your recommendations on structure if you believe a different layout will convert better. We will provide core business information, service details, and draft copy. Client-Provided Footage If Leah has professional photos or video of her own, these should be prioritized over stock — authenticity converts better than stock imagery. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. EDITOR’S STORYBOARD – SAMPLE INTRO Video Theme: Feeling Stuck / Change the Pattern Character: Sunny the Stickman Simple but expressive stickman Round white head, black outline Big eyes / eyebrows for emotion Small hair tuft Hoodie-style torso Clean white or light simple backgrounds Smooth, simple animation style Keep visuals uncluttered and easy to follow SCENE 1 — HOOK Voiceover: “Do you ever feel stuck… like you know what you need to do, but somehow your brain starts doing everything except that?” Visual: Sunny sits at a desk staring at a simple to-do list. He looks frozen and confused. A thought bubble shows things pulling his attention everywhere except the task. Animation Notes: Sunny looks at task ? looks overwhelmed Eyes dart side to side Small “loading” expression on face On-Screen Text: FEELING STUCK? SCENE 2 — CHAOS STARTS Voiceover: “The kids are yelling.” Visual: Two simplified stick-figure kids appear in the background yelling or bouncing around while Sunny winces. Animation Notes: Kids flail arms Noise lines around them Sunny squeezes eyes shut On-Screen Text: “AHHH!” / “MOM!” / “DAD!” style comic bubbles SCENE 3 — EMAIL OVERLOAD Voiceover: ?? ?Email s are multiplying.” Visual: Sunny looks at a laptop or phone while email icons pop up rapidly and begin filling the screen. Animation Notes: Email icons multiply fast Sunny leans backward in panic One email lands on his face for humor On-Screen Text: +17 NEW EMAIL S SCENE 4 — TO-DO LIST JOKE Voiceover: “Your to-do list has a to-do list.” Visual: Sunny holds a long to-do list. Then a smaller to-do list unfolds from that list. Then another tiny one. Animation Notes: List keeps unfolding longer and longer Sunny’s eyes get wider each time Slight comedic pause On-Screen Text: TO-DO LIST then TO-DO LIST FOR YOUR TO-DO LIST SCENE 5 — BRAIN BUFFERING Voiceover: “Your brain is buffering like bad Wi-Fi…” Visual: Close-up of Sunny’s face. A spinning loading icon appears over his head. Maybe a tiny Wi-Fi symbol flickers from full bars to one bar. Animation Notes: Loading circle spins Sunny stares blankly Small glitch effect or blinking eyes On-Screen Text: BUFFERING… SCENE 6 — BODY SHUTDOWN Voiceover: “And your body is just sitting there like, ‘Yeah… I quit, I need a nap.’” Visual: Sunny slumps in a chair or melts onto a couch/floor. A tiny pillow or blanket appears for humor. Animation Notes: Body droops dramatically Eyes half closed Maybe tiny “zzz” appears On-Screen Text: I QUIT. or NEED A NAP. SCENE 7 — REFRAME Voiceover: “But here’s the truth: You’re not lazy. You’re overloaded.” Visual: Scene shifts calmer. Sunny stands in center. A red stamp saying “LAZY” appears, then gets crossed out. Then heavy boxes labeled “stress,” “noise,” “pressure,” and “overthinking” stack around him. Animation Notes: “LAZY” gets rejected Boxes pile up to show overload Sunny looks tired, not lazy On-Screen Text: NOT LAZY OVERLOADED SCENE 8 — WHAT STUCK REALLY IS Voiceover: “And feeling stuck usually isn’t your whole life falling apart.” Visual: Sunny imagines his whole life as a giant messy disaster cloud… Then the cloud shrinks smaller. Animation Notes: Start dramatic Then zoom out and simplify Sunny looks relieved On-Screen Text: IT’S NOT YOUR WHOLE LIFE SCENE 9 — PATTERN LOOP Voiceover: “It’s a few habits, thoughts, and fears running on repeat.” Visual: Sunny runs on a small treadmill or hamster wheel. Around him are looping icons: a fear cloud, negative thought bubble, habit arrows going in circles. Animation Notes: Repeating loop arrows Sunny keeps circling in place Show he’s stuck in a pattern, not broken On-Screen Text: HABITS THOUGHTS FEARS REPEAT SCENE 10 — CHANGE THE PATTERN Voiceover: “Change the pattern… and suddenly, you’re not stuck anymore.” Visual: Sunny reaches up and grabs one of the looping arrows, then snaps it or redirects it. Animation Notes: Loop breaks Scene brightens Sunny posture improves On-Screen Text: CHANGE THE PATTERN SCENE 11 — TURNING THE CORNER Voiceover: “You’re turning the corner.” Visual: Sunny literally walks around a corner from a darker side of the screen into a brighter side. Animation Notes: Dark to light transition Sunny steps forward with confidence Clean, satisfying motion On-Screen Text: TURN THE CORNER We appreciate the effort you put into your application. title: Operations & Project Manager (Fast Growing)
description: Operations Manager-Execution Partner-Project Killer-Fast-Growing Comic Book Company Own the operations backbone of a niche comic book brand, work directly with leadership, and get promoted fairly by numbers. We’ve had “pleasant” VAs who: Can’t drive tasks to completion independently Mark tasks complete with no proof Miss reports/skip cadence and require chasing. Drift on ownership, urgency & follow thru Need hand-holding I don’t need another task hopper. I need a project killer who comes into ambiguity, creates structure, drives tasks to completion, and actually frees the Ops Manager to focus on his key projects. If this works, his deep work hours and project output go up because you’re handling everything else. We will measure that and tie your promotions/raises to it. This is not for everyone. We’re looking for winners. What You’ll Actually Do You will be Ops Manager’s execution partner and force-multiplier. Concrete outputs: Own Asana: every task has an owner, due date, Done Check, and proof link when completed Maintain an active queue of 20+ meaningful tasks, prioritized against our key rocks (Marketing, Sales, Ongoing Operations, Cleanup, Admin) Ship 25+ tasks/week with proof, minimal rework, and zero “ghosted” items Proactively handle operational issues/fires in designated lanes Maintain Reporting at Set Cadence, Follow-up loops across projects Add leverage: plug AI into our workflows (Asana, docs, reports) to make us faster and cleaner without being asked We do NOT need more SOPS-although you might tighten them on the fly. We need someone to do the operations. If you want to sit and write playbooks all day, this is the wrong seat-that will be an earned responsibility later. If you aren’t ready to work hard daily do not apply. How We Set You Up To Win (First 90 Days) We don’t just throw you in the deep end. In your first 30 days, you’ll shadow the Ops Manager, learn our Asana + reporting systems, and get a clear scorecard so you always know what “great” looks like. By 30 days, you’ll own your own project lanes with weekly 1:1s for feedback, support, and removing blockers so you can move faster instead of guessing what we want. Real Growth Example One of our Filipino teammates started with us on basic execution work at ~$800/month. Over time, he took ownership of his queue, fixed broken processes, and became the person we trusted to “just handle it.” As his scope grew, so did his comp and stability. Now he makes ~$2,500/month (and we’re working on getting him even more) because he stuck with it and actually grew. A lot of people say they want that, but their resumes show 6–12 month hops. The pattern here is simple: prove you can own outcomes over time, and we grow your responsibilities, trust, and pay accordingly. Schedule, Hours & Time Zone (No Surprises) This is a full time, US hours role (roughly US Eastern business hours) with a true 50–60 hour workweek during this growth season. Expect most weeks to be closer to that 60 hour mark. If you want a strict 40 hour cap, this is the wrong seat; if you want a place where extra effort is noticed, measured, and rewarded, you’ll feel at home here. This is not just a job. This is a commitment. What Winning Looks Like By Day 30: Ops Manager is spending ~95% of his time on projects, not Slack/Asana/admin fires, because you’re handling those and executing projects alongside him. Profit and leading metrics are moving up faster because of you By 12 months: You are Ops Manager’s go to operator & on track to become Ops Manager. Nothing important moves in Ops without you knowing. You own the Asana board, key ops projects, and reporting cadence. You’re the person we trust to “just handle it,” and your comp reflects that increased ownership. If you become that go to operator, you’ll have real say in how we run Ops – you won’t just be ‘executing tickets,’ you’ll help design the system.” Who This Is NOT For You prefer to ‘coordinate’ and assign tasks to others instead of doing the work yourself with excellence. You want to manage people before you’ve truly proven you can personally execute at a high level. You want a chill, low-pressure 9–5 You need to be told what to do all day and hate being judged by objective numbers You mark tasks complete without proof or next steps You change jobs every 6–18 months and blame the company/manager/market/ You get defensive or freeze when given direct feedback or pressure You are currently juggling multiple full time clients and want to “squeeze us in” on the side. Who This IS For You’ve stayed 2–3+ years in at least one role and can prove outcomes You like pressure, highly competitive environments, being the one who “gets it done” when others stall You’ve built systems (trackers, automations, SOPs), not just followed them You are tech-comfortable: Asana (or similar), CRMs, zaps, AI tools, simple web/ops/marketing stacks You’re willing to bet on one company instead of juggling lots of smaller, easier gigs. We’re in a BIG growth & push season. It will be like this for the next year and then we’ll see. Everyone wants to grow a lot, but it’s actually happening here. Comp & Growth (All of this is written into your contract.) Months 1–3: Ramp / Trial • $800/month base, guaranteed, while you learn our systems and we test fit. • No bonus in this phase. You’re paid to prove you can hit the KPI floors. Month 4+ – Performance Based Upside • Base stays at $800 until you’ve hit KPI floors for 2 straight months. After that, base increases to $900/month going forward. • On top of base, you can earn: $400 bonus in months where you hit 3 out of 4 KPIs (with Output as one of them). $1,000 bonus in months where you hit 4 out of 4 KPIs on the weekly scorecard. • In practice, that means: Solid performance months ~$1,200–$1,300/month Killer months (4/4 KPIs)~$1,800–$1,900/month All bonuses are 100% KPI based  (shipped outcomes, taking load off the Ops Manager, zero CEO/manager rescues, tight open loops) and 4/5 culture. description: We are a U.S.-based performance growth partner working with home service companies. We scale our clients through paid acquisition, sales optimization, and full-funnel growth systems. We bring e-commerce-level marketing rigor into an industry that has been operating a decade behind. We're hiring a CRO Expert to own conversion rate optimization across our client portfolio. Your job is to find every drop-off point in the funnel — from ad click to booked appointment — and systematically test, optimize, and lift conversion at every stage. You'll be working on landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, booking flows, and the entire user journey from cold traffic to scheduled in-home consultation. Every percentage point you lift in conversion translates directly to client revenue, which is exactly the kind of impact we measure and reward. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** - Audit landing pages, lead forms, quiz funnels, and booking flows across all client accounts - Identify drop-off points using heatmaps, session recordings, and analytics (Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, etc.) - Build a structured CRO testing roadmap with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and prioritization - Design and launch A/B tests on headlines, hooks, offers, form layouts, button placement, social proof, and page structure - Optimize lead forms — field count, qualification questions, multi-step vs. single-step, mobile vs. desktop - Improve quiz funnels and lead magnets for higher opt-in and qualification rates - Optimize Thank You pages, confirmation flows, and post-booking experience - Work directly with copywriters, designers, and developers to ship test variants quickly - Track and report on conversion rates at every stage: ad click ? landing page ? lead ? booked appointment ? confirmed appointment - Maintain a CRO testing log — every test documented with hypothesis, result, and learning - Recommend funnel architecture improvements based on user behavior data **WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:** - 3+ years of hands-on CRO experience for lead-gen or e-commerce funnels - Proven track record lifting conversion rates — you can point to specific tests, before/after numbers, and revenue impact - Deep knowledge of landing page builders: Unbounce, Instapage, Leadpages, GoHighLevel, Funnelytics, Webflow, or similar - Fluent in CRO analysis tools: Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Mixpanel - Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and test prioritization frameworks (ICE, PIE, etc.) - Sharp eye for UX, copy, and design — you understand why pages convert, not just what to test - Comfortable working with copywriters and designers to ship variants — you give clear, decisive creative feedback - Strong written and spoken English — you'll be communicating directly with U.S. tea ---------- mbers - Analytical and methodical — you think in conversion rates, statistical confidence, and incremental lift - Self-starter who can operate with full autonomy - Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and ability to overlap with U.S. business hours - No ego. Humble, hungry, and willing to dig into the messy work of testing and iteration **BONUS POINTS:** - Experience with home services, local services, or lead-gen funnels specifically - Experience optimizing quiz funnels ( ---------- , Outgrow, Typeform, ---------- ) - Familiarity with GoHighLevel funnel building and automation - Basic HTML, CSS, or no-code dev skills for rapid landing page edits - Experience working with paid media teams (Meta, Google, TikTok) on creative-to-landing-page alignment - Background in DTC or e-commerce CRO (we bring e-com principles into home services) - Experience with multivariate testing, not just basic A/B - Knowledge of mobile-first design and conversion best practices **CULTURE:** This is a relentless execution culture. We move fast, we test fast, we ship fast. We measure conversion lifts in basis points and revenue, not opinions. If you want a chill role where you write strategy docs that never get implemented, this isn't for you. If you want to ship tests every week and watch the numbers move, apply. **HOW TO APPLY:** Send your application with: 1. A 60-second video introducing yourself in English — pitch us on why we should hire you 2. Two specific CRO case studies — landing page or funnel, what you tested, before/after conversion rates, revenue impact 3. Abundance We do not worry if the glass is half empty or half full because we know it is refillable! There are enough resources, opportunities, and successes to go around for everyone. Some of the fruits of an abundance mindset include gratitude, generosity, and optimism. We view setbacks as temporary and as opportunities to learn, improve, and grow. ABOUT THE JOB The Accountant directly reports to the Controller and will own the accuracy and timeliness of our clients core accounting processes, ensuring compliance with GAAP and internal controls. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with the accounting cycle—from revenue recognition and cash receipts to accrual adjustments and month-end close—along with strong financial planning and analysis capabilities to forecast, analyze variances, and provide actionable insights. Prepare and review journal entries with supporting documentation from the data given by the Data Team; ensure proper coding and documentation for audit trails. Perform reconciliations of cash accounts and banking activities, ensure accuracy of intercompany accounts, and investigate variances. Analyze P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow trends; prepare variance analyses against budgets and forecasts. Build and maintain financial models to support business decisions, capital allocation, and scenario planning. Stakeholder and Client Collaboration Active collaboration within the Finance Team. Partner with the Data Team in completion of financial reports and other financial projects. Communicate financial information and reports clearly to the clients if needed. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA/CFA/MBA preferred. 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with demonstrable expertise in the full accounting cycle. Experience with US clients. Strong knowledge on cash-to-accrual conversions and timely accurate journal entries. Proficiency in GAAP and financial statement preparation; experience with consolidation. Solid FP&A background: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling. Advanced Excel skills and experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, QuickBooks, or similar). Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Effective verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial colleagues or clients. Demonstrated integrity, reliability, and adherence to internal controls. Work Environment: This role is a remote full-time position. The successful candidate will be considered as Independent Contractor. This is a 40-hour work week, from Monday to Friday. Flexible time depending on the agreement with the Controller (2-3hours in the morning Philippine time with overlapping MST schedule). If the work is good and the fit is right, this becomes an ongoing part-time role. **This is not a creative agency role.** We're not looking for someone who redesigns from scratch every time. You'll receive a full brief on selection — including an HTML reference file, brand specifications, a component list, and technical requirements for how the file feeds into our build pipeline. What matters at this stage: you can work from a brief, you understand component-based Figma work, and your files are clean enough that a developer can build from them without interpretation. The test project is paid at a fixed fee of $200. --- ## What We're Looking For **Essential:** - Strong Figma proficiency — components, variants, auto layout, variables - Experience building and working within design systems, not just creating one-off designs - Attention to detail: spacing, alignment, typographic hierarchy - Clean file organisation — layers named, pages structured, components documented - Ability to work from a brief and reference file without needing extensive direction **Preferred:** - Experience designing for web agencies or productised services - Familiarity with how Figma files are used in developer handoff - Understanding of how design tokens map to CSS custom properties **Not required:** - Motion design or illustration - Logo or brand identity work - Copywriting --- ## Working Style - Async, remote — we communicate via email and occasional video calls - You'll receive a clear brief for each piece of work - Revisions are discussed, not assumed — if something isn't right, we talk about why - Founder-led: you work directly with the founder, not through an account manager --- ## Compensation The test project is a fixed fee of $200. If we move to an ongoing arrangement, we'll agree a retainer rate based on expected monthly hours. --- ## How to Apply Start your message with the word RESTRAINED so we know you've read this. Applications that don't include it won't be reviewed. Then include: 1. Two or three Figma files from previous work — component libraries, design systems, or finished site designs preferred 2. A sentence or two on your experience working within an existing design system rather than building from scratch 3. Your hourly rate expectation for ongoing work We're not looking for the cheapest option. We're looking for the right one.

Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent) - Confluence experience for sprint documentation and team wikis - Familiarity with both product and solutions/support engineering contexts - Experience working within a franchise or SaaS product company WHAT WE VALUE - Process Development & Standardization - Develop, document, and enforce internal SOPs for recurring workflows and campaign types. - Build and maintain ClickUp templates that standardize how work gets set up across service lines. - Identify process inefficiencies through data and implement improvements with measurable outcomes. - Partner with service line leads to ensure process changes reflect operational realities. 5. Internal Communication & Team Alignment - Run regular internal standups and project syncs - keep them tight, action-oriented, and documented in ClickUp. - Serve as the connective tissue between service teams; eliminate silos that cause delivery failures. - Deliver clear task briefs and instructions so tea ---------- mbers can execute without ambiguity. - Provide leadership with accurate, timely status reports on project health, risks, and performance metrics. Required Qualifications - 3+ years of project management experience, preferably in a digital marketing agency or DTC ecommerce environment. - Expert-level proficiency in ClickUp: you must be able to demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise. This is non-negotiable. - Proficiency in Everhour or comparable time-tracking and capacity management tools. - Strong command of resource allocation principles; comfortable reading utilization data and making decisions from it. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills - you can write a clear brief, run a focused meeting, and escalate crisply. - Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects under tight deadlines without losing detail. - Analytical mindset: you track metrics, notice trends, and use data to drive decisions. Preferred Qualifications - Familiarity with digital marketing service lines: SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Email /Klaviyo. - Experience building or refining PM processes in a scaling agency environment. - PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management certification. What Success Looks Like at 90 Days - On-time task delivery rate is at or above 90?ross all active client projects. - ClickUp workspace hygiene is at 100%: every active task has a due date, owner, and status. - Zero tasks in backlog aging beyond 7 days without a documented escalation. - Capacity report is running bi-weekly; no tea ---------- mbers are flagged as critically over- or under-allocated. - Blocker-to-resolution time is documented and a baseline has been established for ongoing improvement. title: Tik Tok Shop Video editor/VA
description: Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly) About the Role I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting. Responsibilities The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video: 1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow ---------- nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority. 2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better. In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound. Requirements The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use. No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos. Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job. Pay & Schedule The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment. In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete. Workflow Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process. All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule. Growth Opportunity This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

A candidate who says "I assumed X because Y, but here's what would change if it were Z" tells me more than a candidate who just hands me a figure. If you have questions at any point, ask. Knowing when to ask is part of the job. ========================================= PART 1 — REASONING TEST ========================================= The link below opens a TIMED form. Once you open it, you have 30 MINUTES to complete it and submit your response. Don't open it until you're ready to begin. ---------- ========================================= PART 2 — DATA ANALYSIS EXERCISE ========================================= BACKGROUND The dataset is shared as a Google Sheets link below. It shows TV-commercial advertising performance for one of our clients — a health products company that needed help with marketing attribution. Each row is a single TV ad airing, with the cost of that slot and the revenue and orders attributed to it across several sales channels (main website, Amazon, phone, and an ad-specific landing page). Dataset: ---------- Make your own copy before you start working (File > Make a copy). Please don't request edit access to the original. The workbook has three tabs: - "SF Media Detail" — the raw airing-level data (this is the main dataset). - "column descriptions" — plain-English meanings for the key columns you'll need. You do NOT need every column in the raw data; this tab points you to the ones that matter. - "Product-level info" — the client's product mix and per-product costs, which you'll need to calculate cost of goods. Heads up: this is a real export, so expect some friction. Column names may not be perfectly consistent, dates and times may not be stored the way you'd expect, and not every column is relevant. Part of the exercise is figuring out what's signal and what's noise. DEFINITIONS (read carefully — small wording differences matter) - Week runs MONDAY through SUNDAY. - Revenue for an airing = the total revenue it generated across all four channels (main website + Amazon + phone + ad-specific landing page). The "column descriptions" tab tells you which columns these are. - Ad Cost = the cost of the TV ad slot. The "column descriptions" tab points you to the right column. - COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) = the production cost of the orders generated. Use the product mix and per-product costs on the "Product-level info" tab to estimate this. There is no per-row product column, so you'll need to d ---------- how to apply the mix — explain your approach. - ROAS = Revenue / Ad Cost. ("For every $1 of ad spend, how many dollars of revenue came back?") - pROAS = Profit / Ad Cost, where Profit = Revenue - Ad Cost - COGS. ("For every $1 of ad spend, how many dollars of PROFIT came back?") Note: pROAS uses PROFIT in the numerator, not revenue. This is the one place people most often slip — make sure your two metrics aren't just the same formula twice. QUESTIONS 1. What were the weekly ROAS and pROAS for the month of November? (Some weeks straddle the start/end of the month — tell me how you handled the boundaries.) 2. Using November as your basis, forecast revenue and profitability for the next twelve months. Note that the data thins out toward the most recent dates — tell me whether you think November is a sound basis for a forecast, and what caveats you'd attach to your numbers. 3. What changes did the client make to ad spend during November? In your judgment, was it a good move? Use the data to support your answer. 4. What changes would you recommend to their strategy to grow revenue while holding or improving profitability over the year? 5. What other insights should the client know about? Anything in the data that surprised you, looks like a problem, or looks like an opportunity. DELIVERABLE Send me a Google Sheet containing: - A table of weekly ROAS and pROAS (your November weeks, clearly labeled). - A chart of ROAS and pROAS over time. - Your written answers to the five questions above — in the sheet, or in the body of your email , whichever you prefer. - A short note listing the key assumptions you made and anything you found unclear or contradictory. Make sure your sheet is shared so I can open it (anyone-with-link viewer is fine). If anything in these instructions is ambiguous, you can make a reasonable assumption and note it Good luck — and don't forget the keyword.

title: E-commerce Operations Assistant for Growing U.S. Online Store
job_title: E-commerce Operations Assistant for Growing U.S. Online Store
description: Hi! I’m looking for a reliable part-time E-commerce Operations Assistant to help with daily operations for a growing online store in the U.S. market. The business is expanding and I need someone hands-on who can help with customer communication, supplier follow-ups, product research, pricing checks, Shopify tasks, and keeping operations organized. We sell high-ticket products, not a simple one-product dropshipping item. We work with multiple brands and suppliers, and each brand can have different prices, margins, shipping rules, product details, lead times, warranties, and return policies. Many products are shipped directly from suppliers or manufacturers, so attention to detail is very important. This is a full time , but it is not a “work whenever you want” role. Since this position involves customer email s, SMS, calls, supplier follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and order updates, you must have availability during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time. You will not be working full-time every day at the beginning, but you must be available during that working window when tasks, calls, or follow-ups are needed. This will start as a part-time, task-by-task role, but as the business grows and you prove you are reliable, the work can become more consistent. Pay can also increase as your performance improves and the business continues to grow. Main tasks may include: Responding to customer email s, SMS, and calls in English, including order updates, product questions, quote follow-ups, abandoned checkout follow-ups, and general customer support. Making and answering customer calls in English when needed. Following up with customers by call, SMS, or email for quotes, pending payments, abandoned checkouts, product questions, delivery updates, and order issues. Following up with suppliers about stock, pricing, shipping, product details, and lead times. Updating customers about order status, delivery updates, and supplier responses. Checking product prices, supplier costs, margins, and competitor pricing. Comparing our prices with U.S. competitors. Using a VPN when needed to view U.S. pricing, competitor websites, and availability. Helping with Shopify product uploads and product updates. Reviewing product pages for missing or incorrect information. Keeping CRM sheets and internal spreadsheets organized. Updating customer notes, supplier notes, order notes, and follow-up status. Helping with warranty, return, cancellation, and delivery communication. Handling customer problems professionally and knowing when to escalate an issue before making promises or decisions. Following SOPs and training videos for each task. You will not be expected to do everything at once. I will assign specific tasks and provide instructions, examples, and training videos when needed. Requirements Please do not apply if you do not think you qualify. Advanced written and spoken English. Confident speaking with U.S. customers by phone. Comfortable answering calls, making follow-up calls, replying to SMS, and handling customer issues professionally. Able to communicate clearly when there is a problem, delay, warranty issue, delivery concern, or customer complaint. Experience with Shopify, e-commerce operations, slack, customer support, or virtual assistant work. Experience using Google Sheets, CRM sheets, spreadsheets, or similar tools to stay organized. Able to work with the U.S. market and U.S. customers. Available during agreed U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, depending on assigned tasks, calls, and follow-ups. Must have reliable internet. Must be able to use a VPN when needed. Strong attention to detail. Organized and able to keep accurate notes. Able to follow step-by-step instructions carefully. Comfortable checking supplier websites, product pages, pricing, shipping details, and competitor pages. Able to ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing. Able to work with urgency when a task is assigned. Must understand that refunds, cancellations, discounts, returns, or compensation cannot be approved without owner approval. Important This business sells high-ticket products, so mistakes can be expensive. A wrong product detail, wrong price, missed follow-up, or incorrect promise to a customer can create serious problems. You should not promise customers exact delivery dates unless they are confirmed. You should not approve refunds, returns, cancellations, discounts, or compensation unless I specifically authorize it. You must be careful when checking prices because different brands have different margins, supplier costs, shipping fees, MAP rules, and competitor pricing. Examples of tasks you may receive “Check if this product is in stock with the supplier and confirm the shipping cost.” “Reply to this customer asking for a delivery update.” “Call this customer and confirm their shipping address.” “Call or text this customer who started checkout but did not complete the order.” “Follow up with this lead and ask if they have any questions before purchasing.” “Compare our price with this competitor and calculate the margin.” “Update the CRM sheet with the customer status and next follow-up.” “Check this Shopify order/customer profile and update the CRM sheet with the latest status.” “Check if this product page is missing warranty, shipping, or specification details.” “Upload these products to Shopify using this supplier page.” “Organize this supplier information in the supplier database.” “Follow up with this supplier about tracking or freight delivery.” “Review this customer issue and prepare a draft response.” How to apply Please message me here if you are interested. To show that you read the full post carefully, start your message with: “Hi Chris, I can help with U.S. e-commerce operations.” Also, somewhere in your application, mention: “CRM sheet” Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer these questions in your own words: Have you worked with Shopify, customer service, or e-commerce operations before? Explain briefly. Are you comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone in English? Are you available during U.S. business hours, ideally between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Eastern Time, for assigned tasks, calls, SMS, and follow-ups? Have you used Google Sheets,slack,  CRM sheets, or spreadsheets to manage customer/order information? A customer asks for an exact delivery date, but the supplier only gave an estimated transit time. How would you respond? Before telling a customer that a product is in stock, what would you check? If a customer asks for a refund, discount, cancellation, or compensation, what would you do before confirming anything? Are you able to use a VPN to check U.S. competitor pricing and product availability? Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be considered. Thanks! Chris

title: Performance Marketer

You'll own the entire performance marketing ecosystem—creative strategy, media buying, and CRO—and make them work as one system. --- About Rescale Media We're not just another e-commerce company. Just data and results. --- The Role Here's the problem we're solving: Most e-commerce companies have creative, media buying, and CRO operating in silos. Creative makes ads. Media buyers launch them. CRO optimizes funnels. But nobody connects the data between them. The result? Creative doesn't know what's actually converting. Media buyers don't understand why certain ads work. CRO can't tell creative what messaging drives purchases. Everyone's optimizing their piece without seeing the whole picture. We need someone who owns all three functions—not as a manager who delegates, but as a hands-on leader who understands the mechanics deeply enough to connect them. You'll lead our creative strategists, work at a strategic level with media buyers, and own CRO performance. But more importantly, you'll build the feedback loops that make these functions work as one integrated system. This isn't a CMO role where you sit in meetings and review dashboards. This is a full end-to-end performance marketing role where you're in the trenches—guiding creative direction based on ad data, adjusting media buying strategy based on funnel performance, and optimizing CRO based on traffic quality. --- What You'll Do Creative Strategy Leadership - Lead and guide creative strategists on concepts, angles, and hooks - Translate media buying data into creative briefs—what's working, what's not, and why - Build the creative testing roadmap based on performance signals - Ensure creative output aligns with what actually converts (not just what looks good) Media Buying Strategy - Work at a strategic level with media buyers on campaign structure, scaling decisions, and budget allocation - Diagnose performance issues and identify whether the problem is creative, targeting, or funnel - Connect media buying metrics to downstream conversion data - Guide platform strategy across Meta, Google, TikTok, and other channels CRO Ownership - Own funnel performance—landing pages, advertorials, checkout flow - Run and analyze tests on copy, layout, offers, and user experience - Connect CRO insights back to creative and media buying (what messaging converts, what traffic quality issues exist) - Build dashboards and reporting that show the full customer journey, not just isolated metrics The Feedback Loop - Build the system that connects creative, media buying, and CRO into one continuous improvement engine - Create processes for insights to flow between teams automatically - Identify where breakdowns happen in the customer journey and fix them - Own the holistic view of performance that most companies lack --- What We're Looking For - 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, with at least 2 years in a leadership role - Extensive media buying experience—you've managed significant ad spend ($500K+/month) and know what good media buying looks like - Extensive CRO experience—you understand funnels, conversion optimization, and how to diagnose where we're losing customers - Proven ability to connect data across channels and build unified marketing strategies - Experience leading marketing teams (media buyers, CRO specialists, etc.) - Strong analytical skills—you live in the data and make decisions based on it - Strategic thinker who can zoom out to see the big picture and zoom in to fix details - Clear communicator who can translate complex data into actionable insights for leadership - Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or high-growth consumer brands - Background in both paid social (Meta, TikTok) and other channels (Google, Pinterest, native) - You've scaled a brand from 7-figures to 8-figures or beyond - Experience with advertorial funnels and direct response marketing Bonus Points: - Dropshipping experience (fast-paced testing, thin margins, rapid scaling) - Experience at a performance creative agency—you've seen what works across multiple brands and brought that pattern recognition in-house - Experience with AI creative tools and emerging ad formats --- This Role Is NOT For... We're being direct because we respect your time: - Specialists who only know one piece (creative OR media buying OR CRO)—you need to understand all three - People who want to manage from a distance and delegate everything - Those who can't connect data across platforms and see the full picture - Marketers who optimize for vanity metrics instead of profit - Anyone who needs a large team to execute—you should be able to get hands dirty - People who view creative, media buying, and CRO as separate disciplines instead of one system - Those who struggle to translate data into actionable creative and funnel direction --- Compensation & Benefits - Monthly Salary: $5,000 - $8,000/month + Profit Share - Profit share tied to marketing performance (details discussed during interview) - Remote-first environment - Work directly with founders on growth strategy - Lead a team of specialists while staying hands-on - Build the marketing engine for a portfolio of scaling brands --- Our Hiring Process We don't waste time—yours or ours. Here's how it works: - Step 1: Application (You're here!) - Step 2: Initial Interview with CHRO - Step 3: Internal Assessment by Rescale - Step 4: Interview with CEO - Step 5: Signing of Independent Contractor and NDA - Step 6: Onboarding Total timeline: 1-2 weeks from application to offer. --- Ready to Apply? ---------- Complete the application form above. Be thorough—this is your first impression. Please attach your resume and portfolio. P.S. If you've ever been frustrated that creative, media buying, and CRO don't talk to each other—and you know exactly how to fix it—this role was made for you. P.P.S. title: Executive Assistant

COMMUNICATION * Serve as the first point of contact for the CEO's office, including scheduling requests, email communications, and external inquiries. * Own the day-to-day management of the CEO's inbox, including prioritization, organization, drafting responses, and ensuring no communication falls through the cracks. * Partner closely with the organization's grant lead to support grant writing coordination, deadlines, submissions, and documentation. * Ensure internal teams receive clear communication regarding CEO priorities, decisions, and expectations. * Handle sensitive communications with confidentiality and sound judgment. * Document action items, commitments, and decisions from CEO meetings and ensure appropriate follow-up. STRATEGIC THINKING * Understand the CEO's priorities well enough to make informed decisions regarding scheduling, access, and time management. * Anticipate needs before meetings, events, deadlines, and major initiatives. * Monitor funding opportunities and trends relevant to the organization's mission and programs. * Identify administrative inefficiencies and recommend practical solutions that improve organizational effectiveness. ACCOUNTABILITY * Provide weekly executive briefings that include calendar updates, open action items, grant deadlines, and partnership status reports. * Ensure no grant deadline or compliance requirement is missed without advance notice and a documented plan. * Maintain accurate and current records within all tracking and CRM systems. * Ensure executive communications and follow-up expectations are consistently met. * Protect CEO capacity by owning responsibilities that should not require executive involvement. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS * Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, Project Coordinator, Administrative Operations Professional, or similar role. * Demonstrated experience directly supporting senior executives, founders, CEOs, or C-suite leadership. * Strong executive calendar management and inbox management experience. * Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, projects, and stakeholders simultaneously. * Experience working in a fast-paced, mission-driven, nonprofit, startup, or growth-oriented environment. * Strong organizational and project management skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Experience using project management, collaboration, and CRM systems. * Comfortable working with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms to support research, communication, organization, documentation, and administrative efficiency. * High degree of discretion, trustworthiness, professionalism, and sound judgment. * Strong alignment with the organization's mission of supporting underrepresented talent in technology. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with grant research, grant writing, or nonprofit grant management. * Familiarity with federal, state, corporate, and foundation funding opportunities. * Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives. * Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or executive leadership team. * Familiarity with HubSpot, Notion, Asana, Jira, Google Workspace, or similar platforms. IMMEDIATE HIRE OPPORTUNITY This is an immediate-hire opportunity for a candidate who can step into the role with confidence and professionalism. Month Three — Optimize Bring forward at least two data-grounded recommendations for what is working and what should change. Participate in the Q4 marketing planning session as a contributing voice. What Makes This Role Different This is not a generic marketing operations coordinator role. description: *Web Designer (UX/UI) — Gig* Boutique Video Production Studio — New York *About the Role* We're a boutique video production studio based in New York City, specializing in corporate image films, brand documentaries, and event films — primarily for European companies operating in the US market. You're not a graphic designer who builds websites on the side. Web design is your specialism. It's where your thinking lives. *What You'll Do* You'll take ownership of the full website project from concept to launch — starting with strategy, not aesthetics. Before a single frame gets designed, you'll need to understand our brand, our clients, and our business goals. 1. Strategy & Concept • Develop the sitemap, define page hierarchy, and map out the user flow • Make deliberate structural decisions before moving into design • Understand what a service-based studio site needs to do commercially, not just visually 2. Design & Build • Design and build a 5–7 page website in Wix (including Wix Developer tools) or Webflow • Deliver fully responsive designs for both desktop and mobile — not just scaled-down versions of each other • Understand scroll behavior, interactive states, and responsiveness as logic problems, not just visual ones • Apply hierarchy the way a developer thinks: what loads first, what earns attention, what drives action 3. Conversion & SEO • Build a conversion-focused site that actively moves a visitor toward becoming a client • Implement proper SEO foundations from day one: meta titles, header structures, and technical configurations • Structure content and copy placement for both readability and search performance 4. Technical Setup • Handle hosting setup, domain transfer, and any migrations required • Deliver a clean handoff so the site is fully live and running from day one • Manage any technical configurations independently — no handholding needed *What We're Looking For* Required: • 3+ years specializing in web design — not general graphic, brand, or print design • A genuine process: sitemap ? wireframe ? visual design, every time • Strong information architecture skills — you can define page structure, navigation logic, and content hierarchy from a brief • Deep understanding of web UX: conversion logic, scroll behavior, mobile-first thinking, and interactive states • Expert-level skills in either Wix (including Wix Developer / Velo) or Webflow — tell us which one and show us what you've built with it • A portfolio of live websites for service-based businesses or creative studios that shows process, not just final output • Clear, proactive communicator in English — you flag problems early and ask the right questions *How to Apply* Send us the following: • Your portfolio — live websites only. The thinking matters as much as the output. Bonus points if any of them are for a creative studio, production company, or service-based business. • A short introduction: who you are, what kinds of projects you've worked on, your platform of choice (Wix or Webflow), and your rate for a project like this. Compensation • $400–600 flat project fee for the full website (5–7 pages), depending on complexity and experience • Ongoing retainer available for post-launch support, updates, and maintenance — billed hourly at a rate we agree on upfront We're looking for the best fit, not the cheapest option. title: Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator
job_title: Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator
description: About Nosu Nosu is a Dutch health-and-wellness brand focused on helping people reshape their relationship with sweetness, cravings, food habits, and metabolic health. Our brand is built around the idea that long-term wellness does not come from extreme restriction or quick fixes, but from small, sustainable changes in behavior. We create content around topics such as sugar cravings, blood sugar, insulin resistance, glucose metabolism, appetite, food noise, weight management, sweet taste, reward, and healthier daily habits. Nosu’s brand direction is modern, reliable, approachable, innovative, and grounded. Our visual identity combines vibrant organic visuals, clean photography, modern typography, and relatable human lifestyle imagery, so the brand feels both scientific and accessible. Role Overview Health & Wellness Content Editor / Social Media Creator We are looking for a strong content editor and social media creator to help us turn simplified health and metabolic-health topics into blog articles and Instagram content. This role is ideal for someone who is good at writing, editing, simplifying information, creating educational social posts, and working with health/wellness content. You do not need to be a doctor, scientist, or medical researcher. However, you should be comfortable working with topics like nutrition, blood sugar, cravings, metabolic health, supplements, appetite, and behavior change. You should be able to make content feel simple, relatable, and engaging without making exaggerated claims. Main Responsibilities 1. Turn one topic into blog articles For every assigned topic or subtopic, you will create a short or medium-length blog article. The article should: * Be easy to understand. * Speak directly to our target persona. * Use simple, natural language. * Avoid overly technical explanations. * Avoid exaggerated health or medical claims. * Explain why the topic matters in everyday life. * Connect the topic to cravings, food behavior, metabolic health, or healthy habits. * Always include a natural tie-in to Nosu. The blog article should not feel like a generic SEO article. It should feel like it was written for someone who struggles with cravings, sugar, food noise, dieting, energy dips, or feeling out of control around sweet foods. The goal is to make the reader think: “This explains what I experience. This brand understands me.” 2. Repurpose each topic into Instagram content After creating the blog article, you will turn the same topic into Instagram content. This may include: * Educational carousel posts * Single-image educational posts * Myth-vs-fact posts * Quote posts * Problem/solution posts * Founder/expert-style educational posts * Relatable meme-style posts * UGC/testimonial-inspired posts * Product education posts * Ingredient education posts * Simple visual explainers * Story slides * Reel script ideas Each Instagram post should focus on one topic or subtopic only. For example: * One post about insulin resistance * One post about why sugar cravings happen * One post about food noise * One post about blood sugar spikes * One post about how sweet taste connects to reward * One post about how Nosu fits into a healthy routine The posts should follow the formats used by strong DTC health and supplement brands: educational, relatable, visual, simple, and built for social media attention. 3. Write Instagram captions For each Instagram post, you will write a caption that: * Hooks the reader. * Explains the idea clearly. * Feels natural and human. * Speaks in the language of our target audience. * Reinforces the blog topic. * Includes a natural tie-in to Nosu. * Encourages saves, shares, comments, or clicks when relevant. Captions should not feel overly salesy. They should feel educational and helpful, while still moving the reader closer to understanding why Nosu exists. 4. Collaborate on visuals Visuals will be a collaboration. Nosu can provide: * Product photography * Lifestyle images * Brand assets * Visual references * Design examples * Templates * Creative direction The hire can help with: * Choosing the best visual format * Creating simple graphics * Building carousels in Canva, Figma, or similar tools * Suggesting image concepts * Adding text overlays * Making sure posts look clean and on-brand The added text and layout should reflect Nosu’s visual identity: clean, modern, approachable, science-backed, and visually consistent. We want the content to feel like a real brand system, not random social posts. 5. Apply Nosu’s brand tone All content should feel aligned with Nosu’s brand. We want to make complex health topics understandable, but we do not want to overpromise or make medical claims. 6. Support our organic strategy The hire should help us build an organic content system based on the strongest DTC health brands. This includes helping us create a healthy mix of: * Educational posts * Category education * Product education * Relatable posts * Social proof posts * Founder/expert-style posts * Lifestyle and habit content * Myth-busting content * Simple explainers * Community/persona-led content Over time, this content should help Nosu become a trusted educational brand in the space of sugar cravings, metabolic health, food behavior, and healthier habits. Ideal Candidate You may be a good fit if you: * Have excellent English writing and editing skills. * Can turn simple notes into strong, polished content. * Can write in a way that speaks to a specific target audience. * Understand how to make health content relatable. * Have experience with wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, psychology, or behavior-change content. * Can create Instagram carousels or social media posts. * Have a good eye for clean design and visual hierarchy. * Can use Canva, Figma, Adobe Express, or similar tools. * Can follow brand guidelines and content structures. * Are detail-oriented. * Understand that health content must be careful, accurate, and not exaggerated. * Can collaborate with a brand team on visuals and messaging. * Can turn one topic into multiple useful content assets. Important: What This Role Is Not Nosu will provide the source material, simplified explanation, key takeaways, and strategic direction. Your main job is to turn our input into: * A clear blog article * Strong social posts * Great caption * Clean, brand-aligned visual content This is also not purely a graphic design role. Writing, editing, and simplifying information are just as important as creating the final Instagram post. To Apply Please send: 1. Examples of blog articles, educational content, or health/wellness writing you have created. 2. Examples of Instagram carousels, social posts, or social media graphics. 3. A short explanation of your experience with health, wellness, nutrition, supplements, fitness, or educational content. 4. A short explanation of how you would turn one topic into a blog article and Instagram post. 5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly rate. 6. Your weekly availability. 7. Tools You Should Know You should be experienced with: * Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or Adobe Illustrator * Designing for Meta ads * Designing for Instagram/Facebook * Basic direct response ad design * Working with product photography * Creating multiple creative variations quickly Bonus if you have experience with: * Shopify brands * Clothing/apparel brands * Fashion or lifestyle ads * Meta ad creatives * UGC-style static ads * Ecommerce conversion design * Creative testing * Klaviyo/email graphics ## Weekly Deliverables We are looking for someone who can consistently create batches of static ads.
