title: Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant
description: # Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant for Shopify Clothing Brand ## About Us Sunset Surf is a fast-growing clothing brand selling premium embroidered coastal hoodies. We are scaling through Shopify, Meta ads, creator content, inventory restocks, wholesale, and brand trips. We are looking for a detail-oriented Ecommerce Finance & Operations Assistant who can help us track our business numbers clearly every week and every month. This role is not a logistics role. We already have someone helping with logistics. This role is focused on tracking money, expenses, payments, inventory costs, QuickBooks, Shopify payouts, and monthly reports. ## What We Need Help With We need someone who can help us clearly understand: * How much money came in * How much money went out * How much we spent on inventory * How much we spent on workers, creators, and contractors * How much we spent on Meta ads * How much we spent on brand trips * How much cash is tied up in inventory * How much inventory has sold * How much inventory is still left to sell * Estimated monthly profit * Upcoming payments and expenses The goal is to help us see a clear picture of the business every week and month. ## Main Responsibilities * Track Shopify sales and payouts * Compare Shopify payouts to bank deposits * Track QuickBooks transactions * Organize and categorize expenses in QuickBooks * Track inventory purchases * Track cost per hoodie/SKU * Track how much cash is tied up in inventory * Track units sold and units remaining * Track creator, contractor, and worker payments * Track Meta ad spend * Track product/sample costs * Track brand trip spending * Track receipts and invoices * Maintain Google Sheets or Excel trackers * Prepare weekly financial summaries * Prepare monthly spending and profit summaries * Flag missing expenses, unusual payments, or cash-flow concerns * Work with our bookkeeper/CPA when needed ## Initial Project The first project will be to organize and track financial data from January 1st of this year to present. This includes: * Shopify payouts * Business expenses * Inventory purchases * Creator/contractor payments * Worker payments * Meta ad spend * Brand trip expenses * Software/app subscriptions * Product/sample costs * Monthly summaries After the initial setup, this will become an ongoing weekly and monthly tracking role. ## Brand Trip Tracking For brand trips, we mainly need spending tracked clearly. You will track: * Trip name * Location * Date * Budget * Flights * Hotel/Airbnb * Food * Uber/rental car * Activities * Creator payments * Products gifted * Photographer/videographer costs * Decorations/props * Miscellaneous expenses * Total spent * Whether the trip was over or under budget * Receipts and payment dates We want to clearly see how much we are spending on brand trips each month. ## Inventory Tracking Example If we buy 1,000 hoodies at $30 each, that is $30,000 spent upfront. If each hoodie sells for $99, that inventory has $99,000 in potential revenue. We need help tracking: * Total inventory cost * Units received * Units sold * Units remaining * Revenue generated so far * Remaining inventory value * How much cash is still tied up in inventory This helps us understand where our money is and how much inventory still needs to sell. ## Tools You Should Know You must be comfortable with: * QuickBooks * Shopify * Google Sheets or Excel * Basic ecommerce reporting * Expense tracking * Cash-flow tracking Experience with these is a bonus: * Meta Ads Manager * TrueProfit * BeProfit * Inventory Planner * Settle * Finaloop * Ecommerce bookkeeping * Apparel or clothing brands * Inventory/COGS tracking ## Ideal Candidate You are a good fit if you are: * Very organized * Strong with numbers * Experienced with QuickBooks * Experienced with Shopify * Comfortable with spreadsheets * Detail-oriented * Reliable with weekly updates * Good at spotting missing expenses or mistakes * Comfortable asking questions when something does not make sense * Able to create simple, clear reports * Experienced with ecommerce businesses ## Important You will not have control over bank transfers or final payment approvals. Your role is to track, organize, report, and help us understand the numbers. Final payments, banking decisions, tax decisions, and accounting decisions will be handled by the owner and/or bookkeeper/CPA. ## Weekly Report Every week, we want a simple report showing: * Total sales * Total Shopify payouts * Total expenses * Meta ad spend * Creator/contractor/worker payments * Inventory payments * Brand trip expenses * Estimated profit * Upcoming bills/payments * Any missing receipts or concerns * Any cash-flow notes ## Monthly Report Every month, we want a summary showing: * Total revenue * Total expenses * Estimated profit * Inventory purchased * Inventory sold * Cash tied up in inventory * Creator/content spend * Worker/contractor spend * Brand trip spend * Ad spend * Software/app expenses * Areas where we may be overspending * Big payments coming up next month ## How to Apply Please send: 1. Your experience with Shopify 2. Your experience with QuickBooks 3. Examples of ecommerce finance, bookkeeping, or operations tracking work you have done 4. Your experience with inventory, COGS, or cash-flow tracking 5. Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel 6. Your hourly or monthly rate 7. Your availability 8. Any ecommerce finance tools you recommend Please also answer this question: If a brand spends $30,000 on inventory upfront, but that inventory will sell over the next few months, how would you track that so the owner understands both cash flow and profit? Thank you!

title: Appointment-Setting VA — Hard Money & EMD for Real Estate Investors
job_title: Appointment-Setting VA — Hard Money & EMD for Real Estate Investors
description: We're Cornerstone Legacy Capital — a US-based real estate finance firm. We're hiring an appointment-setting VA to drive qualified real estate investor prospects to our Hard Money and EMD funding partners. This is one of two specialized VA roles on our team. You'll focus exclusively on the lender side — Hard Money Loans (fix-and-flip, bridge, ground-up construction, DSCR) and EMD / Double Close capital (for investors needing earnest money or to close creative finance deals). A separate VA handles our business credit products. Real estate finance vocabulary is required for this role — you'll be in DMs with investors using terms like BRRRR, sub2, DSCR, double close, EMD, gator, wholesale, and bridge daily. This is a real, ongoing role with documented systems already in place — full playbook, scripts, tracker, and KPI dashboard are ready on Day 1. The Two Products You'll Be Working 1. Hard Money Loans (Fix-and-Flip, Bridge, Ground-Up Construction, DSCR) — for active real estate investors with deals in pipeline needing rehab / bridge / construction / DSCR financing, residential or commercial. Application: ---------- /apply (with Andrea's referral link) 2. EMD / Double Close / Seller-Financed Down Payments — for investors needing short-term capital to cover earnest money or close creative finance deals (sub2, wholesale assignments). Application: ---------- (with Andrea's referral link) Your weekly target: 10–20 form fills split across the two products (target: ~7–14 Hard Money + ~3–6 EMD). What You'll Do - Source qualified prospects from real estate investor communities — Pace Morby's Sub2 Owners Club, AstroFlipping wholesaling groups, BiggerPockets investor forums, ---------- metro Facebook groups (DFW, Carolinas, others), LinkedIn REI creators, Instagram REI niche accounts - Run engagement-first outreach— comment thoughtfully in REI communities (deal-share posts, funding questions, creative finance threads), then DM the people who engage back - Route prospects to the correct product — investors needing rehab / flip / ground up construction / bridge / DSCR funding go to Hard Money; investors needing fast EMD or double-close capital go to EMD - Use pre-approved scripts and compliance language — never quote rates, never promise loan terms, never guarantee approval - Light qualifying only— what deal are they working on? What stage? — then send the appropriate intake form - Log every prospect in our Excel-based tracker with the correct Product tag - Hit 40–50 outreach touches per day across 4 hour workday - Run a weekly review call (Fridays) with the owner You're a Great Fit If - You've done outbound appointment setting before (sales VA, business development) and can show numbers from past roles - You're a near-native English speaker — REI prospects are unforgiving on VA-voiced DMs - You have real estate finance literacy— you understand or can quickly learn what hard money is, what an EMD is, what BRRRR / sub2 / DSCR / double close / wholesale assignment mean. Past experience working with US real estate brokers, lenders, or wholesalers is a strong plus. - You're disciplined about daily volume and tracking - You can stay strictly on-script around lending claims— no quoted rates, no promised approval - You're comfortable with LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, Gmail, Go High Level and Excel - You can work Mon–Fri during US Central Time business hours You're NOT a Fit If - Real estate finance vocabulary feels overwhelming or boring to you - You want to "improvise" the scripts — sorry, compliance is non-negotiable - You can't commit to consistent daily volume - You don't have outbound sales / appointment-setting experience - You can only work very late or very early relative to Central US time Logistics - Hours: 20 hours/week (4 hours/day, Mon–Fri), during US Central Time business hours - Pay: $2.50 - 5/hour - Start: ASAP — paid 1-week trial period - Tools: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, Gmail, Excel, Go High Level and our internal tracker - Training: Full onboarding curriculum provided — Day 1 is compliance + product overview + real estate finance vocabulary deep-dive - Long-term upside: After 60 days of consistent performance, we'll discuss either a rate increase or moving to a performance-bonus structure How to Apply - Please read carefully. 1. Include the phrase "PURPLE GIRAFFE" at the very top of your application. If it's not there, I will not read further. 2. Answer the screening questions below thoughtfully — not in one-sentence answers. 3. Record a 60-second Loom video introducing yourself in English. Tell me (a) why this real estate finance role interests you specifically and (b) one example of appointment-setting success from your past work, with numbers. Paste the Loom link in your application. Screening Questions 1. Compliance & Language Rewrite "Below is a sample message draft: 'Hi [name] — we can get you approved for a hard money loan at 7% with no money down, guaranteed funding in 5 days.' What is wrong with this message from a compliance standpoint, and how would you rewrite it to be safer while still being effective?" 2. Real Estate Finance Vocabulary Check "Briefly explain in your own words what each of these terms means: (a) Hard money loan, (b) Earnest money deposit (EMD), (c) DSCR loan, (d) BRRRR, (e) Sub2 / Subject-to, (f) Double close. We're not looking for textbook definitions — we want to see you understand the concepts well enough to talk to real estate investors about them." 3. Product Routing (Hard Money vs. EMD) "A real estate investor DMs you and says: 'I have a property under contract in Dallas. I'm doing a sub2 deal but the seller wants $30K earnest money in 5 days or they're walking. Need help fast.' Which of our two products is the right fit, and write the response you'd send them." 4. Public Group Engagement (No Pitching) "Imagine you see a post in a real estate investor Facebook group where someone writes: 'Looking for capital for a fix-and-flip in Phoenix. Any creative ideas?' — Write the comment you would leave on that PUBLIC post. The comment should NOT pitch our service directly." 5. The Warm DM (Hard Money) "Following your comment in Question 4, the person engages with you. Now write the DM you would send them to start a conversation about hard money options for their flip." 6. Handling a Tricky Inbound "A real estate investor replies to your DM and says: 'What's your interest rate and how fast can you close? I'll only fill out a form if I know the numbers.' — Write the response you'd send." 7. Daily Discipline "This role requires ~50–60 outreach touches per day, Mon–Fri, in real estate investor communities. Walk me through what a productive day looks like for you — including how you stay focused, how you avoid getting sloppy as fatigue sets in, and what your end-of-day routine looks like." 8. Track Record with Numbers "What outreach tools have you used (LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, PhantomBuster, GHL, etc.)? Share one specific example where your outreach work generated booked appointments — include real numbers (touches ? replies ? booked). Real estate or lending experience preferred. If you don't have numbers, explain why." 9. Real Estate Community Experience "Are you currently active in (or have you worked with clients active in) any of these communities: Pace Morby's Sub2 / Gator Method group, AstroFlipping, BiggerPockets, ---------- Facebook groups, or any US real estate investor community? If yes, describe your experience. If no, are you willing to spend time learning these communities before Day 1?" 10. Time Zone Reality Check "This role works best Mon–Fri during US Central Time business hours (roughly 8am–5pm CT, with flexibility). What is your local time zone, and what specific hours would you commit to each weekday in YOUR local time? Be precise." 11. Past Boss / References "Provide the names and contact info (email or LinkedIn URL) of two former clients or managers who can speak to your appointment-setting work. We may reach out before extending an offer."

title: Outbound Marketing Owner
description: We're a U.S. recruiting / RPO business serving manufacturing leaders, and we're looking for someone to own our outbound marketing end to end — not run a script we hand you, but build, drive, and improve the entire engine that turns a list of target companies into booked conversations. This is a role for an owner, not an executor. We'll point you at our market (~1,500 priority manufacturing accounts) and the outcome we want (real conversations with decision-makers), and you bring the strategy, the tools, and the judgment to get there. If you need to be told each step, this isn't for you. If you've been wanting full ownership of an outreach function — and a direct line between your performance and your pay — keep reading. WHAT YOU'LL OWN: The whole outbound engine — strategy, targeting, messaging, channels, and execution. You own the number: booked meetings with qualified decision-makers. Strategy & ideas — you're expected to bring new tools, channels, and angles to the table, test them, and tell us what's working. We want to learn from you, not just direct you. Targeted research & personalization — we're quality-over-volume (~100 deeply-researched leads/week against our priority accounts, each with a real, specific hook), not mass-blasting. You know how to find the signal that earns a reply. Campaign execution — build and run sequences (we use Instantly; open to your recommendations), test relentlessly, and optimize toward replies and meetings, not send volume. The technical backend — still extremely important and non-negotiable. You own deliverability: sending domains, mailboxes, DNS (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, custom tracking domains), warmup, rotation, and inbox-health monitoring. Setup is front-loaded; keeping placement high is ongoing. If the email s don't hit the inbox, nothing else matters. Tooling — Apollo, Clay / Claygent, verification, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and whatever else you can justify. Recommend the stack; we'll resource what works. WHO YOU ARE: - You've owned outbound or lead-gen before and can point to meetings or deals you drove — not just campaigns you ran. - Confident you can land conversations, and comfortable being measured on it. - A builder and problem-solver who brings ideas rather than waiting for instructions. - Deep on email infrastructure and deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, warmup, 2024+ Google/Yahoo sender rules) — a hard requirement. - Strong with modern outbound tooling (Apollo, Clay, Instantly / Smartlead) and quick to evaluate new ones. - Fluent written English, sharp judgment, and genuine attention to detail. COMPENSATION: $5–10 / hour USD to start, depending on experience — part-time initially. This is a starting point: strong performance moves you up — more hours, a higher base rate, and bigger upside on every meeting and deal you drive. Booked-meeting bonuses: - Meetings 1–20: $20 each - Meetings 21–40: $30 each - Meetings 41+: $40 each (cap) Deal bonuses — once you've hit the meeting cap, you earn on outcomes: $100–$500 per deal that converts into a completed search, scaled by deal size. A "qualified meeting" = a target decision-maker (VP / Director of Manufacturing, Operations, Quality, Plant Manager, President / COO) who attends a genuine fit conversation. No-shows and unqualified contacts don't count. HOW TO APPLY: Send the following: 1. A short note on how you'd approach owning outbound for a recruiting business targeting manufacturers — your angle, your first moves, and the tools you'd reach for. 2. A specific result you've personally driven (meetings or deals), with rough numbers. 3. Screenshots from Instantly / Smartlead showing your reply rates and inbox health. 4. Your answer to: what's the difference between DMARC p=none, p=quarantine, and p=reject, and which do you use during warmup? 5. Your rate and availability. Generic applications won't be considered. We're looking for an owner — show us how you think. GenioSys | Recruiting built for manufacturers | geniosys.ai

Primary responsibilities: • LoRA trainer optimization — improving and tuning the LoRA training setup itself: training configs, hyperparameters (rank, learning rate, scheduler), trainer settings, and pipeline efficiency, to maximize output quality while reducing training time and cost. This is about optimizing how LoRAs are trained, not manually collecting datasets or babysitting training runs. Deep hands-on knowledge of AI-Toolkit and Musubi Tuner is required. • Base-model fine-tuning — full fine-tuning of open-source base models, with the same optimization mindset toward configs, training efficiency, and output quality. • Workflow optimization — designing, building, and continuously improving ComfyUI workflows; optimizing node graphs, render efficiency, VRAM usage, batching, and model offloading for repeatable, production-grade output. • Training pipeline optimization — improving training speed, cost, stability, and quality; managing and optimizing multi-GPU training runs. • Evaluation & iteration — building systematic evaluation methods to compare configs, checkpoints, and training approaches, and iterating toward measurable quality gains. description: DON'T APPLY IF >>>>> Please read carefully. We would like applicants to have tests, IQ and identity above 80%. Also please submit your best samples as they are factored for alignment with our quality. Backlink & AI Visibility Specialist (SEO · AEO · GEO) We're a digital marketing agency specializing in trades and construction businesses, and we're hiring a Backlink & AI Visibility Specialist to build and grow off-page authority for our own brand and our clients' brands — and to make sure those brands are accurately cited and surfaced by AI-powered search engines, large language models (LLMs), and answer engines. This is a hybrid role that bridges traditional link building with two emerging disciplines: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). You'll work across multiple client accounts, so you should already have a vetted list of backlink sources and placements you've personally used with success. Experience: 2–5 years in link building or SEO Employment type: Full-time (contract options available) Focus areas: Link building + AEO/GEO + AI search & LLM citation Core link-building responsibilities Research and prospect link targets using Ahrefs, Semrush, and Moz — but prioritize niche relevance and real editorial traffic over raw DA/DR scores. A relevant link from a trade publication beats twenty links from high-authority sites no one reads Run journalist-source and digital-PR outreach (email , LinkedIn) using current platforms — Qwoted, Source of Sources (SOS), ---------- , and #JournoRequest on X (HARO/Connectively shut down in Dec 2024; don't rely on it) — to earn guest posts, editorial links, resource-page placements, and press coverage Conduct competitor backlink analysis to identify gaps and replicate genuinely earnable, high-value opportunities Monitor backlink profiles, identify toxic links, and submit disavow requests via Google Search Console Work with the content team to develop linkable assets — original data studies, surveys, infographics, and long-form guides that publishers actually want to cite Local citations & directory management Manually build and manage local citations and business directory listings across Canadian and North American platforms — the kind of work a tool like BrightLocal automates, done by hand for accuracy and full control Set up new accounts and complete listings from scratch where needed, keeping NAP (Name, Address, Phone) data consistent across every directory Work from a provided master list of target directories for manual entry, and proactively flag additional niche- or region-relevant directories worth adding Keep listings current over time — updating details, removing duplicates, and verifying entries AEO, GEO & LLM citation responsibilities Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Optimize content to be selected as the direct answer in Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, voice assistants, and featured snippets Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Ensure our brands, products, and content are accurately represented and cited in outputs from generative AI models including ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini Audit how — and whether — our brands are cited in LLM outputs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and track citation frequency, accuracy, and sentiment over time Earn mentions and citations on the sources AI answer engines index most heavily — authoritative publications, industry wikis, Reddit, Quora, and reputable government/educational domains Note: many of these placements are "no-follow" and won't pass traditional link equity. For AEO/GEO that's expected — the goal is AI citation and entity strength, not PageRank. We want someone who understands that distinction. Structure content for extraction: lead with a direct 40–60 word answer block, use FAQ schema, speakable schema, and clear entity definitions, and write in an objective, declarative voice (AI engines down-weight "we think / in our opinion" hedging) Keep content fresh and specific — recency and concrete statistics are heavily weighted, especially by Perplexity, which refreshes near-daily and cites 4–8 sources per answer Make sure AI crawlers can actually read the page: critical text rendered server-side (not injected by client-side JavaScript), and the right crawler access configured (e.g. OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT search eligibility, distinct from GPTBot training access) Develop and execute digital PR strategies aimed at earning mentions on high-E-E-A-T domains that serve as training and retrieval sources for AI models Strengthen entity recognition across AI systems by optimizing Knowledge Panels, Wikidata entries, and third-party review platforms (G2, Trustpilot, Clutch) How we work — our standards (non-negotiables) Link building in 2026 is about earning citations and trust, not gaming volume. We expect you to: Earn, don't manipulate. No PBNs, link farms, paid link networks, comment spam, or scaled/automated link schemes. Google's spam updates penalize these, and one bad shortcut can damage a client account we've spent months building. Manually vet every target. Real editorial standards, real organic traffic, real topical relevance — not just a metric in a tool. Disclose paid placements with rel="sponsored" where applicable. Build relationships, not one-offs. Repeat publisher relationships beat cold-blasting templates that editors delete on sight. Honour the human edit pass. Any AI-assisted outreach or content draft gets a human voice + accuracy review before it goes out. Drafts are never sent or published raw. How we measure success This role is tracked against clear outputs, reviewed monthly. You'll work from a shared tracker (provided) and keep it current. Core KPIs: Links/citations earned — count, by type (editorial, guest, resource, directory, digital PR) and by client Quality of placements — relevance + real traffic, not just DR/DA Live link survival rate — placements that stay live and indexed Citation tracking (AEO/GEO): a monthly prompt audit — run 20–30 buyer-intent prompts per client across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, logging whether the brand is cited, citation accuracy, and sentiment over time Local citation health — directory listings live, NAP-consistent, duplicate-free Toxic-link monitoring — flagged and disavowed as needed Detailed recurring tasks, cadence, and tracking columns live in the accompanying VA task tracker. What we're looking for 2–5 years of hands-on link building or SEO experience A documented track record of placements you can show us (live URLs) Working knowledge of AEO/GEO is a strong plus; if you don't have it yet, you must be able to learn it fast Comfortable with high-volume, detail-accurate manual data entry — citation and directory work rewards consistency and care Honest grasp of what does and doesn't work — e.g., why self-placed Wikipedia links get reverted and how legitimate, policy-compliant entity presence is actually built Details Full-time, with contract options available pay range, weekly hours, and any time zone overlap you require] How to apply To be considered, your application must include: Your 3–5 best link-building or digital-PR samples — live URLs, each with a one-line note on why it mattered. Samples are weighted heavily; they're how we judge fit against our quality bar. ID Proof and IQ scores of 80% or higher on your profile

description: This is not a task on a list. This is the engine. I am building TalkTuit, an AI communications platform for the trades, plumbing and HVAC first. The product is the entry point. I know exactly what it feels like to miss the phone while you are buried in a job, because I have lived both sides of it. I am not looking for hands to rent. I am looking for a great engineer who wants to keep doing what they are great at, on something that actually means something, and own a real piece of the outcome. The integration layer: connect those agents to ANY CRM a client already runs, through APIs and webhooks, never locked to one platform. The automation layer: end to end workflows (n8n and similar) that onboard clients, sync data, and run the business with as little human touch as possible. The growth engine: an automated demo system where a prospect replies to an email and, within minutes, the system provisions a number, builds a personalized voice demo from their website, and sends it to them to try. The self-healing layer: monitoring and recovery so each client system and each internal system diagnoses and repairs itself, plus a recurring automated audit that catches problems before the client ever sees them. All of it on AWS, data rich, cost efficient at scale, documented, and clean enough to transfer at an exit. Who you are You have built and shipped real production systems on AWS, not just demos. You live in AI agents and automation, and you can reason about architecture, not just wire up tools. Voice AI experience is a strong plus. CRM and API integration experience is a strong plus. You can work mostly independently and own outcomes, with some overlap with US Eastern time for working sessions. A person or a small team is both fine. If you bring a bench, even better. This is a partnership, not a job So we do not waste each other's time: this is structured as a partnership for the right fit. Revenue share that begins when revenue does, plus participation in the company's exit. Real upside, tied to what you help build, with the heavy lifting front loaded and the rewards compounding behind it. I keep majority ownership and control. You get a stake worth caring about. We talk specifics once we both know it is a fit. If you want a steady hourly ticket with daily tasks handed to you, this honestly is not it, and that is okay. The honest bar I have interviewed a lot of people. This is one final round to find the rare fit I have not met yet. If the scope excited you instead of scaring you, I want to hear from you. How to apply Start your message with the word BUILT so I know you read this all the way through. Business Credit ($100K–$350K at 0% for 12–18 months) — for entrepreneurs and real estate investors with strong personal credit (700+ FICO) wanting to scale. Intake: ---------- 2. Credit Repair / Credit Consulting— for prospects who need to rebuild credit (bankruptcies, late payments, inquiries) before they can qualify for funding. you're running outbound by end of Week 2 - Long-term upside: After 60 days of consistent performance, we'll discuss either a rate increase or moving to a performance-bonus structure How to Apply - Please read carefully. To filter out copy-paste applications: 1. Include the phrase "PURPLE GIRAFFE" at the very top of your application. If it's not there, I will not read further. 2. Answer the screening questions below thoughtfully — not in one-sentence answers. 3. Record a 60-second Loom video introducing yourself in English. Tell me (a) why this role interests you and (b) one specific example of appointment-setting success from your past work, with numbers. Paste the Loom link in your application. Screening Questions 1. Compliance & Language Rewrite "Below is a sample message draft: 'Hi [name] — you're guaranteed to be approved for $200K in business credit. Just fill out our form and you'll get the money.' What is wrong with this message from a compliance standpoint, and how would you rewrite it to be safer while still being effective?" 2. Product Routing (Business Credit vs. Credit Repair) "A prospect DMs you and says: 'I want to get business credit but I have a few collections on my credit report and my score is around 620.' Which of our two products is the right fit, and write the response you'd send them." 3. Public Group Engagement (No Pitching) "Imagine you see a post in a Facebook entrepreneur group where someone writes: 'Trying to figure out how to fund inventory for my e-commerce business — banks keep rejecting me.' — Write the comment you would leave on that PUBLIC post. The comment should NOT pitch our service directly." 4. The Warm DM (Business Credit) "Following your comment in Question 3, the person likes your comment and replies thoughtfully. You are the right person if You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process. You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers. You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Facebook — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform. You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased. You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process to do your best work. job_title: Operations & Client Coordination Assistant, Keep Clients Answered & Devs Moving
description: About the business I run a web design and development consultancy serving US-based clients. I handle strategy, design direction, client relationships, and sales. I also work with developers who help execute the web development projects. The business is growing, but too many operational details still depend on me. The real problem Client requests, developer follow-ups, task tracking, timelines, invoices, and project updates all flow through me. When I get busy, replies take too long, completed work waits for review, invoices get delayed, and project details slip. I need someone reliable to help run the operational layer around the work so I can focus on strategy, design, and sales. Your job is to help make sure: Clients get timely responses Developers know exactly what needs to be done Completed work doesn't sit unreviewed Notion stays accurate Invoices are prepared on time I know what needs my attention each morning What you'll do Client communication support: Monitor client requests in Gmail and other channels I give you access to Draft replies, follow-ups, and project updates for my review Prepare weekly client update drafts based on project progress Send new-client welcome email s and help make sure the onboarding process runs smoothly Flag anything urgent, unclear, or at risk of becoming a problem Task and project coordination: Turn client requests into clear internal tasks for developers Keep Notion updated with tasks, statuses, owners, and deadlines Watch for stalled tasks and follow up Prepare a daily brief showing what needs attention, what's blocked, and what's next Developer follow-up: Monitor developer submissions Check whether the delivered work matches the client request Do basic QA: links, copy, responsive behavior, forms, screenshots, and obvious inconsistencies If something is incomplete or unclear, ask the developer to fix or clarify it Admin and invoicing: Prepare invoices using my existing formula and template Organize project notes and client information Help document repeatable processes as SOPs while we work, so the system gets stronger over time What this role is NOT: This is not a passive "wait for instructions" role. I need someone who follows up, notices when something is sitting too long, and reminds me when I'm the bottleneck. If a developer submission has been waiting for review, you ping me. If a client request is unclear, you flag it. If a deadline is getting close, you bring it up early. You help create the operating system around my work, so fewer things depend on my memory. You won't make final decisions on client communication, scope, pricing, or invoices at first. I'll approve anything client-facing or financial before it goes out. But you'll own the preparation and the follow-up. As trust builds, you'll get more autonomy over routine decisions. Requirements: Excellent written English. You'll draft email s my US clients read. This is non-negotiable. Strong attention to detail. The whole point is that nothing falls through the cracks. Hands-on Notion experience. You should already know how to work in it. Comfortable organizing tasks, deadlines, and project information. Proactive communication. You follow up and don't go silent. Comfortable working asynchronously across time zones. Reliable internet (with a backup plan for outages) and a quiet setup for occasional video calls. Bonus: experience with web design, web development, agencies, project coordination, or client service. Working style You should be structured, communicative, and comfortable reminding people (including me) when something needs attention. I'm looking for someone who creates order, not someone who needs every next step explained every day. How to apply Start your message with the word PROACTIVE. Applications that don't start with this word will be ignored. Then answer these questions: Tell me about one specific time you caught something before it became a problem. I want a real example, not a generic answer like "I always double-check my work." Have you used Notion for task or project tracking? Describe how. Write a short sample client update based on this situation: The homepage revisions are done and ready for the client to review. The mobile layout still needs one small adjustment, which the developer is handling today. You expect to send the final review link tomorrow. What is your expected monthly salary for 20 hours/week? What hours do you usually work, in Philippine time? Link to your CV, portfolio, or any relevant work samples. Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small paid test task, estimated at 60-90 minutes.

title: 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control
job_title: 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control
description: That is a great addition! However, it is important to note that **Adobe Character Animator and Kling Motion Control use completely different animation technologies.** * **Adobe Character Animator** is traditional 2D puppeteering. It requires a complex, layered file with all the limbs, facial features, and mouth shapes completely separated. * **Kling Motion Control (on Higgsfield)** is generative AI video. It does *not* use a rigged file or layers. Instead, it requires a single, pristine, high-resolution flat image of the character—ideally in a neutral, unobstructed stance (like a standing A-pose) where the AI can clearly see the entire body, proportions, and face without overlapping limbs. Since the contractor will already be re-drawing and cleaning up the Illustrator file, they can easily provide both. They just need to export a specific version of the character optimized for your AI workflow. Here is the updated job posting with the Higgsfield/Kling requirements integrated: ### **Job Title:** 2D Illustrator & Animator: Rig Mascot (.ai) for Adobe Character Animator & AI Motion Control ### **Job Overview:** We are looking for a skilled 2D illustrator and animator to take our existing company mascot (currently a flat vector logo in an Adobe Illustrator .ai file) and prepare it for two distinct video workflows. First, we need it converted into a fully functional, rigged digital puppet for **Adobe Character Animator**. Second, we need a clean, optimized export of the character prepared for AI motion transfer using **Kling Motion Control via the Higgsfield AI platform**. If you have experience preparing vector assets for both traditional 2D rigging (custom triggers/visemes) and AI video generation, we want to hear from you! ### **Scope of Work & Responsibilities:** 1. **Asset Preparation (Adobe Illustrator):** Open our existing vector mascot file, clean up the paths, and separate the character into the strict, correctly named layer hierarchy required by Adobe Character Animator (e.g., separating eyes, pupils, eyebrows, blinking states, mouth shapes/visemes, torso, and limbs). 2. **AI Motion Control Prep (Kling/Higgsfield):** Using the cleaned vector, create a high-resolution, full-body flat export of the character in a neutral standing pose (or A-pose). Ensure there are no overlapping limbs or objects obstructing the face/body, as this will be used as the base reference image for AI motion tracking and element binding. 3. **Puppet Rigging (Adobe Character Animator):** Import the prepared .ai file into Character Animator and build a complete, high-quality puppet rig. 4. **Triggers & Controls:** Set up auto lip-syncing, eye-gaze tracking, and breathing behaviors. Create keyboard triggers for basic gestures (such as a hand wave, a point, or changing facial expressions). 5. **Testing & Optimization:** Ensure the puppet deforms smoothly without visual glitches during webcam tracking. ### **Project Deliverables:** * The newly organized, layered Adobe Illustrator (.ai) file. * The final, fully rigged Adobe Character Animator (.puppet) file ready for use. * A high-resolution, full-body flat .png (unobstructed, neutral pose) optimized specifically for Kling AI / Higgsfield. * A 10-second test recording (.mp4) showing the Character Animator puppet's functionality. ### **How to Apply:** Please submit your application with the following: 1. A brief introduction about your experience with Adobe Character Animator and preparing character assets for animation. 2. **Links to your portfolio or specific examples of puppets you have rigged in Adobe Character Animator.** (Applications without relevant video or puppet samples will not be considered). 3. Your estimated turnaround time for a project like this. *To ensure you have read this entire job post, please start your cover letter with the word **"ANIMATOR"** in all capital letters. Generic, copy-pasted applications will be ignored.*

I am not looking for a basic VA, data entry assistant, general social media poster, or Canva content creator. I own a large Facebook group called ---------- Contractors For Hire with over 78,000 members. The group serves homeowners, contractors, trades, vendors, and home-service businesses in the Dallas-Fort Worth area. I am launching a paid Preferred Contractor / Sponsor Program and need someone experienced to help structure it, manage sponsor inquiries, keep the group clean, and help grow the community. You must have direct experience managing or helping manage an active Facebook group, online community, membership community, local business group, marketplace group, or sponsor/advertiser program. If you have not managed group posts, comments, spam, member issues, sponsor inquiries, paid listings, or community engagement before, do not apply. The goal is to monetize the group without turning it into a spam group. Main responsibilities: Manage pending posts and comments. Remove spam, scams, and low-quality posts. Reply to sponsor inquiries using approved scripts. Send sponsor package information to interested contractors. Collect business information through Google Forms. Update sponsor tracking in Google Sheets. Maintain a Preferred Contractor Directory. Draft weekly sponsored contractor spotlight posts. Create weekly engagement posts to grow the group. Welcome new members. Track sponsor leads and follow-ups. Send a daily report to the owner. Important: You will not handle payments. You will not receive my Facebook password. You will not be added as a Facebook admin. You may be added as a moderator after trust is established. The owner handles all payments, pricing, sponsor approvals, and final approvals. Minimum requirements — applications without this will be ignored: Direct Facebook group or online community management experience. Experience moderating posts, comments, spam, member complaints, or group rules. Experience replying to sponsor leads, advertisers, business owners, or sales inquiries. Experience using Google Sheets to track leads, follow-ups, status, and notes. Strong written English. Organized and detail-focused. Comfortable using Facebook Groups, Messenger, Google Sheets, Google Forms, Canva, and ChatGPT. Able to follow written rules exactly. Able to work independently without needing constant instruction. Able to show examples or clearly explain past community/group work. Preferred experience: Experience with contractor, real estate, home services, local business, marketplace, or lead-generation communities. Experience selling or managing sponsorships, paid placements, featured listings, or directory listings. Experience growing Facebook groups without spamming. Experience building or managing sponsor/advertiser tracking systems. To be considered, you must provide at least one of the following: A Facebook group or online community you helped manage. A screenshot or example of community/moderation/sponsor work. A description of a sponsor or paid-listing system you managed. A clear example of lead tracking, advertiser follow-up, or community monetization work. Work schedule: Part-time to start. 10–15 hours per week. Must be available for at least 2 hours of overlap with Texas business hours. Compensation: Starting pay is $4–$5/hour, depending on proven experience. Performance bonuses are available: Basic Directory Listing sold — $10 bonus Preferred Contractor sponsor sold — $25 bonus Category Sponsor sold — $50 bonus Weekly Sponsored Spotlight sold — $25 bonus Bonuses are paid only after the sponsor has paid the owner and the sponsor has been approved. Work Terms / Trial Structure: This is a part-time 30-day paid trial contractor role. It is not a full-time job at the start. Expected workload is approximately 10–15 hours per week. Hours must be approved by the owner. Hours must be tracked and submitted weekly for approval. The contractor will be paid only for approved hours and approved assigned work completed during the trial. There is no guaranteed long-term employment. If performance is strong, this can become a long-term part-time role with more hours. Either side may end the trial if it is not a good fit. The owner handles all payments, pricing, final approvals, sponsor approval, and Facebook admin access. The contractor will not receive my Facebook password, bank access, payment account access, or Facebook administrator access. Application instructions: To apply, put DFW GROUP MANAGER at the top of your message. Your first sentence must answer this: What is the largest Facebook group or online community you have personally helped manage, and what exactly did you do? Then answer these questions: What Facebook groups or online communities have you managed before? What was the largest group size? Did you approve/decline posts, remove spam, handle comments, or deal with member complaints? Have you ever helped monetize a group, directory, or community? Have you ever managed sponsor leads, paid placements, featured posts, advertisers, or business leads? How would you monetize a 78,000-member contractor/home-services group without turning it into spam? What Texas-time hours can you work? What is your hourly rate? What proof or examples can you provide of similar work? Do not apply if you only have basic VA experience and have never managed a Facebook group, online community, sponsor program, or advertiser/lead system.

title: Level 2 Service Desk Specialist

title: Heir Property Acquisitions Specialist – Tax Delinquent & Multi-Heir Properties
job_title: Heir Property Acquisitions Specialist – Tax Delinquent & Multi-Heir Properties
description: We are a Texas-based real estate investor specializing in tax-delinquent and heir properties. Our goal is to help families resolve back taxes, liens, and messy title issues by securing sign-overs or partial-interest purchases so we can clear the property and either fix-and-flip, wholesale, or hold it. This is NOT a high-volume cold-calling role. We focus on low-volume, high-depth, consultative conversations. You will build genuine rapport, map full family trees, uncover pain points, and persistently contact every necessary heir/sibling/co-owner — even if the first person says “no” — to gather information for affidavits of heirship and secure sign-overs or majority interest. Schedule Full-time – 40 hours per week (8 paid hours per day) Daily hours, you pick: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM CST (with one 1-hour unpaid break) I would love someone who can work both Saturday and Sunday. I'm flexible on the schedule though. So no weekends isn't a deal breaker (Perfect schedule: 10am-7pm. Wednesday–Sunday) Key Responsibilities: Work provided skip-traced tax-delinquent and heir lists (multiple phone numbers per lead). Make targeted dials daily— quality over quantity. Build deep rapport and have longer, consultative conversations. Ask discovery questions to uncover pain points (tax stress, inheritance burdens, family disputes, maintenance costs, etc.). Map the full family tree and contact siblings, co-heirs, or anyone else who must sign paperwork. If the primary contact doesn’t answer or declines, immediately research and reach the other family members to keep the opportunity alive. Gather detailed heir information needed for affidavits of heirship and partial-interest agreements. Log accurate notes in our CRM on each family member’s position and motivations. All calls are recorded for coaching and quality. Compensation: Base pay (the wage listed is base pay only and does not include bonuses). You will also earn performance bonuses for every closed deal. Solid performers who consistently get deals will receive pay increases — the more money you help me make, the more I’m willing to pay. Additional compensation is provided for bilingual Spanish speakers. Job Requirements: Excellent spoken English with a clear, warm, professional phone presence. Strong natural rapport-building and listening skills. Comfortable with persistence and pivoting conversations smoothly (e.g., turning a “no” into contacting other heirs). Must be comfortable using Screenshot Monitor (we provide the account and training) for time tracking and coaching purposes. Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, and quality headset. Coachable and excited to learn Texas heirship laws, UPHPA, and our exact process. Mandatory Application Step: Complete the free DISC behavioral assessment and attach the PDF with your results to your application. ---------- -Applications without the DISC PDF will not be considered.- To Apply Reply with: 1. Your completed DISC test PDF (required) 2. A voice recording (Read the sample script below naturally) 3. Reply with your preferred schedule CST. I would like your working schedule to be (Wednesday - Sunday) Weekends have the highest pick up rate which means you will close more deals and earn more bonuses. Im open to what schedule works best for you. Sample Script: Hey Hubert, this is [Your First Name]. I do genealogy and title work here in Texas, Do you happen to know [Deceased’s Full Name] by chance?

title: Cold Email Specialist (Infrastructure + Copy + Deliverability, Full Stack) - Long-Term

description: Compensation: $600 to $1,000 USD per month based on what you can prove. Hours: 40 hours per week. Some overlap with Morocco, Dubai, and EU business hours required (Manila 3 PM to 11 PM works for us; flexible within that range). READ THIS FIRST This is not an entry-level role. We are not looking for someone who watched a "cold email in 2026" YouTube playlist and sent 200 email s from their Gmail. We are looking for someone who has built sending infrastructure from zero, run real campaigns at volume, kept domains healthy, and booked real meetings for a real business. If that's not you yet, this isn't your post. If your experience is "I wrote cold email copy for a client once" or "I managed a VA team that did outreach", stop reading. The tests will expose it in an hour. ABOUT RMD RMD is a digital marketing agency. Our team is distributed across Morocco and Dubai and works remote. Our primary client base is in Dubai and the GCC, with growing work across the EU and North Africa. We run SEO, paid ads, branding, and web development for service businesses, e-commerce stores, and B2B companies in 20+ countries. WHAT THIS ROLE IS You own our outbound email machine end to end. Not just the copy. Not just the sending tool. The whole stack: 1. Infrastructure: secondary domains, mailboxes, DNS, warmup, sending health 2. Data: sourcing lead lists, cleaning them, verifying them, segmenting them 3. Copy: short plain-text sequences that get replies, not opens 4. Operations: campaign builds, launch checklists, inbox management, meeting booking, weekly reporting We already run a multi-domain, multi-mailbox sending setup on Instantly with a live campaign program into the GCC. You will take it over, keep it healthy, and scale it: first for RMD's own client acquisition, then for client campaigns as we grow the service. If you only want to write copy and hand the "technical stuff" to someone else, this role isn't a fit. The technical stuff IS the role. Copy that never lands in the inbox is decoration. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Set up and maintain sending infrastructure: buy secondary domains, configure SPF / DKIM / DMARC, create mailboxes, set custom tracking domains, run warmup, monitor health scores - Source lead lists by niche, title, and country (Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator + scraper, LeadRocks, or equivalent), with GCC and EU targeting - Clean and verify every list before upload: strip free email domains, dedupe, verify (Reoon, MillionVerifier, or equivalent), enrich missing fields, make the catch-all keep-or-cut call - Write 3-step plain-text sequences (opener, bump, breakup) with personalization variables that actually render, and iterate them on reply-rate data - Build and launch campaigns in Instantly: schedules in the prospect's timezone and work week (much of the GCC runs Sunday to Thursday, the UAE runs Monday to Friday), stop-on-reply, text-only, daily caps per mailbox, domain-clustering caps per recipient company - Diagnose deliverability problems before they kill a domain: bounce spikes, spam placement, blacklists, when to pause vs rotate vs retire a mailbox - Manage the reply inbox daily: triage, answer objections, push for the meeting, book it on the calendar, hand the warm lead to the CEO with context - Report weekly with the numbers that matter: delivered, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings booked per 1,000 sends, infra health - Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) as part of the daily workflow. AI is openly used in the agency, not as a shortcut to skip thinking - Communicate with the team in writing daily (email , ClickUp). Updates short, blockers raised early REQUIRED (WE WILL VERIFY ALL OF THIS) - 2+ years running cold email campaigns end to end. Sourcing to inbox to booked meeting. Not "I wrote sequences". Ran the machine. - 2 campaigns from the last 12 months you can walk through with numbers: niche, list size, total sends, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings or sales calls booked. With platform screenshots (redact client names if NDA). We will dig into these on the test and the call. - You have built sending infrastructure from zero, yourself. Domains bought, DNS records configured (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), mailboxes created on Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, warmup run, custom tracking domain set. Be ready to explain each DNS record's job in plain words. - Instantly in production. Smartlead or lemlist accepted if you can map over fast, but you should know your way around a sending platform's campaign builder, schedules, account health, and code/variable view without a tutorial. - One deliverability save you can tell start to finish. A domain or mailbox that started burning (bounces, spam folder, health drop), what you checked, what the root cause was, what fixed it, and what the numbers did after. "I just slowed the sending" is not a save story. - List building in production. You have pulled targeted B2B lists by title + industry + country from Apollo, Sales Navigator + a scraper, LeadRocks, or equivalent, and you know why a narrow GCC query returns 9 results while the same query in the US returns 9,000. - Email verification workflow. You verify every list before upload, you know the difference between valid, invalid, catch-all, and unknown, and you can defend when a catch-all is worth the bounce risk. - Copy that gets replies. Short, plain text, one idea per email , specific CTA, follow-ups that bump instead of re-pitching. You can name your benchmark reply rate by market and what you change first when a campaign comes in under it. - Reply handling to booked meetings. You have personally worked an outbound inbox: objections, "send me more info", ghosting, and you have booked meetings from it. Outbound that ends at "positive reply" is half a job. - Cold email canon. You have studied at least 2 of: Nick Saraev, Alex Hormozi ($100M Leads, the outreach chapters), Eric Nowoslawski, Daniel Fazio, Jay Feldman. Name a principle from one of them and point to a campaign above where you used it. - English fluency at C1 or higher. Your email s read like a human wrote them, not a template engine. - Stable internet, quiet workspace, 40 hours per week available. If we struggle to find the profile at this exact bar, we may relax the experience minimum case-by-case. We will not relax the campaign-numbers + infrastructure + deliverability evidence floor. BONUS (NOT REQUIRED) - Clay (enrichment workflows, waterfall verification) - Google Postmaster Tools and inbox placement testing in production - B2B experience in GCC, EU, or US markets specifically - French (we have France and North Africa clients) - Light automation (Zapier, Make) for lead routing and reporting - LinkedIn outreach experience alongside email (multichannel sequencing) WHO WE HIRE - People who ship the work and don't disappear - People who want a long-term role, not a gig - People who can take direction in writing, push back when they think we're wrong, and own a deliverable end to end - People who can show their work, not just describe it WHAT WE OFFER - $600 to $1,000 USD per month based on what you can prove. Top of band reserved for candidates who hit every "Required" item with evidence. - Direct work with the CEO and a small team. Your campaigns ship for real in week one - Real growth, not lip service. This is a role you grow OUT of, not stagnate in. The path here is cold email specialist, then outbound lead, then head of a productized outbound service we sell to clients. If you stay 18 months, you should not be doing the same work you started with. - You get to do more, fast. As you prove yourself, you take on more: client campaigns, strategy calls, multichannel outbound, junior briefing. We don't ration responsibility. - We reward progress and skill expansion. Learn a new tool, ship a harder deliverable, hit a result the team didn't expect. When that happens, we adjust your pay and scope to match. A-players see significant raises (80%+) within the first year. We measure progress, not seat-time. - Performance bonus structure discussed after the first month - Async-first culture. If you do the work, you'll be left to do it Who this is NOT for: people who want to stay at their current level and improve slowly. We're hiring people who want to move forward. If "comfortable plateau" is your goal, this isn't the seat. HOW TO APPLY Send your application to ---------- with the subject: "Cold Email Specialist PH, [Your Full Name]" In your email , include: 1. A 2-paragraph intro: who you are and why this role fits. 2. 2 campaigns you ran in the last 12 months. For each: niche | list size | total sends | reply rate | positive reply rate | meetings booked. Attach platform screenshots (redact client names if needed). 3. Your infrastructure proof. One setup you built from zero: how many domains and mailboxes, which DNS records you configured, which warmup tool, how long before full sending volume. A screenshot of account health helps. 4. Your deliverability save story in 5-8 sentences: what broke, what you diagnosed, what fixed it, what the numbers did after. 5. Cold email canon answer. Of Saraev / Hormozi / Nowoslawski / Fazio / Feldman: who shaped your approach the most? In 3-5 sentences: which principle of theirs you actually use, and point to a campaign above where you used it. 6. Reading-proof. Start your email body with the line: RMD RMD. (Yes, exactly those two words on the first line. This is how we know you actually read the post.) 7. Your salary expectation in USD per month. 8. When you can start full-time. We read every application that follows the format above. Applications missing the campaign numbers, infrastructure proof, save story, canon answer, or the RMD RMD first line will not be reviewed. We are filtering hard on purpose. If we want to move you to the screening stage, we reply within 5 business days. If you don't hear from us in that window, your application wasn't a fit this round. We're a small team without a dedicated recruiter, so please don't chase. We respect your time enough to be honest about that.

title: Tik Tok Shop Video editor/VA
description: Job Title: Virtual Assistant / Video Editor for TikTok Shop (Beginner Friendly) About the Role I am looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help me with basic video editing for my TikTok Shop account. The tasks are super simple, and beginners are more than welcome to apply! I will provide the raw clips, and your job will be to make quick, basic edits to get them ready for posting. Responsibilities The two most important parts of this job are the following, and they should be your main focus with every video: 1. Cut out all dead space between clips. The videos need to be fast-paced and tight. Any pauses, gaps, or slow ---------- nts between clips must be removed so the viewer stays engaged from start to finish. Retention is everything on TikTok, and a well-paced edit is the number one priority. 2. Add plenty of overlays and photos throughout the video. You will be finding and inserting relevant images and overlays consistently throughout each video to keep the viewer visually stimulated and watching. The more engaging the visuals, the better. In addition to the above, you will also add a few brief onscreen text captions throughout the video to summarize key points. These do not need to be excessive — just enough to reinforce what is being said and help viewers who are watching without sound. Requirements The main technical requirement for this job is that you must have a smartphone capable of downloading and running TikTok Studio. All editing will be done using this specific app, which is completely free and very easy to use. No advanced editing experience is required, and beginners are absolutely fine! You just need to be willing to learn, follow simple instructions, and have a reliable internet connection to receive raw clips and upload the finished videos. Attention to detail is a must. To ensure you are reading this entire job post, at the subject of your application, put your favorite season of the year. If you do not have this, we will not consider you for this job. Pay & Schedule The pay rate for this position is $4.00 USD per hour, paid weekly. You will be required to keep a timesheet logging your hours worked each day, which will be used to calculate your weekly payment. In terms of workload, I typically produce between 4 and 9 videos per day. The editing tasks are intentionally simple, so you should be able to comfortably complete around 4 videos per hour. On a typical day, this means the work will take you roughly 1 to 2.5 hours to complete. Workflow Raw video clips will be shared with you through a shared Google Drive folder. You will download the clips, edit them using TikTok Studio on your phone, and then re-upload the finished videos back to the same Google Drive folder. No complicated file-sharing tools — just a simple, straightforward process. All edited videos must be returned within 24 hours of receiving the raw clips. For example, if I send you the clips on Monday, I need them back by Tuesday. This turnaround time is essential so I can maintain a consistent daily posting schedule. Growth Opportunity This is not just a one-off project — I am looking for someone to grow with long-term. As my TikTok Shop continues to scale, there will be opportunities for increased hours, additional responsibilities, and higher pay for the right person. If you are reliable, consistent, and take pride in your work, there is a real future here.

This is not a basic social media posting role. Your job is not just to create content. Your job is to find people who are already discussing relevant problems, join the conversation naturally, create interest, and move qualified prospects into a trackable lead path. What You’ll Do You will be responsible for finding and engaging potential buyers across platforms such as: Reddit Facebook Groups TikTok comments YouTube comments X/Twitter Forums Niche online communities Your main tasks will include: Researching buyer-intent conversations online Finding posts, comments, and threads where people are already asking questions or showing interest Leaving useful, natural comments that contribute to the discussion Starting conversations through replies and DMs without sounding spammy Qualifying prospects based on problem, interest, urgency, and buying intent Moving qualified leads to the correct profile, bridge page, landing page, or sales handoff Tracking all activity, links, conversations, clicks, leads, and conversion signals daily Testing different hooks, comment angles, platforms, and outreach styles Reporting what is producing real conversations and buyer signals What We’re Looking For We need someone who is a hunter, not just a poster. You should be able to: Write strong, natural English Sound like a real person in online communities Understand how Reddit, Facebook groups, TikTok, YouTube comments, and X work Identify buying intent from comments and discussions Start conversations without sounding like a marketer Follow daily activity targets Track your work clearly Think strategically about where buyers are hiding online Adapt your messaging based on what gets responses This Role Is Good For You If You enjoy: Searching online for active conversations Commenting and replying naturally Starting DMs and building conversations Testing angles and seeing what gets traction Working with clear daily targets Turning organic activity into measurable leads This Role Is NOT For You If This is not a fit if you only know how to: Schedule posts Make Canva graphics Write generic captions Wait for people to engage Copy-paste spammy comments Say “check my link” everywhere Report activity without producing leads We are looking for someone who can create real opportunities, not just activity. Daily Targets You will be expected to hit daily activity and lead-generation targets such as: Find 20+ relevant buyer-intent posts, threads, or comments Leave 25–40 useful comments or replies Start 10–15 conversations or DMs Generate 3–5 qualified leads or strong buyer signals Track clicks, replies, conversations, and lead quality daily Weekly Success Metrics Success in this role means: Consistent qualified buyer conversations Trackable clicks to profiles, bridge pages, or landing pages Clear lead reports Strong platform and angle testing Sales opportunities passed to the team Evidence that organic activity is creating real buyer interest Requirements Strong written English Experience with organic outreach, community engagement, lead generation, or social selling Familiarity with Reddit, Facebook Groups, TikTok, YouTube, and X Ability to research and find buyer conversations manually Comfortable with daily reporting Able to work independently and hit targets Must understand the difference between spam and natural engagement How To Apply Please answer the questions below: What platforms have you used for organic lead generation? How would you find people online who are already interested in a product before they ever see an ad? Give an example of a natural comment you would leave on a post where someone is asking for product recommendations. How would you move someone from a public comment into a DM without sounding spammy? What would you track daily to prove that your work is producing leads? Have you generated leads before through comments, DMs, groups, or communities? Explain your result. Applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.

description: Most editors who apply to this will be ignored. That is not us being rude. It is us being honest. Most of all, we want someone who wants to be part of a team that is always learning and pushing the craft forward. We do not care how many years you have been editing. We care about your work. Your portfolio d ---------- this, not your resume. Pay: Up to PHP 100,000 per month for the right person, based on your skill and your portfolio. How to apply: • Your portfolio link. About the brand Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook . You can show us accounts you have worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, and what happened after. You think in systems. You do not wing it. You have a repeatable process for researching a brand, building a content strategy, and delivering direction that a team can execute consistently. You understand the difference between content that builds an audience and content that converts that audience into buyers — and you know how to build both into a strategy at the same time. What this role involves Deep dive into the Keenya Kelly brand — audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors — and develop a content strategy tailored to where we are going, not just where we have been Deliver weekly content ideas for Instagram, Facebook , and TikTok — including hooks, format direction, caption angles, and CTAs that connect to our active offers Deliver Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram Build and hand over a content system our team can run — including a competitor database, hook library, and content direction framework Join bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle Adapt content direction during active launch periods — we run live challenges, webinars, and course launch campaigns that require content to shift with the offer What this role does NOT involve You will not be posting, scheduling, editing videos, designing graphics, managing DMs or comments, or handling any execution. Our team handles all of that. Your job is strategy and content direction only. You are the right person if You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Facebook — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process to do your best work You communicate proactively and do not go silent when things come up This is not the right role if You need to control execution in order to stand behind your strategy You are still building your process and learning as you go You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown and monetized You struggle with structure, deadlines, or communicating your own process clearly How to apply Your application must include: 1. A brief description of your content strategy framework or system — how you approach a new brand from day one 2. Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize — include the platform, the follower growth, and the revenue or conversion results 3. Your availability and your rate for part-time consulting work Applications that do not include proof of results will not be reviewed. We are looking for someone ready to work alongside an established brand, not build one from scratch.
