title: Founding Ecommerce Lead
description: Summary: We're building a new, modern direct-to-consumer brand focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences. We believe ecommerce is more than just a website – it's the engine that connects our brand, customers, products, and operations.  As one of the first dedicated hires for the business, you'll have a unique opportunity to help shape how we grow from day one. This isn't a role where you'll inherit a playbook – you'll help write it. We're looking for someone who's excited by the challenge of rolling up their sleeves and building something new. Someone who enjoys solving problems, learning new skills, and wearing multiple hats as the business evolves. If you're energized by turning ideas into reality and making a tangible impact every day, you'll feel right at home. As the business grows, this role offers significant opportunity to grow alongside it, with the chance to help shape future success of the brand. The Role: As our Ecommerce Lead, you'll own the day-to-day management and performance of our website, playing a key role in driving revenue growth and delivering an exceptional digital customer experience. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategy and execution. One day, you might be reviewing sales performance, testing new Shopify apps, or optimizing the customer journey. The next, you could be writing product copy, troubleshooting a site issue, coordinating a product launch, or identifying new opportunities for growth. Working closely with leaders across product design, creative, marketing, and technology, you'll turn ideas into execution while continually improving how customers discover, shop, and engage with our brand. You'll have meaningful ownership, broad exposure across the business, and significant influence over the future direction of the website experience. Job Duties & Responsibilities: Build & Grow the Website Experience -Own the day-to-day management of our Shopify storefront and all of its elements. -Monitor sales performance and identify opportunities to improve growth. -Help plan promotions, product launches, and merchandising strategies. -Continuously improve the customer journey from homepage through checkout. Create Outstanding Customer Experiences -Ensure products, collections, pricing, and promotions are presented accurately. -Improve navigation, merchandising, and overall shopping experience. -Identify customer pain points and implement practical improvements. -Work closely with creative partners to bring campaigns and new launches to life. Use Data to Make Better Decisions -Track key ecommerce metrics including revenue, conversion, AOV, and customer retention. -Build reports that help the team understand what's working and what isn't. -Use customer insights to recommend improvements across the business. -Support experimentation through testing and continuous optimization. Experience, Education & Designations: -5+ years of ecommerce experience in a direct-to-consumer (DTC) environment. -Proven experience managing a Shopify storefront. -Demonstrated success driving ecommerce growth through merchandising, conversion optimization, and customer experience improvements. -Experience with merchandising, promotional planning, and ecommerce trading calendars. -Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, operations, creative, and other business functions. -Managing external agencies and third-party partners. -Experience working in an early-stage or high-growth business is considered an asset. Knowledge, Skills & Attributes: -Strong analytical, commercial, and financial acumen, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. -Proficiency with Shopify and the broader ecommerce ecosystem. -Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and Looker or similar business intelligence platforms. -Experience using Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, or similar customer engagement and behavioral analytics tools. -Familiarity with A/B testing platforms and conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies is considered a strong asset. **Applicants are encouraged to submit their resume, LinkedIn profile, as well as a 1-2 minute introductory video on why they feel they could be a good fit for this position.  Thank you to everyone who applies.

title: Marketing Data Analyst & Ads Specialist
description: Position: Marketing Data Auditor & Ads Specialist Company: Yard Dawgs Lawn Care Location: Remote (Philippines) Hours: Full-time, Monday–Friday (Mountain Time, flexible start) Reports To: Liam Sunstrum, Owner About Us Yard Dawgs Lawn Care is a fast-growing lawn care company operating across 6 locations in Alberta and Saskatchewan, Canada. We provide weed control, fertilizer, aeration, and specialty lawn treatments to over 10,000 customers. We're scaling toward $5M in revenue this year and need someone obsessed with data accuracy to make sure every marketing dollar is tracked and accounted for. The Role We spend heavily on Google Ads, Meta (Facebook /Instagram) Ads, and generate leads through organic and direct channels across 6 locations. We need a detail-oriented person to audit every single lead that comes in each day and ensure the marketing source is accurately tracked from our CRM (HubSpot) into our field service software (Real Green). Our marketing budget decisions depend on the accuracy of this data. Core Responsibilities Daily Lead Source Auditing Audit ALL inbound leads daily (50–100+ leads/day) across phone calls and form submissions Cross-reference HubSpot lead source data against what was entered in Real Green Identify and correct any source mismatches (e.g., a Google Ad lead entered as Organic) Flag unresolvable leads for management review Maintain a daily audit log tracking every lead reviewed, match status, and corrections made Lead Tracking & Reporting Track total leads, qualified leads, and converted customers by source (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Organic, Direct, Referral, Yard Sign, etc.) Track performance by location (Calgary, Edmonton, Red Deer, Medicine Hat, Saskatoon, Regina) Maintain weekly accuracy reports showing rep error rates and source-level mismatch patterns Build and maintain a monthly marketing performance dashboard including: Cost Per Lead, Cost Per Sale, Conversion Rate, LTV:CAC Ratio, and ROI by channel and location Ad Platform & Attribution Monitoring Monitor that Google Ads and Meta Ads leads are being attributed correctly in HubSpot (Paid Search vs. Paid Social vs. Organic, etc.) Verify UTM parameters and tracking templates are working properly across all ad accounts Flag any attribution errors or tracking issues immediately (e.g., Facebook leads showing as Paid Search) Ensure naming conventions are followed across all ad campaigns Bonus (Higher Pay Available) If you are an expert in running Google Ads (Search, Performance Max), Meta Ads (Facebook /Instagram), and can manage ad campaigns end-to-end — strategy, setup, optimization, reporting — we are willing to pay significantly more for the right person. This would expand the role into hands-on ad management across 6 locations in addition to auditing. If you have this experience, include examples of campaigns you've managed, monthly budgets, and results in your application. If you are really good at this and have true HubSpot, Excel, Ads experience we can do between 7-10 USD per hour.

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Fashion Textile Brand
job_title: Full-Time Video Editor for Fashion Textile Brand
description: We are looking for a highly skilled full-time video editor to join our team, a fashion textile brand. We are looking for someone with advanced editing skills, strong taste, and a good eye for fashion, fabric movement, clothing, texture, color, and mood. A big part of this role will be creating videos for social media and video ads, including Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, Meta ads, Google ads, YouTube Shorts, YouTube ads, and eventually longer YouTube or brand storytelling videos. We need someone who can create videos that look beautiful but are also strategic. The goal is to make people stop scrolling, understand the fabric, feel inspired, and want to click, shop, save, or learn more. What We’re Looking For You should understand how hooks work in short-form content and ads, especially the first few seconds of a video. You should be able to create strong openings, clean pacing, tasteful transitions, good text overlays, and videos that communicate the product clearly. You will edit different types of content, such as: * Social media videos * Video ads * Product and fabric movement videos * UGC-style videos * Founder/voiceover videos * Educational fabric videos * AI-assisted creative videos For our brand, every fabric has a different feeling. A silk chiffon video should not feel the same as a rhinestone lace video. Linen may need something clean and effortless, while beaded lace may need something more dramatic and luxurious. We want someone who can understand these differences and edit in a way that matches the product, the customer, and the goal of the video. Skills Needed The ideal candidate should be strong in: * Advanced video editing * Short-form video editing * Social media ad creatives * Fashion, beauty, product, or lifestyle editing * Hook-based editing * Captions and text overlays * Music selection and sound design * Color correction * Clean pacing and visual rhythm * Creating multiple versions from the same footage * Editing in different ratios: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, and 16:9 We do not want generic template-style editing. We are looking for someone who has taste, understands visuals, and can make fabric/product videos feel elevated and engaging. **AI Tools & Creative Technology** Experience with AI tools (intermediate is ok and to be willing to learn). You do not need to know every tool, but you should be curious and open to using AI to improve the creative process. Useful tools include Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, Canva, Runway, Kling AI, Pika, Midjourney, ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, Descript, Topaz Video AI, and OpusClip. **To Apply** Please send: 1. Your portfolio with your best video editing work 2. Examples ofvideos you have edited 3. A short explanation of your editing style 4. The tools you use 5. Your experience with AI video or creative tools 6. Your monthly full-time rate Bonus points if you have experience editing for fashion, ecommerce, fabric/textile, beauty, or paid social media ads. This is a position with a high growth potential.

title: Virtual Medical Scheduler
description: VISTA DERMATOLOGY Virtual Medical Scheduler Remote · Full-Time ABOUT VISTA DERMATOLOGY Vista Dermatology is an independent, physician-owned private practice built on a simple but powerful belief: every patient deserves to be treated like family. Unlike large corporate dermatology groups, every person on our schedule is fully ours, and we take that responsibility seriously. Our patient experience begins the ---------- nt someone picks up the phone or submits an online request. We’ve built a reputation for excellence in clinical care, and we protect that reputation just as fiercely in every scheduling interaction. Our staff isn’t just answering a phone line, they’re nurturing relationships and setting the tone for everything that follows. We’re a small but fast-growing practice. In our first year, we went from a team of eight to fourteen, and we’re continuing to grow. We compensate our team competitively, invest in their development, and have a strong track record of long-term retention. Our tea ---------- mbers stay—and we’re proud of that. ROLE OVERVIEW We’re hiring our first Virtual Medical Scheduler: a remote, full-time hire who will serve as the first voice our patients hear. This is a high-volume, detail-critical scheduling role supporting a dermatology practice that handles 400–500 incoming calls per week across our appointment lines. This isn’t a vague support role. It’s a focused, essential function: answer calls, schedule patients accurately, enter the right insurance information into our practice management system, and represent Vista Dermatology with warmth and professionalism on every single interaction. If we hire well, we intend to hire a second virtual scheduler shortly after, and we’re committed to making this a stable, long-term position with a clear compensation path and real professional investment over time. SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY This role requires consistent, predictable availability. Our phones open at a set time each morning, and our patients expect someone to be there. - Hours: 7:45 AM – 4:15 PM, Monday through Friday (40 hours/week) - Time Zone: Central Time (US) - Lunch break: 12:15 PM – 12:45 PM (30 minutes) - The 7:45 AM start allows time to review email s, check messages, and be ready before calls begin - Phones close to active callers at 4:00 PM; the final 15 minutes are used to close out to-do lists and contact the manager with any remaining questions - Attendance is non-negotiable — this is the first point of contact for our patients - Tardiness policy: notify the office manager by phone at least 10 minutes before your start time if late; no more than 2 late arrivals per rolling 30-day period - Punctuality is treated as a core professional standard, not a preference WHAT YOU'LL DO Your day will be primarily driven by live call volume, with additional responsibilities added incrementally as you become proficient. Tasks are prioritized in the following order: 1. Live Scheduling Calls (Primary Responsibility) - Answer 200–300+ inbound scheduling calls per week with professionalism and warmth - Collect accurate patient demographic, insurance, and appointment information - Enter all information correctly into our EMA (Modernizing Medicine/ModMed) practice management system; this is the first entry point of the patient chart - Verify insurance eligibility using our credentialing grid (updated regularly; the most current version must always be used) - Send patients the correct intake paperwork and obtain required credit card authorizations - Follow each scheduling step consistently and in order — every time, without skipping steps - Transfer calls appropriately when a patient has a clinical question outside the scope of scheduling 2. Online Scheduling Support (Added After Proficiency) - Process online scheduling requests and messages submitted through the patient portal - Manage online scheduling queue after demonstrating consistency on live calls 3. Voi cemail & Reschedule Callbacks (Added After Proficiency) - Return voi cemail messages within a strict callback window - Handle reschedule requests and cancellations professionally 4. Fax & Referral Processing (Added After Proficiency) - Process incoming fax referrals and scheduling records from outside providers WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR This role is not high-level complexity, but it demands a very specific kind of person. The work that looks deceptively simple on paper consistently separates strong performers from those who don’t make it past week two. You're a fit if you: - Have excellent spoken and written English — clarity and professionalism are non-negotiable - Type 50–70 words per minute with high accuracy - Are calm, patient, and consistent even during high call volume - Are naturally detail-oriented and take following a process seriously - Can sit at a computer for extended periods and navigate modern software with ease - Value stability and doing one thing excellently - Have a computer-comfortable background: past work in data entry, sales systems, student platforms, or similar computer-heavy environments - Understand that accuracy matters more than speed in the early stages - Are comfortable working during U.S. Central Time business hours This Role Is NOT a Fit If You: - Thrive on constant variety and creative problem-solving - Prefer physical, hands-on work environments - Have difficulty sitting attentively at a computer for a full workday - Are looking for a steppingstone to a different kind of role quickly - Are not comfortable with detailed, step-by-step processes that must be followed precisely - Have limited experience with modern computer systems or software TOOLS & SYSTEMS YOU'LL WORK WITH You do not need prior experience with these specific platforms, but you must be comfortable and confident with modern computer systems. Our staff has consistently found that tech-savvy individuals pick up our systems quickly. - ModMed (EMA / Modernizing Medicine): our all-in-one electronic health record, scheduling, and practice management system - Klara: HIPAA-compliant secure messaging with patients - RingCentral: our phone system (call volume is monitored and reviewed weekly) - Gusto: payroll and time tracking - Insurance Credentialing Grid: must be reviewed and used on every scheduling call; updated regularly - HIPAA compliance is expected in all digital communications: all patient information is protected health information (PHI) TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS Because this is a remote, HIPAA-regulated role, your home setup must meet the following minimum standards before your start date: Internet & Connectivity - Minimum 10 Mbps download / 5 Mbps upload speeds (25 Mbps preferred for video) - A direct Ethernet (LAN) cable connection is strongly preferred over Wi-Fi for maximum stability - A backup internet source is required Hardware & Software - PC with at least Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 processor and 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred) - Operating system: Windows 10/11 or macOS 12+ - HD webcam (minimum 720p) for video check-ins - High-quality noise-canceling headset — critical for clear communication and patient privacy - A secure, enterprise-grade VPN and antivirus software to meet HIPAA requirements - Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure (our EHR is fully cloud-based) - Familiarity with HIPAA-compliant communication platforms (e.g., Zoom for Healthcare, Microsoft Teams, Slack) Environment - Quiet, distraction-free workspace - Secure physical environment appropriate for handling protected health information (PHI) TRAINING & ONBOARDING We take onboarding seriously. We’ve grown quickly and trained several rounds of employees, and we’ve developed a structured onboarding approach that sets people up for success. We’ll apply a similar approach for our first virtual hire. - Week 1: Observational training — watching and learning alongside an experienced tea ---------- mber; ModMed video tutorials; meeting with office manager at end of week - Week 2: Graduated training — practicing scheduling with live supervision; check-in with office manager at end of week - Weeks 3–12: Increasing independence on calls; weekly touchpoints and performance reviews throughout - Day 90: Formal performance review with the office manager Our experience is consistent: those who adapt to the system do so quickly. Those who don’t fit the role make that clear in the first one to two weeks. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS We believe the best way to reward great work is through a strong, reliable hourly rate with clear raises you can count on as you grow with us. We’ll define a formal title progression (Scheduler I, Scheduler II, Scheduler III) tied to tenure, performance metrics, and peer feedback, so you’re always advancing—even when the work itself stays consistent. Months 1–3 (Onboarding): $6.00/hour Months 4–6: $6.50/hour Months 7–12: $7.00/hour Year 2: $7.50–$8.00/hour (based on performance review) Year 3+: $8.50+/hour (based on performance review) Every step up is tied to performance. Show up consistently, handle calls with care, and follow the process, and the raises will follow. We want you to see exactly what you’re working toward. Additional Benefits - 13th Month Bonus: One additional month’s salary paid at year-end (a standard Philippine benefit we are proud to honor) - Annual healthcare allowance: $432/year - Performance bonuses tied to call volume and quality metrics - Equipment & connectivity stipend: available after 12 months of strong performance (a reward for loyalty and consistency, not a day-one entitlement) - Payroll processed twice monthly via Gusto Time Off Full-time employees (30+ hours/week) earn paid time off based on hours worked: - Years 1–2: PTO accrues at 3.08 hours per 80 hours worked (10 days/year) - Years 2–4: PTO accrues at 4.61 hours per 80 hours worked (15 days/year) - Year 5+: PTO accrues at 5.84 hours per 80 hours worked (19 days/year) In addition, 6 paid U.S. holidays are observed each year: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and Christmas. Combined with PTO, total paid days off are 16 per year (years 1–2), 21 per year (years 2–4), and 25 per year (year 5+). - PTO begins accruing on your start date but may not be used until after the 180-day probationary period - PTO must be requested at least 4 weeks in advance (28 days); sick leave follows a separate process COMMUNICATION & SUPERVISION We use a structured, transparent management approach. You will never feel like you’re working alone without direction or feedback. - Weekly check-ins with the office manager throughout your first 90 days - Formal semi-annual performance reviews - For urgent scheduling questions during your shift: contact the supervising Medical Assistant via RingCentral - For non-urgent issues: email the office manager at any time - For face-to-face conversations or screen sharing: Google Meet - Performance tracked weekly via RingCentral (call volume) and ModMed (scheduling activity) We are an approachable team. We’d rather you ask a question than handle something incorrectly, especially when it comes to insurance data and patient communication. When in doubt, ask. Always. WHY THIS ROLE MIGHT BE PERFECT FOR YOU You’re not just filling a seat, you are Vista Dermatology’s first impression. You’re the voice our patients hear before they ever meet a physician or step into a treatment room. That means something. If you’re someone who finds deep satisfaction in doing one thing really well, in being the dependable constant in a busy medical practice, and in knowing that your work directly contributes to patient care—this role was made for you. We offer stability, growth, real professional investment, and a team that will treat you as a valued member, not a remote resource. We’re looking for someone who wants to stay, to grow within this role, and to be part of building something lasting. To Apply, please click the following link - ---------- Here, you will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out an Experience Questionnaire and take a quick assessment. If you pass this first round, we will send you a few follow up assessments. The last round will involve sending in a video recording of yourself answering a handful of questions, then finally a live face-to-face interview. Then we will make our final decision. Please Note: It is best to have already taken your English Proficiency Assessment on your Onlinejobs.ph profile through ---------- and the IQ Test through ---------- before applying since we will request both of these in the application process. It is not mandatory to have them completed but it will improve your chances of moving along in the process. We’re excited to find the right person — and when we do, we intend to invest in them for the long haul. — The Vista Dermatology Team

title: Remote Sales & Demo Specialist for U.S. SaaS Company
job_title: Remote Sales & Demo Specialist for U.S. SaaS Company
description: ShyftGrid is looking for a serious Remote Sales & Demo Specialist to help us grow a U.S.-based SaaS platform for property operators, multi-location businesses, workforce teams, and service companies. This is a remote position with a guaranteed monthly base plus commission, residual income, and growth bonuses. This is a strong opportunity for someone who speaks professional English, is organized, can follow up consistently, and wants to grow with a company instead of only doing short-term tasks. ABOUT SHYFTGRID ShyftGrid is a software platform that helps businesses manage teams, locations, scheduling, shift activity, operations, and workforce accountability. Our pricing is based on monthly recurring revenue, so this role is focused on helping us bring in real paying customers. This is not just a basic VA job. This role is for someone who can help create sales opportunities, communicate with business owners, book demos, support demos, follow up, and help turn interested prospects into paying monthly customers. COMPENSATION Starting monthly base: $500 USD per month The monthly base covers the regular daily work: - Lead research - Finding qualified businesses - Outreach - CRM updates - Booking demos - Demo support - Follow-up - Customer communication - Pipeline organization Commission: 35% of the first month collected revenue from customers you help close. Residual commission: 5% monthly residual for 12 months while the customer stays active and paying. Important: There is no separate demo bonus. Demo booking and demo support are part of the monthly base pay. Commission and bonuses are based on real paying customers, not just demo activity. MRR BONUS STRUCTURE Bonuses are based on verified monthly recurring revenue, not just the number of demos. $2,500 MRR active for 60 days = $250 bonus $5,000 MRR active for 60 days = $500 bonus $10,000 MRR active for 60 days = $1,000 bonus $20,000 MRR active for 60 days = $2,500 bonus $30,000 MRR active for 60 days = $5,000 bonus Customers must be real paying businesses. Free trials, refunds, chargebacks, unpaid invoices, or fake accounts do not count. PAY GROWTH This position starts at $500/month. After 60–90 days, base pay may increase based on performance and verified revenue created. Possible pay growth: $2,500 MRR created = eligible for $650/month base $5,000 MRR created = eligible for $750/month base $10,000 MRR created = eligible for $1,000/month base Pay increases are not automatic. They are based on real results, CRM tracking, consistent communication, and paying customers. WHO THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR This role is ideal for someone who: - Speaks clear professional English - Is comfortable communicating with U.S. business owners - Is organized and consistent - Can work remotely with minimal supervision - Understands lead generation and sales follow-up - Can book and support demo calls - Can learn software quickly - Can use a CRM properly - Is motivated by USD income, commissions, and growth bonuses - Wants a long-term opportunity, not short-term task work WHAT YOU WILL DO You will help with: - Finding property managers, cleaning companies, security companies, restaurants, warehouses, home healthcare companies, and multi-location operators - Researching qualified leads - Contacting business owners and managers - Sending approved outreach messages - Booking demos - Helping show the software during demos - Following up after demos - Tracking every lead and follow-up in the CRM - Helping prospects understand pricing - Helping close monthly subscriptions - Keeping the pipeline organized MAIN CUSTOMER TARGETS We are mainly focused on businesses that can pay monthly and have multiple locations, teams, employees, shifts, or operational problems. Examples: - Property management companies - Cleaning companies - Security companies - Restaurants with multiple locations - Home healthcare companies - Warehouses - Staffing companies - Service businesses with field teams - Multi-location operators Our Starter plan is $39/month, but the main sales focus is higher-value customers: Multi-Location Control: $99 per location per month Operations Pro: $149 per location per month Enterprise: Custom pricing The goal is not just to get many small customers. The goal is to help build monthly recurring revenue. REQUIREMENTS You must have: - Strong English communication skills - Reliable internet - A quiet place for calls - Sales, appointment setting, lead generation, or customer support experience - Ability to work U.S. business hours or partial U.S. business hours - Ability to use CRM tools - Ability to follow instructions carefully - Ability to write professional messages - Ability to attend video calls when needed - Ability to track all activity clearly BONUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH - SaaS sales - Property management - Real estate support - Appointment setting - Cold email - LinkedIn outreach - CRM management - U.S. business clients - B2B lead generation - Demo calls - Customer onboarding IMPORTANT RULES - All leads must be tracked in the approved CRM. - Commission is paid only after customer payment clears. - No commission is paid on demos only. - No commission is paid on free trials, refunds, chargebacks, or unpaid accounts. - Residual commission continues only while the customer stays active and paying. - Bonuses are paid only after verified MRR stays active for at least 60 days. HOW TO APPLY Please reply with the following: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Your sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or customer support experience. 3. Your English-speaking experience with U.S. or international clients. 4. Your internet speed. 5. Your available work hours in Philippines time and U.S. Eastern Time. 6. The CRM tools you have used before. 7. A short answer to this question: “How would you help ShyftGrid get its first 25 paying business customers?” 8. Please include a short video introduction if possible. This helps us understand your communication style. We are looking for someone serious, organized, and motivated by long-term growth. If you want stable monthly pay plus commission and residual upside, this could be a strong opportunity.

title: Social Media Graphic Designer
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY This organization is a mission-driven nonprofit headquartered in the United States. It operates a national network of grassroots chapters focused on advocacy, education, and community organizing. The organization partners with progressive groups nationwide to advance equity, inclusion, and social impact through coalition building and grassroots engagement. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a creative, reliable Social Media Graphic Designer to support this nonprofit team with visual content creation across social media platforms. This is a part-time role (~10 hours/week) ideal for a designer who produces high-quality work consistently and is available during set hours for real-time collaboration. The primary focus is designing social media graphics for Instagram, with content repurposed across Facebook and other platforms. The internal team provides content direction and approved messaging internally. The designer will bring those ideas to life visually. This is a growth-oriented position with a clear path from 10 hours/week to 20 hours/week based on performance and organizational need. RESPONSIBILITIES Social Media Content Design (Primary Focus) 1. Design social media graphics for Instagram (static posts, carousels, stories), with content repurposed for Facebook and other platforms as needed. 2. Create visually compelling, on-brand content that aligns with the organization’s mission, voice, and visual identity. 3. Translate approved messaging, campaign themes, and content briefs into polished, publish-ready designs. 4. Maintain consistency in brand aesthetics across all visual content, including color palette, typography, and layout. Collaboration & Communication 1. Collaborate directly with the COO and internal team on content direction, feedback, and revisions. 2. Be available and responsive during agreed-upon working hours for real-time communication and iteration. 3. Incorporate feedback promptly and deliver revisions within expected turnaround times. 4. Maintain organized files and design assets for easy access and reuse by the team. Brand & Content Support 1. Adapt existing design templates for recurring content series and campaigns. 2. Support special projects such as event graphics, fundraising visuals, and advocacy campaign materials as assigned. 3. Stay current with social media design trends and bring fresh visual ideas to the team. REQUIREMENTS Must-Have Qualifications 1. 2+ years of experience in graphic design with a portfolio demonstrating social media content creation. 2. Proficiency with Canva, including the ability to create professional, polished designs efficiently. 3. Strong visual design sense, including layout, typography, color theory, and brand consistency. 4. Ability to take content direction and approved messaging and translate it into compelling visual designs without needing to develop copy or strategy. 5. Reliable availability during agreed-upon working hours with consistent responsiveness to messages and feedback. 6. Ability to work independently, manage multiple design requests, and meet deadlines without constant oversight. 7. Strong written communication skills in English for collaborating with the U.S.-based team. 8. Reliable internet connection and ability to overlap with U.S. Pacific Time and East Coast hours. Preferred Qualifications 1. Experience with Adobe Illustrator or other professional design tools beyond Canva. 2. Background in designing for nonprofit, advocacy, or mission-driven organizations. 3. Experience creating content specifically for Instagram (posts, stories, reels covers, carousels). 4. Familiarity with social media best practices including image dimensions, aspect ratios, and platform-specific formatting. 5. Experience working with brand guidelines and style guides. 6. Comfort with learning new tools and adapting to evolving content needs. A growth mindset is essential. KEY TRAITS WE’RE LOOKING FOR 1. Creative and Consistent: Produces high-quality, on-brand visuals reliably. Every design reflects the organization’s standards and mission. 2. Available and Responsive: This is the most important trait for this role. The team needs a designer who is present, reachable, and responsive during agreed working hours. Availability and communication are non-negotiable. 3. Detail-Oriented: Catches inconsistencies in design, spacing, alignment, and brand elements before deliverables are submitted. 4. Self-Starter: Takes initiative, manages their own workload, and delivers results without needing to be micromanaged. 5. Mission-Aligned: Understands and respects the purpose behind the organization’s work. While deep subject matter expertise is not required, genuine respect for the organization’s mission and values is expected. 6. Team Player: Treated as an integral part of the team, not a separate contractor. Expected to contribute ideas, take feedback constructively, and grow into greater responsibility over time. 7. Transparent Communicator: Speaks up when something is unclear, flags capacity issues early, and communicates progress honestly. TOOLS AND PLATFORMS Canva Graphic Design Adobe Illustrator Instagram / Facebook Google Suite Graphic Design Social Media Platforms Communication & Collaboration HOW TO APPLY Interested candidates will submit their resume and portfolio for review, followed by a pre-recorded video interview. Top candidates will be shortlisted and forwarded to this nonprofit team for final evaluation.

title: Head of Lead Generation
description: CP Restoration Services Job Description POSITION AT A GLANCE Job Title: Head of Lead Generation Department: Sales & Marketing Reports To: Owner / CEO (Jason Crown) Location: Remote (US-based preferred) Employment Type: Full-Time Compensation: Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Commission on closed deals sourced) Company: CP Restoration Services | ---------- ABOUT CROWN CREDIT PRO CP Restoration Services is a leading credit repair company founded in 2014 with over 7,000 clients nationwide. We specialize in disputing inaccurate and negative items across all three major credit bureaus — Equifax, Experian, and TransUnion — helping our clients achieve financial freedom through better credit. We are a fast-growing company with a team spanning the US and the Philippines, and we are now looking for a driven, strategic leader to own and scale our entire lead generation engine. ROLE OVERVIEW The Head of Lead Generation is responsible for building, managing, and continuously optimizing the full pipeline of qualified leads that feed the CP Restoration Services sales team. This person owns everything from the top of the funnel — awareness and lead capture — to the handoff of sales-ready leads to our sales representatives. You will design and execute a multi-channel lead generation strategy including referral partner development, paid digital advertising, organic/SEO content, email marketing, and social media. You will also build the systems and automations that ensure no lead falls through the cracks and every prospect receives timely, consistent follow-up. This is a high-impact, high-accountability role. Sales are the lifeblood of CP Restoration Services and you will be directly responsible for the revenue pipeline. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Referral Partner Development • Identify, recruit, and manage referral partnerships with mortgage brokers, real estate agents, auto dealerships (F&I managers), CPAs, tax preparers, financial advisors, and apartment leasing offices. • Build co-branded marketing materials and custom landing pages for each referral partner. • Implement a referral tracking system (PartnerStack or equivalent) so partners can monitor their referrals and commissions in real time. • Set monthly referral volume targets and maintain relationships through regular check-ins. 2. Paid Digital Advertising • Plan, launch, and manage Facebook and Instagram lead generation ad campaigns targeting individuals with credit challenges. • Manage Google Search Ads campaigns targeting high-intent keywords such as “credit repair near me” and “remove collections from credit report.” • Explore YouTube and TikTok ad opportunities to build brand awareness and generate inbound leads at lower cost. • Monitor cost-per-lead, cost-per-acquisition, and ROAS across all paid channels and optimize weekly. • Manage the ad budget efficiently and report performance to ownership monthly. 3. Lead Funnel & CRM Management • Ensure every lead from every source flows automatically into HubSpot CRM via Zapier or native integrations. • Build and maintain 7-touch automated follow-up sequences in HubSpot (email + SMS) so no lead goes uncontacted. • Establish speed-to-lead protocols so every inbound lead is contacted within 5 minutes of submission. • Segment leads by source, credit profile, and intent level to prioritize the sales team’s outreach. • Source and manage aged lead lists ( ---------- or equivalent) as a cost-effective supplementary channel. 4. Organic Lead Generation & Content • Manage and fully optimize the CP Restoration Services Google Business Profile, including generating a consistent flow of 5-star reviews from satisfied clients. • Oversee an SEO content strategy targeting high-intent searches by clients seeking credit repair help. • Manage social media content calendar (Facebook , Instagram, TikTok) with 3–5 posts per week, including educational content, client success stories, and promotional offers. • Use tools like Buffer or Later to schedule and automate content publishing. 5. Analytics & Reporting • Track and report weekly on key metrics: leads generated by channel, cost per lead, lead-to-appointment rate, appointment-to-close rate, and cost per acquired client. • Benchmark against industry standards (15–20% lead-to-client conversion rate, $150–$300 cost per client acquisition). • Use A/B testing on ad creative, landing pages, and email subject lines to continuously improve conversion rates. • Present a monthly lead generation report to the CEO with insights, wins, and next-month strategy. 6. Sales Team Enablement • Collaborate with the Sales Manager to ensure lead handoff is seamless and leads arrive with full context (source, credit score range, goal). • Develop call scripts, email templates, and follow-up sequences for the sales team to use with incoming leads. • Work with the Sales Manager to identify which lead sources produce the highest close rates and double down on those channels. QUALIFICATIONS Required • 3+ years of experience in lead generation, growth marketing, or demand generation — ideally in financial services, credit repair, mortgage, real estate, or a related industry. • Proven track record of building and scaling multi-channel lead generation programs that directly drove revenue growth. • Hands-on experience running and optimizing Facebook /Instagram Lead Ads and Google Search Ads campaigns. • Proficiency with HubSpot CRM, including building automated sequences, managing pipelines, and reporting. • Strong understanding of referral partner programs and experience building B2B referral networks. • Experience with Zapier or ---------- for marketing automation and CRM integrations. • Data-driven mindset — you track everything and make decisions based on numbers, not gut feel. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred • Prior experience in the credit repair, mortgage lending, or personal finance industry. • Familiarity with Credit Repair Cloud or similar credit repair CRM platforms. • Experience with SEO content strategy and managing a content calendar. • Knowledge of CROA (Credit Repair Organizations Act) marketing compliance requirements. • Experience managing remote teams or coordinating with offshore tea ---------- mbers. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured by the following metrics, reviewed monthly: KPI Target Qualified leads generated per month 200+ (ramp to 500+ within 6 months) Cost per lead (paid channels) Under $25 Lead-to-appointment conversion rate 25%+ Overall lead-to-client conversion rate 15–20?tive referral partnerships 10 within 60 days, 25+ within 6 months Speed to lead (contact within) 5 minutes of lead submission WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience. • Performance bonus tied directly to qualified leads and closed deals sourced — the better you perform, the more you earn. • 100% remote position with flexible working hours. • A company with 10+ years of history, 7,000+ clients, and a proven service that sells itself. • Direct access to and support from the founder/CEO. • A clear mandate: you own lead generation. Your results are visible and rewarded. • Opportunity to build and lead your own lead generation team as the company scales. HOW TO APPLY To apply, please send the following to ---------- • Your resume or LinkedIn profile. • A brief cover letter (3–5 sentences) explaining your lead generation experience and why you are the right person for this role. • One example of a lead generation campaign you built — what you did, the results, and what you learned. Applications without a cover letter and campaign example will not be reviewed. CP Restoration Services | ---------- | Est. 2014

title: Recruitment Specialist / ATS Administrator (Lever, Greenhouse)
description: Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation) Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role. Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows. About the role and how we work together: I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it. The most important quality, above everything else: You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro ---------- , a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for. What you will actually be doing, day to day: On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below. On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential. Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast. Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm. The kind of person who thrives here: Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them. Skills to have already : Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days. Compensation: $500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management. To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test: 1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did? 2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them? 3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly. 4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable. 5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do? 6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly. 7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

title: Google Apps Script Engineer + Sheets Systems Builder
job_title: Google Apps Script Engineer + Sheets Systems Builder
description: SALARY:  PHP 50,000–90,000/month (~$900–$1,600 USD) HOURS: Project-based to start, with a path to an ongoing seat I'm hiring one person to automate and connect a multi-tab Google Sheets system that runs a live operation. The architecture is already well-built — tracking tasks, launches, shifts, payroll, and testing across a large structure. I don't need it rebuilt. I need it automated, connected, and rolled up — surgically, without breaking what works. If you stop at VLOOKUP, this isn't your seat. If you build scripted automation AND clean multi-sheet data systems that feed dashboards and run themselves — keep reading. --- The work — two sides, both matter: 1) Apps Script automation (`.gs`) - Write and maintain Apps Script across a multi-tab system - Build **triggers** — onEdit, time-based, onChange — for live workflow automation - Diagnose and fix broken logic (a contained payroll-calculation bug is the first real task) - Add validation, flagging, alerting, scheduled summary email s - Connect Sheets to **external APIs** with auth + error handling where needed 2) Advanced formulas + sheet-to-dashboard data systems - Build **multi-sheet data connections** — worker sheets rolling up into a **master dashboard** - Fluent with **QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, INDEX/MATCH, ARRAYFORMULA, FILTER, pivot logic** — the formula stack that moves and aggregates data cleanly across tabs - Design **data-collection flows**: individual input sheets ? consolidated master view, live and accurate - Build dashboard views that summarize operational data (performance, labor, output) in real time Always: build on a copy, test, then deploy. Non-negotiable.** Document everything so it stays maintainable. --- **Non-negotiables —** - **Real Apps Script experience** — actual `.gs` code, not just formulas - **Advanced formula fluency** — QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA, INDEX/MATCH at a systems level, not single-cell - Can build **sheet-to-sheet and sheet-to-dashboard data pipelines** that stay accurate at scale - Can read an existing system and **extend it without breaking it** — surgical, not destructive - Clean, documented, maintainable work - Sharp communication, reliable availability, stable setup **You stand out if —** - You use **clasp** for local Apps Script development - You've done **Apps Script + external API** integration (REST, OAuth) - You've built **master-dashboard rollups** from multiple input sheets - You've automated **real operational systems** — payroll, tracking, reporting — not toy demos --- **How to apply (follow exactly — skip a step and you're deleted) —** The instructions are the first test. I read every application that follows them. I ignore every one that doesn't. 1. Put **SCRIPT** at the very top, so I know you read this in full. 2. Share **2–3 projects you personally built** — must show **both** real `.gs` work **and** a multi-sheet/dashboard data system. Link code (GitHub/Gist), a Loom walkthrough, or a working sheet copy. 3. In 2–3 sentences: **describe one thing you automated with Apps Script that a formula couldn't do** — name the trigger and the logic. 4. In 2–3 sentences: **describe a time you connected multiple sheets into one master dashboard** — what formulas/method you used and how you kept the data accurate. 5. In one line: **how do you test before touching a live system?** Nail this and you move to a paid test task — a small, real automation or data-connection job on a copy of my sheet. Nail that and we scope the full build. I'm hiring one person. Show me you can both script and build clean data systems.

title: Operations Manager — Recruitment & Lead Gen (Remote, Full-Time)
job_title: Operations Manager — Recruitment & Lead Gen (Remote, Full-Time)
description: Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation) Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role. Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows. About the role and how we work together: I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it. The most important quality, above everything else: You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro ---------- , a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for. What you will actually be doing, day to day: On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below. On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential. Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast. Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm. The kind of person who thrives here: Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them. Skills to have already : Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days. Compensation: $500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management. To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test: 1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did? 2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them? 3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly. 4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable. 5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do? 6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly. 7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

description: Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation) Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role. Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows. About the role and how we work together: I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it. The most important quality, above everything else: You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro ---------- , a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for. What you will actually be doing, day to day: On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below. On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential. Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast. Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm. The kind of person who thrives here: Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them. Skills to have already : Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days. Compensation: $500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management. title: Creative Content Director
description: About the Role Refined Touch Media is looking for a Creative Content Director who can help transform ideas into engaging content that captures attention and drives conversations. This is not a typical social media manager role. We're not looking for someone who simply follows instructions or edits videos. We're looking for someone who can think strategically, research trends, develop creative concepts, and bring fresh ideas to the table. The right person will help lead the creative direction of content across YouTube, Instagram, Facebook , LinkedIn, TikTok, and other digital platforms. Your goal is simple: Take creative work off my plate while elevating the quality of the content we produce. Responsibilities Creative Strategy Research content trends, formats, and emerging opportunities Develop content concepts and campaign ideas Identify hooks, angles, and storytelling opportunities Study competitors and industry leaders for inspiration Bring new ideas proactively instead of waiting for assignments Content Production Edit short-form and long-form video content Create engaging graphics and visual assets Design thumbnails and promotional materials Repurpose content across multiple platforms Improve pacing, retention, and viewer engagement Content Planning Build content calendars and publishing schedules Recommend content based on audience interests and business goals Organize content ideas and production workflows Help prioritize high-impact opportunities Copy & Messaging Write captions, titles, descriptions, and calls-to-action Create platform-specific messaging Maintain consistency with brand voice and positioning What Success Looks Like Content consistently feels creative, intentional, and engaging New ideas are regularly presented without being asked Content quality improves over time Videos have stronger retention and engagement Creative decisions are backed by research, not guesswork The owner spends less time managing content creation Required Skills Advanced video editing experience Strong understanding of visual storytelling Experience with CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Canva, or similar tools Graphic design experience Strong copywriting ability Ability to analyze content performance and trends Excellent communication and organization skills Bonus Skills Motion graphics YouTube strategy Thumbnail design AI-assisted content workflows Marketing and advertising knowledge Experience working with service-based businesses Who Excites Us We love people who are naturally curious. You constantly ask: Why did this video perform well? What would make this more engaging? How can we improve this idea? What trend should we be paying attention to? You don't wait for permission to think creatively. You enjoy researching, experimenting, and finding new ways to capture attention. You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You care about producing work that makes people stop scrolling. Most importantly, you understand that great content isn't just editing. It's strategy, psychology, storytelling, and execution working together. Work Environment & Benefits Remote position Flexible schedule Trust-based culture Performance-based growth opportunities Direct collaboration with leadership Opportunity to help shape the creative direction of a growing marketing agency We're not looking for someone to simply manage content. We're looking for someone who can help create content worth paying attention to.

title: Bookkeeper & Financial Administrator (Remote | Performance-Based)
description: WHO WE ARE Clock Clean Services (CCS) is a commercial cleaning company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. We serve general contractors, property managers, and national accounts across the United States. We run a tight, high-standard operation. Our systems are clean, our expectations are clear, and we hold everyone on our team — including ourselves — to the same standard: accurate, on time, every time. We don't hire people to fill seats. We hire people who take ownership of their lane and execute with precision. THE ROLE We are looking for a Bookkeeper to own the financial record-keeping side of Clock Clean Services. This is a focused, well-defined role — no ambiguity, no scope creep. You process what comes in, reconcile what needs reconciling, and keep our books clean. This role is per-task based — you are paid for what you complete accurately. There is no hourly retainer. If you work fast and accurately, you earn well. If your work requires correction, it comes back to you before payment clears. This starts as a part-time engagement and has a clear path to full-time as the business scales. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Process all Company invoices — log, code, and file accurately • Perform account reconciliations for all designated Company accounts • Process expense reports as submitted by Company leadership • Execute and submit payroll runs on schedule — never late • Maintain organized, accurate financial records in our accounting system • Flag any discrepancies or anomalies to leadership the same day identified • Provide monthly financial summaries as requested COMPENSATION STRUCTURE Pay is per task, per completion. Here is the rate schedule: Task - Rate - Notes Invoice Processing - $1.50 per invoice - Per invoice logged, coded, and filed accurately Account Reconciliation - $8.00 per account - Per account reconciled and confirmed Expense Report Processing - $2.00 per report - Per report processed and categorized Payroll Run Submission - $5.00 per run - Per complete run submitted on schedule Accuracy Bonus:  $50.00/month in any month where zero material errors are identified across all submitted work If you're fast, accurate, and consistent — this structure rewards you well. Estimated monthly earnings at normal volume: $150–$300+. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ? Proven bookkeeping experience — QuickBooks or similar accounting software ? Exceptional accuracy — you catch errors before they leave your desk ? Reliable and on time — payroll especially cannot be late ? Strong written English communication with Company leadership ? Ability to work independently without daily supervision ? Proactive — you flag issues immediately rather than waiting to be asked ? Detail-oriented by nature, not by effort THIS IS NOT FOR YOU IF... • You need an hourly retainer regardless of output • You submit work before double-checking it • You go quiet when you encounter a problem instead of escalating it • You treat bookkeeping as routine data entry rather than financial stewardship • You need daily check-ins to stay on task HOW TO APPLY To be considered, your application must include all of the following: • Your resume — highlight bookkeeping experience and any accounting software you've used • A short written introduction (no video required) — tell us about your bookkeeping background and why this structure works for you • Your answer to this question: "You're reconciling an account and find a $200 discrepancy you can't immediately explain. Walk me through exactly what you do." Subject Line: Bookkeeper Application Applications without a written introduction or question answer will not be reviewed. IMPORTANT: Applications are accepted exclusively through OnlineJobs.ph. Any applicant who contacts company phone numbers, email s, social media accounts, or tea ---------- mbers directly regarding this position will be disqualified from consideration. Please submit everything through OnlineJobs.ph only. We are building something that lasts. If you want to be part of a team that operates with precision and takes pride in clean work — this is your role.

Tutorial edits that teach our audience how to recreate effects --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- REQUIREMENTS - Proficient in Premiere Pro or comparable software. After Effects and Photoshop are a huge plus. We also teach editing in mobile apps, so familiarity with CapCut is a plus. - You work fast under pressure and find shortcuts without sacrificing quality - Organized, detail-oriented, and coachable - Fluent in English, written and spoken (your video intro will confirm this) - Available to overlap with US business hours for async communication - This is a remote role open to applicants worldwide We are not looking for perfectionists. Preferred Experience Experience writing about medical sales, healthcare, medtech, pharma, biotech, recruiting, or job search topics. Experience writing news-style articles or industry roundups.
