title: Recruitment Assistant
description: Job Title: Full-Time Operations Lead — Self-Driven Executor & Tester (Recruitment Tech, Demos & Multi-Channel Lead Generation) Type: Full-time, long-term. Clear growth path from executor into a senior operations and management role. Hours: Long days in the early build phase, around 10-12 hours, spanning Indian afternoon hours for core setup work and Indian night hours for software demos and channel testing (US time-zone overlap). Hours become more balanced as systems are documented and the team grows. About the role and how we work together: I run a lead-generation and recruitment-technology operation that spans several methods at once. The way I work is simple: I am the engine of ideas, companies, and direction, and I need one outstanding right-hand person to be the engine of execution. I will hand you a method, a company, or a concept, explain it once, and then rely on you to take it from there — to set it up, test it, troubleshoot the small problems on your own, document what works, and report back. You will begin as my primary hands-on executor doing all of this yourself, and as you prove your reliability and judgment, you will grow into running the operation: building the playbooks, then hiring and training other people so that you are leading a team rather than carrying every task alone. This is genuinely built to become a senior, high-trust, well-compensated position for the person who shows they can own it. The most important quality, above everything else: You learn quickly and work independently. The single trait that will make you succeed here is the ability to be shown something once — through a short explanation fro ---------- , a video, or a set of notes — and then go figure out the rest yourself. I should not have to sit beside you walking you through each click. The methods we run change often and involve constant small problems to solve, so I need someone who treats a new tool or platform as a puzzle to crack on their own rather than a reason to wait for instructions. If you are the kind of person who teaches yourself new software for the fun of it and enjoys rolling up your sleeves on tedious hands-on work, you are exactly who I am looking for. What you will actually be doing, day to day: On the recruitment-technology side, you will set up and operate applicant-tracking and recruiting platforms such as Lever, Greenhouse, iCIMS and similar systems, create and manage job postings, and collect and organize candidates. A major part of the early work is securing the software accounts that make everything run, which means handling demos from start to finish: I will bring you the companies, and you will research each company's website and domain beforehand so you walk into the call informed and prepared, fill out the demo request forms, get on the sales calls, and present yourself calmly and professionally so the account gets approved. Composure here is a real skill, and I will explain more about it below. On the lead-generation side, you will be testing and running acquisition across multiple channels — Snapchat, Zillow, Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist and others — and across different angles such as job, rental, and survey offers. This part of the work is genuinely experimental: platforms shift, accounts get restricted, and what worked last month stops working. So this is not a "follow the fixed manual" job; it is a "try something, watch it fail, adjust, try again, and write down what finally works" job. You will be thinking on your own about where and how to post, testing manually, noticing what gets traction, and refining it. That willingness to grind through repetitive manual testing without losing motivation is essential. Underneath all of this sits the supporting infrastructure that you will own: sourcing US phone numbers, working with proxies and incognito or private browsing, managing multiple accounts cleanly without mixing them up, and installing and configuring the tools we use. None of this needs to be mastered on day one, but you need to either know it or be genuinely eager to learn it fast. Finally, and this is the part that protects the whole operation: you will document every working process as you discover it. My single biggest need is an operations partner who becomes the memory of the business — who writes down the sequence that worked so we never lose it again. Daily reporting to me is part of the rhythm. The kind of person who thrives here: Beyond the fast-learning ability, you are self-motivated and take full ownership without being chased. You honestly enjoy hands-on, repetitive, manual work and do not get bored by the grind that makes systems run, because much of the early work is exactly that grind. You are brave and emotionally steady — demos involve rejection and probing questions, and new platforms involve constant failure, and you stay calm, composed, and detached through all of it rather than getting flustered, because that steadiness is precisely what gets accounts approved and methods cracked. You are organized and disciplined about writing things down. You are honest and trustworthy, because this is a role with real responsibility. And over time, you are someone who can teach what you have learned to new hires and help manage them. Skills to have already : Direct experience with applicant-tracking systems and LinkedIn Recruiter is strongly preferred and will move your application to the top. Experience running or arranging software demos is a big plus. Comfort with — or a fast, genuine willingness to learn — proxies, incognito browsing, US phone-number sourcing, and multi-account management is important. Any background in recruitment, lead generation, sales operations, or serious hands-on virtual-assistant work where you personally owned the execution is highly valued. That said, please understand my hiring philosophy clearly: I am hiring trainable raw ability, grit, and self-direction over a long checklist of pre-known tools. If you learn fast and work hard, the specific platforms are teachable in days. Compensation: $500 to $1,000 per month depending on experience, plus performance bonuses tied directly to results. For someone who proves they can own and grow this role, there is real and fast growth in both pay and responsibility as the position expands into operations management. To apply, please answer all of these questions in your reply. Applications that skip them will be ignored, because the ability to follow this instruction is itself part of the test: 1.Tell me about something genuinely complex that you taught yourself, using only videos or brief instructions. How quickly did you become good at it, and how do you know you did? 2.Which applicant-tracking platforms have you personally worked in, and what exactly did you do inside them? 3.Have you ever researched a company and then filled out forms or joined sales calls to set up software or demo accounts? Describe the experience honestly. 4.How comfortable are you with proxies, incognito browsing, managing multiple accounts, and sourcing things like phone numbers online? Honesty matters here — a real willingness to learn is perfectly acceptable. 5.Describe a specific time when something you were working on kept failing, and you had to keep trying different approaches until it worked. What happened, and what did you do? 6.Have you ever trained or managed other people? If so, describe it briefly. 7.Are you available full-time, including long days of 10-12 hours in the early phase, across Indian afternoon and night hours?

description: We are looking for a sharp, organized Virtual Assistant to help us grow our Ambassador Partner Program at ---------- . EstateDocPrep helps homeowners protect their families through estate planning workshops. We are building a network of local ambassadors — real estate agents, insurance professionals, and community members — who invite homeowners to our free workshops. Your job is to find these ambassadors, reach out to them, and keep the pipeline moving. This is a focused outreach role. You will NOT be doing general admin, bookkeeping, or customer service. You will spend most of your time on Facebook , Instagram, and our CRM finding the right people and sending them personalized messages using scripts and templates we provide. WHAT YOU WILL DO EVERY DAY: Find real estate agent and professional business pages on Facebook and Instagram Send personalized DMs using our provided scripts (you will rotate 10 different message templates) Post in Facebook groups using our ready-to-use content templates Follow up with people who replied but have not yet taken action Log every message, reply, and outcome in our tracking spreadsheet Send follow-up sequences to warm leads via text and email templates in our CRM (GoHighLevel) Load and manage email campaigns in GoHighLevel Report daily activity: messages sent, replies received, interested leads You will have a full playbook, scripts, templates, and tracking sheets on day one. We respond to shortlisted candidates within 48 hours. The start date is immediate for the right person.  THEN  ASEND TO  MY WHAT PP A NOTE ON THIS ROLE: This is a focused, process-driven job. We have built a complete system — the scripts are written, the tracking sheet is ready, the targets are clear. We are not looking for someone to figure things out. We are looking for someone who shows up every day, follows the process, hits the daily targets, and communicates clearly when something is not working. If you are reliable, organized, and enjoy outreach work, this is a great long-term opportunity with room to grow as the program expands. ---------- Ambassador Partner Program

title: Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA
description: WISE SCOUT Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA Remote · Full-Time About Wise Scout Wise Scout is a recruitment firm that helps small and growing businesses find and hire exceptional remote talent, primarily in the Philippines. We're a small, tight-knit team that does meaningful work: we match the right people with the right opportunities and help businesses build teams they're genuinely proud of. We're a caring, lighthearted team that believes work should be purposeful but not all-consuming. We care about our families, our people, and doing things well. If you've ever wanted to be part of a company where you're treated as a person first — this is that place. We're growing, and this hire is a critical next step. The person who steps into this role won't just support the work, they'll help shape how we operate and eventually build a team of their own. Role Overview We're looking for a Recruitment Operations & Client Success VA to be the operational engine behind Wise Scout's hiring pipelines and client relationships. This is a role for someone who loves moving things forward; who sees a task and gets it done without waiting to be told twice. You'll own the day-to-day execution of our recruitment process: setting up client meetings, building assessment pipelines, posting jobs, filtering candidates, tracking progress, and keeping clients informed every step of the way. You'll also support internal HR for our staff and jump into client-facing calls when needed. This isn't a role where you'll wait for perfect instructions. We have processes — many of them — but they're still being refined. You'll need to be comfortable stepping into some ambiguity, figuring out what the next step is, and moving forward. If that excites you, you'll thrive here. Schedule & Availability This role requires meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours, as client meetings and internal team calls happen in U.S. time zones. At least half of your working hours must be available during U.S. business hours in the Central time zone. During busy weeks, around a quarter of your hours will be spent in the U.S. Central time afternoons (between 12-4am PHT) Weekly all-hands meeting with the full Wise Scout team (Tuesdays 2pm CST/3am PHT) Weekly operational sync with Abby to drive hiring pipelines forward Schedule is otherwise flexible; we trust you to manage your time and deliver results What You'll Own This role is broad but focused. Here are the five core areas you'll be responsible for: 1. Client Communication & Relationship Management Set up and schedule intro calls with new clients; follow up with meeting notes, to-dos, and next steps Maintain consistent, professional communication with clients throughout the hiring process Send follow-up check-ins over days and weeks to stay top of mind with prospective clients Represent Wise Scout warmly and confidently in email and on video calls Potentially run intro meetings and hiring calls with clients independently over time 2. Hiring Pipeline Management Build and manage assessment pipelines in Criteria Corp for each active role Write experience questionnaires: self-assessment quizzes designed to quantify a candidate's background through how they answer, not just what they say Post job descriptions across multiple job boards Download and score applicants in spreadsheets; filter to top candidates based on scores and answers Move candidates through each stage of the pipeline with clear documentation and communication 3. Recruitment Reporting & Tracking Maintain a master tracking spreadsheet showing all open roles, current stage, and time-in-process for each Upload data and report regularly to leadership on pipeline health: how many applicants, who's moving forward, and where things stand Ensure nothing falls through the cracks between steps or between client touchpoints 4. Job Description Writing Use AI tools (and interview notes) to draft compelling, accurate job descriptions for each client role Collaborate with John and Abby to refine and finalize before posting 5. Internal HR & Staff Support Check in regularly with Wise Scout's internal staff to gauge workload, morale, and needs Answer basic technical questions about Slack, ---------- , and other internal tools Track team hours in ---------- , compile timesheets, and submit payroll through ---------- Support onboarding of new hires as the team grows What We're Looking For Skills and tools can be taught. What we can't teach is the right wiring. Monthly -Run the full monthly invoice cycle independently. -Bank and credit card reconciliation. -Categorize all expenses against the chart of accounts. -Produce a draft P&L and balance sheet for accounting partner review. -Management summary: revenue, COGS, gross margin, AR aging, and notable collections risks. title: Property Deal Analyst - Full Time
description: We're a UK property company. We find rental property deals, analyse them, and either manage them ourselves or pass them to investors. There's a steady flow of potential deals coming in every day, and someone needs to go through them properly and tell us which ones are worth our time. It's careful, focused, repetitive work - and done well, it's one of the most important roles in the business, because everything we do starts with finding good deals and filtering out bad ones. We're looking for someone who is genuinely good at careful, detailed analysis, takes pride in getting it right, and wants a stable role they can settle into for the long term. Every day, you will: Find potential deals : Search specific Facebook groups and other online sources where property deals get posted. Filter them (first pass): Run each one against a clear set of pass/fail rules we'll give you. Most deals fail here - that's normal and correct. Your job is to kill the obvious "no" deals quickly so they never reach us. Analyse the survivors (deep dive): For the deals that pass the first filter, you'll do a proper analysis: pull the numbers, find comparable properties, check the competition, and fill out a deal analysis sheet we'll provide. Give a verdict: For each analysed deal, you'll give us a clear thumbs up or thumbs down - "this is a good deal" or "this isn't" - with your reasoning. We make the final call, but your verdict is what we act on, so it has to be sound. Keep everything organised: Log each deal in our system so nothing slips through the cracks. You will not be talking to landlords, negotiating, or closing deals. That's our side. Your job is the analysis and the verdict - and doing it accurately, every day, at good volume. You'll do well here if you: Can form a sound judgement on numbers. This is the heart of the job. You'll be d ---------- whether a deal is actually good, and we act on your verdict. We need someone who can look at the figures and think clearly about whether they really stack up - who can tell a genuinely good deal from one that's just been dressed up to look good. This is not copy-and-paste data entry. Stay consistent, so deal number 40 gets the same care as deal number 1. You don't get sloppy when you're tired or bored. You hit your daily targets without being chased, and a cleared list done correctly gives you genuine satisfaction. Catch the small things. A wrong comparable, a transposed number, a missing field - you notice it. In this work, small errors lead to wrong verdicts, so getting the details right the first time matters. Want this role for the long term. You're looking for a stable, steady job you can hold for years - not a stepping stone to something else. Have reliable power and internet. This work happens on a daily schedule, so you need a stable setup where you can work consistently without long outages. Please don't apply if you: Are looking for a short-term gig or a stepping stone while you pursue something else - studying full-time, planning to move abroad, building your own business on the side. This role needs your full focus and a long-term commitment. Get bored easily by repetitive, detail-heavy work. This job is the same careful process every day. If that sounds dull to you, you'll be unhappy here and so will we. You do not need any property or real estate experience - we'll train you on everything property-related. We're hiring for temperament and analytical ability, not property knowledge. How to apply There's a link below to complete the application form for this role. This is the only way your application will be processed. You'll also need to attach a short Loom video of yourself within the application form, introducing yourself further. Develop leverage strategies among multiple suppliers. Present sourcing recommendations supported by objective financial analysis. Maintain detailed records of negotiations and supplier communications. Quality & Supplier Performance Coordinate supplier qualification and approval processes. Monitor supplier quality metrics and corrective actions. Work with factories to resolve quality issues. Coordinate inspections and quality audits. Maintain supplier records and certifications. Support product registrations and regulatory submissions where applicable. Ensure supplier adherence to: FDA requirements ISO standards Product testing requirements Labeling requirements Country-specific regulations Work with internal and external regulatory resources to ensure compliance. Packaging Development & Product Commercialization Coordinate packaging design projects with suppliers and internal stakeholders. Manage artwork revisions and approvals. Ensure packaging complies with all applicable regulatory and customer requirements. Coordinate packaging testing and validation. Support new product launches from concept through commercialization. Production Coordination Collaborate closely with the Director of Supply Chain Operations. Support production scheduling and manufacturing capacity planning. Monitor factory production status. Track manufacturing milestones and shipment readiness. Escalate production risks proactively. Help ensure products are delivered on schedule and in full. Risk Management Identify supply chain risks before they become disruptions. Develop contingency sourcing strategies. Maintain secondary supplier options where appropriate. Monitor geopolitical, regulatory, tariff, and transportation risks. Create mitigation plans for critical products. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, International Trade, or related field. 5+ years of international sourcing experience. Experience sourcing products from Asia and/or Latin America. Proven negotiation experience with overseas factories. Strong understanding of manufacturing processes. Experience managing supplier relationships. Experience with quality systems and supplier audits. Strong financial and analytical skills. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to travel internationally as required. Preferred Qualifications Experience in regulated industries such as medical devices, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, consumer products, or industrial manufacturing. Knowledge of quality management systems and supplier compliance programs. Experience with packaging development. Experience with product commercialization and product launches. Experience conducting overseas factory audits. Fluency in Mandarin, Vietnamese, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, or other relevant languages is a plus. Critical Success Factors The successful candidate will demonstrate: Exceptional integrity and ethical conduct. Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving abilities. Data-driven decision-making. Aggressive but professional negotiation skills. Ability to challenge suppliers constructively. Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities. Strong attention to detail. Ownership mentality and accountability. Ability to operate independently with minimal supervision. Fiduciary Duty, Ethics & Conflict of Interest Requirements This position is held to the highest fiduciary and ethical standards. The employee must always act solely in the best interests of the Company and its affiliated entities. As a condition of employment: The employee may not accept commissions, kickbacks, rebates, gifts, referral fees, overrides, consulting fees, or any other compensation from suppliers, manufacturers, brokers, trading companies, freight forwarders, consultants, or other third parties doing business with the Company. The employee may not own, directly or indirectly, any financial interest in a supplier, manufacturer, broker, trading company, or service provider utilized by the Company without prior written disclosure and approval. The employee may not participate in any purchasing, sourcing, supplier selection, or contract negotiation decision that presents an actual or perceived conflict of interest. The employee must immediately disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest. The employee must comply with all Company procurement, ethics, anti-bribery, anti-corruption, confidentiality, and supplier conduct policies. All supplier recommendations must be based solely on quality, compliance, service, reliability, risk profile, and total cost of ownership considerations. Any violation of these requirements may result in immediate termination and may subject the employee to legal action where applicable. Confidentiality & Intellectual Property Due to the strategic nature of this role, the employee will have access to confidential supplier information, product designs, pricing, sourcing strategies, forecasts, customer information, and other proprietary business information. As a condition of employment, the employee must: Execute a Confidentiality, Non-Disclosure, and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding all Company information. Return all Company records and materials upon termination of employment. Assign to the Company all work product, supplier relationships developed on behalf of the Company, sourcing strategies, databases, specifications, packaging designs, processes, and intellectual property created during employment. Refrain from using Company information for personal gain or for the benefit of any third party. Performance Metrics (KPIs) Success in this role will be measured through: Annual cost savings achieved Supplier quality performance On-time delivery performance Supplier responsiveness Regulatory compliance performance Successful product launches Supply continuity and risk reduction Packaging project completion Inventory availability support Negotiated improvements in pricing and payment terms Supplier diversification and contingency planning effectiveness This position serves as a trusted steward of the Company's global supply chain and is expected to consistently act in the Company's best interests while maximizing value, minimizing risk, and maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and integrity.

During paid working hours for our clinic, you must be focused on our work. During our scheduled shift, you may not: - Work for another client - Work for another employer - Work for another agency - Monitor another client's messages - Attend another client's meetings - Run another time tracker - Subcontract your work - Share logins We understand that some professionals may have outside commitments. We value clear communication and reliable availability. -------------------------------------------------- THIS ROLE IS A GOOD FIT IF -------------------------------------------------- This role is a good fit if you: - Have real US medical billing experience - Have worked hands-on in eClinicalWorks - Can work denials independently - Can follow up on A/R without constant reminders - Know how to use payer portals - Can document clearly - Are comfortable with a dedicated full-time schedule - Want a stable long-term role with a US medical clinic - Are honest about your experience and availability -------------------------------------------------- THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT IF -------------------------------------------------- This role is not a good fit if you: - Have no hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience - Only know scheduling or basic eligibility - Are looking for entry-level training - Cannot work US Central Time hours - Already have another job that overlaps with our schedule - Are applying as an agency - Plan to subcontract the work - Cannot document claim follow-up clearly - Need constant step-by-step instruction for routine billing tasks -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY -------------------------------------------------- Please follow these instructions carefully. title: AI Data Engineer - Data Extraction
description: Specification-Driven Extraction Engineering: Design and maintain declarative extraction specifications—using Pydantic models, JSON schemas, or domain-specific languages—that describe exactly which fields to capture, their types, and validation rules. Implement pipelines that translate these specifications into executable extraction plans, leveraging both classical (Scrapy, Playwright) and AI-augmented (LLM-based semantic parsing) backends. Build reusable specification libraries for recurring data types (product prices, tariff codes, regulatory texts) to accelerate onboarding of new sources. Design and implement autonomous data extraction agents that can make decisions about source selection, retry logic, and parsing strategies Autonomous & Self-Healing Systems: Deploy self-healing spiders that automatically detect website layout changes and repair themselves using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (e.g., Scrapy MCP Server, Playwright MCP). Integrate semantic extraction (Scrapy-LLM, custom LLM pipelines) to eliminate selector brittleness—spiders rely on field descriptions, not fragile XPaths. Hands-on experience building AI agents and orchestration systems. Orchestrate complex, multi-step browsing workflows with agentic frameworks (BMAD/TEA, AutoGPT-like agents) that reason about page state, adapt to anti-bot measures, and correct their own behaviour in real time. Platform Thinking & Reusability: Move beyond one-off scrapers: build a component-based extraction platform where selectors, login handlers, and pagination logic are shared, versioned, and tested. Implement monitoring, alerting, and automatic rollback for failed extraction runs. Champion ethical crawling by design—rate limiting, robots.txt respect, and compliance with GDPR/CCPA are built into the specification layer, not retrofitted. Collaboration & Continuous Innovation: Partner with data scientists and domain experts to refine extraction specifications for complex, unstructured domains (e.g., legal texts, tariff classifications). Evaluate and pilot emerging tools to push automation coverage beyond 90%. Document and evangelise specification-driven best practices across the engineering organisation. Qualification: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science 3+ years of experience in web scraping or data extraction Required Skills: Proficiency with Python Experience with specification-Driven Extraction Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen Hands?on use of Scrapy?LLM, Scrapy MCP Server, or similar systems that decouple field definitions from page structure Familiarity with frameworks that give LLMs browser control (Playwright + MCP, BMAD/TEA) to handle complex, non?deterministic crawling tasks. Classical Scraping Fundamentals Data Validation & Storage – Ability to define validation rules within specifications and land clean data into SQL/NoSQL databases or data lake Basic API integration and authentication flows. HTTP, DOM, XPath, CSS. Nice to Haves: Contributions to open-source scraping or AI-automation projects. Contributions to open-source scraping or AI-automation projects. Familiarity with data privacy engineering (GDPR, CCPA) baked into specification design. DevOps light – Docker, CI/CD for testing extraction specifications.

title: Junior Web Developer – 76,000/month (Remote)
description: We are a private equity-backed company operating 27 businesses across medical, real estate, and consulting. We are looking for a highly skilled Full-Time Junior Web Developer who can build and scale web pages rapidly, with a strong eye for structure, speed, and quality. This role is primarily focused on web page production. The bulk of your work will be approximately 80-90% creating and duplicating web pages at a consistent, high pace (using a template). These include home pages, service pages, blogs, landing pages, and a large volume of geolocation-specific pages that we build for our growing portfolio of healthcare and real estate brands. So basically, you will build a custom template from a figma design and then build it on wordpress (elementor), you will then duplicate the template for multiple pages (different locations) and you would just change the text copies and images on those duplicated pages. This is not just a production role. We are building something significant and we want a developer who takes pride in doing the work well, learns fast, and grows with the team. We currently have a team of 25+ talented Philippines-based developers, SEOs, and marketing professionals working across multiple US healthcare and real estate brands. You will be joining a high-performing, remote-first team that ships real work every day. WHY WORK WITH US We are a fast-growing organization with genuine long-term opportunities for the right people. Here is what sets us apart: •Above-market salary - At $1,250 USD/month (76,000 PHP), this role pays significantly above the Philippine market rate for a junior developer, and compensation grows as you do. •Real career development - You will work across 27 businesses in different industries, building skills in healthcare, real estate, and digital marketing that few developers your level get exposure to. •Stable, long-term work - This is not a project-based or short-term contract. We invest in the people on our team and we are looking for someone who wants to grow with us for years. •AI-forward team - We actively embrace AI tools to work smarter and faster. You will be encouraged and supported in using Claude AI and other tools to level up your output. •Leadership that understands digital - Our team is led by experienced digital marketing and SEO professionals who know the work from the inside. You will be supported, not just assigned tasks. •Remote and flexible - Work from anywhere in the Philippines with a stable internet connection. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY — PAGE PRODUCTION (80–90%) The core of this role is speed and consistency in web page production. You will be working primarily in WordPress and Elementor to: •Duplicate existing templated pages and replace images and text copy to produce new pages quickly and accurately •Build a high volume of geolocation-specific pages (city and state landing pages) for our medical, real estate, and consulting brands •Create home pages, service pages, blog layouts, landing pages, and comparison pages across our portfolio •Maintain consistency in page structure, formatting, and brand standards across all websites Speed Benchmark: Our target is one fully duplicated and updated page every 45 to 60 minutes. This will be a key measure of performance in both the hiring exam and ongoing work. Candidates who consistently hit or beat this benchmark thrive in this role. AI-ASSISTED DEVELOPMENT (STRONGLY PREFERRED) The second most important thing we look for in this role is comfort using AI tools to build pages faster and smarter. We do not require any specific tool, but we strongly prefer candidates who already use AI in their daily workflow. Examples of how AI can be applied in this role: •Converting raw text copy into a fully structured web page layout with sections, headings, and calls to action — without needing a designer •Building or installing custom calculator widgets and interactive elements on web pages using AI-generated code •Troubleshooting CSS or layout issues faster using AI suggestions •Automating repetitive page-building tasks to hit and exceed the speed benchmarks above If you are already using Claude AI, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any similar tool to assist your development work, that is a strong advantage. ADDITIONAL SKILLS (PREFERRED, NOT REQUIRED) These skills are not required to get started, but we will ask you to apply them at certain points as you grow into the role. Having any of these already is a plus: 1. Lead Capture and CRM Integration •Familiarity with contact forms, popup forms, and other lead capture elements across different WordPress themes and plugins •Experience connecting forms to CRMs via Zapier or similar automation tools (e.g., Make / Integromat) •Basic understanding of how lead data flows from a website form to a CRM or email platform 2. Website and Domain Transfers •Experience transferring domain ownership from a previous owner to a new registrar or account •Ability to migrate website files and databases as part of an acquisition handoff •Familiarity with converting plain HTML websites or non-WordPress CMSs (such as Wix) into fully functioning WordPress websites 3. Conversion Tracking Setup •Knowledge of installing and verifying Google Ads and Facebook /Meta Ads conversion tracking codes on websites •Ability to set up lead tracking to ensure paid traffic and form submissions are measured correctly •Basic understanding of Google Tag Manager as a way to manage tracking scripts 4. Website Security and Malware Prevention •Familiarity with WordPress security best practices to reduce vulnerability to malware and unauthorized access •Experience with security plugins (e.g., Wordfence, Sucuri) and basic hardening measures •Ability to help implement security protocols across multiple websites in our portfolio KEY RESPONSIBILITIES •Produce and duplicate web pages at a target pace of one page per 45 to 60 minutes using WordPress and Elementor •Build and manage a high volume of geolocation pages and service pages for our healthcare and real estate brands •Replace images and text copy on templated pages accurately and consistently •Use AI tools to speed up page production, generate layouts, and implement custom widgets or functions •Support CRM integrations by connecting website forms to automation workflows via Zapier or similar tools •Assist with website and domain transfer processes during new business acquisitions •Help implement and maintain security measures across our portfolio of websites •Support conversion tracking setup for Google Ads and Facebook Ads campaigns •Collaborate with our SEO, content, and marketing team to ensure pages meet quality and performance standards REQUIREMENTS Required: •Strong, hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor — this is non-negotiable •Ability to produce pages quickly and accurately, with consistent quality •Good English reading comprehension for working with US-market copy •Reliable internet connection and a stable remote work setup Preferred: •Active use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your development workflow •Experience with geolocation or programmatic page production at scale •Familiarity with healthcare, medical aesthetics, or real estate website content •Any of the additional skills listed above (forms/CRM, domain transfers, tracking, security) IMPORTANT: THE EXAM MATTERS MORE THAN THE INTERVIEW All shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical page-building exam as part of the hiring process. This exam is not a formality. Because the core of this role is the ability to build pages fast and accurately, your exam performance will be the primary factor in our hiring decision — more than your resume, portfolio, or interview responses. We are looking for real speed, real output, and real quality. Candidates who nail the exam will move to the top of our shortlist, regardless of years of experience.
